title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zakharova said Russia lodged a protest with Japan's embassy in Moscow over planned joint military exercises by Japan and the United States, calling provocative military activity near Russia's eastern border unacceptable; Iran's armed forces said they will not tolerate U.S. use of regional states' territory to commit aggression against Iran and will respond more strongly, while U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran's strikes on U.S. bases will be answered and the Pentagon announced a deal with defense contractors to boost production of Patriot and THAAD interceptors.

title_en: Special Program 'Understanding China's Governance' Book Sharing Session Airs Simultaneously on Mainstream Media in China and Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: On the occasion of Chinese President Xi Jinping attending the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and paying a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, a special program of the 'Understanding China's Governance' book sharing session on the Xi Jinping: The Governance of China series, jointly organized by China Media Group, Kyrgyzstan's national television and radio company, and Kyrgyz National University, aired simultaneously on CGTN's Russian channel and Kyrgyzstan's national broadcaster. At the session, Kyrgyz Secretary of State Koichiev and other guests said that Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era keeps pace with the times and continues to develop, providing fundamental guidance for contemporary China's long-term stability and continued progress, and expressed the hope that the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation will also inject strong momentum into Kyrgyzstan's revitalization and development.

title_en: International figures positively assess President Xi Jinping's important speech at the SCO Summit
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): International figures positively assessed President Xi Jinping's important speech delivered today (September 1) at the SCO Summit, saying it provides important guidance for improving global governance. They noted that China actively advocates multilateral cooperation and promotes dialogue and consensus among different countries, sending more positive signals to a world full of uncertainty.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo will be held in Nanning, Guangxi from September 17 to 21, that the Central Propaganda Department and 11 other departments issued a notice on organizing the 2026 "National Defense Education Month" activities in September, and that the 2026 edition of "First Class of the New Semester" will air tonight on CCTV's comprehensive channel, themed around the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory.

title_en: Rescue and relief work continues at full effort after mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: The segment reports that rescue operations in Gyirong County, Tibet, entered their seventh day, with a memorial held for victims and search, road-clearing, and monitoring work continuing; it also notes that China's second batch of aid supplies to Nepal departed Shenzhen and was expected to arrive in Kathmandu that evening.

title_en: Primary and Secondary Schools and Kindergartens Nationwide Welcome the Autumn Semester
summary_en: The segment reports that schools across China are beginning the autumn semester with varied "first lessons" covering scientific exploration, safety education, and retracing the Long March, alongside new education measures including continued "sunshine class placement" for balanced student and teacher allocation, fully rolled-out revised national curriculum textbooks, and hands-on science teaching. It also notes that students in disaster-affected areas such as Hengzhou in Guangxi and Shigatse in Tibet have started the new semester on schedule.

title_en: Solar Power Installed Capacity Surpasses Coal for First Time, Becoming China's Largest Power Source
summary_en: CCTV News reports that as of the end of July, China's cumulative solar power installed capacity reached 1.286 billion kilowatts, overtaking coal power for the first time and accounting for 31.5% of total installed capacity, making solar the country's largest power source. Solar generation in January-July reached 802.4 billion kilowatt-hours, up 15.5% year-on-year and equal to 13% of total electricity consumption.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with US-China Business Council Board Delegation
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing with a delegation from the US-China Business Council board, saying China is willing to work with the US to expand mutually beneficial cooperation and manage differences while urging Washington to address Chinese concerns. The US business representatives said they remain confident in China's economic prospects and will continue investing in China as long-term partners.

title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in Egyptian Media
summary_en: On the occasion of his state visit to Egypt, President Xi Jinping published a signed article titled "Seventy Years of Standing Together Through Storms, Forging Ahead on a New Journey" in Egyptian newspapers Al-Ahram, Al-Akhbar, and Al-Gomhuria, reviewing 70 years of China-Egypt relations and outlining cooperation in trade, culture, and multilateral affairs. The article notes this is Xi's second visit to Egypt as president, made at the invitation of President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

title_en: Xi Jinping Concludes Attendance at 2026 SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1 local time, President Xi Jinping concluded his attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and his state visit to Kyrgyzstan. As he departed Bishkek, Kyrgyz Prime Minister Adylbek Kasymaliev and others saw him off at the airport.

title_en: Peng Liyuan Attends Spouses' Group Activity at SCO Summit
summary_en: On the morning of September 1 local time in Bishkek, Peng Liyuan, wife of President Xi Jinping, attended the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit spouses' group activity hosted by Aigul Japarova, wife of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov. Peng watched an exhibition of Kyrgyz ethnic culture and an artistic performance, praising the performers and inviting Kyrgyz artists to perform and exchange more in China.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Mongolian President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khurelsukh on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, where Xi called for deepening the China-Mongolia comprehensive strategic partnership and Khurelsukh reaffirmed Mongolia's one-China principle and friendship with China. Cai Qi and Wang Yi also attended the meeting.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Uzbek President
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Bishkek on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit, marking the 10th anniversary of the China-Uzbekistan comprehensive strategic partnership and discussing cooperation including the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, counterterrorism, and cultural exchanges.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Russian President Putin
summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit in Bishkek, where the two leaders discussed deepening China-Russia cooperation and SCO development, and exchanged views on international and regional issues of shared concern.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The station aired a CCTV Quick Comment today (September 1) titled "Promoting Higher-Quality Development of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization."

title_en: Xi Jinping attends 'SCO Plus' meeting and delivers important speech
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1 local time in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping attended the 'SCO Plus' meeting and delivered a speech titled 'Jointly Advocate an Equitable and Orderly Multipolar World and Realize More Just and Reasonable Global Governance,' proposing three suggestions for the SCO's role; the meeting was chaired by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, with leaders including Belarus's Lukashenko, India's Modi, Iran's Pezeshkian, Kazakhstan's Tokayev, Pakistan's Sharif, Russia's Putin, Tajikistan's Rahmon, Uzbekistan's Mirziyoyev, and UN Secretary-General Guterres attending.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 26th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of State and Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: On September 1 in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping attended the 26th meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Council of Heads of State, hosted by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, with leaders including Belarus's Alexander Lukashenko, India's Narendra Modi, Iran's Masoud Pezeshkian, Kazakhstan's Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, Pakistan's Shehbaz Sharif, Russia's Vladimir Putin, Tajikistan's Emomali Rahmon, and Uzbekistan's Shavkat Mirziyoyev participating. Xi delivered a speech titled "Promoting the Shanghai Cooperation Organization's Higher-Quality Development," marking the SCO's 25th anniversary, proposing four points on development, security, people-to-people ties, and dialogue, and the meeting adopted the Bishkek Declaration and 28 outcome documents, with Pakistan to chair the SCO for 2026-2027.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the U.S. struck Iranian Revolutionary Guard mine-laying units and Iran retaliated against two U.S. air bases in Jordan; that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said conditions for restarting Russia-Ukraine talks are lacking; that Icelandic Prime Minister Kristrún Frostadóttir said her government will not pursue EU accession talks during its term; and that Japan's new 10-year government bond yield approached a 30-year high.

title_en: 2026 SCO People-to-People Exchange Event Held in Bishkek
summary_en: On the sidelines of President Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and state visit to Kyrgyzstan, China Media Group and Kyrgyzstan's national broadcaster co-hosted a 2026 SCO people-to-people exchange event in Bishkek on August 30, where a 2026-2027 action plan for deepening media cooperation among SCO countries and a global opinion poll on SCO influence were released, along with China-Kyrgyzstan cultural cooperation results and the launch of CGTN's Russian channel across Kyrgyzstan.

title_en: Kyrgyzstan Voices Praise for Xi Jinping's State Visit, Hails New Chapter in Bilateral Ties and China-Kyrgyzstan Community with a Shared Future
summary_en: Kyrgyz figures from various sectors praised Xi Jinping's state visit, saying the two heads of state reached important consensus on building a China-Kyrgyzstan community with a shared future and opened a new chapter in bilateral relations. International figures also expressed expectations that Xi's attendance at the SCO summit will advance the organization's high-quality development.

title_en: Trade-in program for consumer goods drives over 1.54 trillion yuan in sales this year
summary_en: CCTV reports, citing the Ministry of Commerce, that as of August 30 the 2026 consumer goods trade-in program had driven over 1.54 trillion yuan in related product sales, benefiting more than 206 million person-times, with 27 localities running their own subsidy programs for self-selected categories that generated sales of 2.286 million items. The segment adds that retail sales of high energy-efficiency home appliances at above-designated-size units grew more than 30% year-on-year in the first seven months, and that the market penetration rate of new energy passenger vehicles exceeded 60% for four consecutive months.

title_en: Rescue and relief work continues after mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: Rescue operations continue in the core disaster area at the Gyirong port, where high-altitude emergency rescue helicopters are transporting firefighting, police, health and epidemic-prevention personnel and supplies for deep search efforts. Crews are clearing the damaged section of National Highway 216, communications at the port have been restored, and authorities have preliminarily identified eight high-risk geological hazard points for follow-up monitoring.

title_en: China's Manufacturing Sector Conditions Improve Notably from Last Month
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics and the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported on August 31 that China's manufacturing PMI for August was 49.8%, up 0.6 percentage points from the previous month, with 16 of the 21 surveyed industries posting gains. Production and new orders both returned to expansion, and the PMIs for equipment manufacturing and high-tech manufacturing stood at 51.4% and 52.9% respectively, maintaining relatively rapid growth.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang to Visit Russia for the 11th Eastern Economic Forum and Chair China-Russia Investment, Energy Cooperation Meetings
summary_en: At the invitation of the Russian federal government, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, will visit Russia from September 2 to 4 to attend the 11th Eastern Economic Forum. During the visit he will hold the 13th meeting of the China-Russia Investment Cooperation Committee, the 23rd meeting of the Energy Cooperation Committee, and the 8th China-Russia Energy Business Forum.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets with President of Austria's National Council
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, met in Beijing with Rosenkranz, President of Austria's National Council, with both sides pledging to deepen the China-Austria friendly strategic partnership and expand practical cooperation.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Austrian National Council President Rosenkranz
summary_en: Zhao Leji, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, held talks in Beijing with Austrian National Council President Rosenkranz, with both sides pledging to deepen exchanges between their legislatures and expand cooperation in trade, technology, and people-to-people ties. Rosenkranz reaffirmed Austria's adherence to the one-China policy and said deepening cooperation with China is a consensus across Austria's major parties.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on August 31 to study and implement Xi Jinping's remarks on rescue work following the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet. The meeting also heard a report on urban underground pipeline construction, studied work on improving the quality of investment promotion, and reviewed draft revisions to the tax collection and administration law and the audit law implementation regulations.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Upholding and Implementing Political Responsibility for Party Governance
summary_en: The 17th issue of Qiushi Journal, published September 1, will carry a Xi Jinping article titled "Uphold and Implement the Political Responsibility for Governing the Party," an excerpt of his remarks from June 2013 to July 2026 stressing that the Party must govern itself strictly and that responsibility for Party discipline must be clearly assigned, carried out, and enforced through accountability.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Small-Group Talks with Kyrgyz President
summary_en: On the evening of August 30, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan dined with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and his wife at the presidential residence, while the next morning Peng Liyuan and the Kyrgyz first lady visited the National History Museum in Bishkek and viewed cultural exhibitions.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Kyrgyz President Japarov
summary_en: On August 31 in Bishkek, Xi Jinping held talks with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, who hosted a welcome ceremony; the two leaders signed a joint declaration on developing the comprehensive strategic partnership and a treaty of permanent good-neighborliness and friendly cooperation, and witnessed the exchange of bilateral cooperation documents.

title_en: Xi Jinping attends welcome ceremony hosted by Kyrgyz President
summary_en: In Bishkek, Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and his wife held a welcome ceremony for Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at the Ala-Archa State Residence (Harmony Palace), including a military band, a guard of honor inspection, and a march-past. Xi greeted the honor guard in Kyrgyz and the two leaders watched the parade before posing for a photo in front of the two countries' flags.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the launch of mass production at a China-Serbia joint humanoid robot factory in Šabac, Serbia, attended by Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić; Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi saying the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the US fulfills its commitments, and Supreme Leader Mojtaba's remarks on the US and Israel; a Russian strike on a Ukrainian ammunition depot in Kyiv Oblast that killed 38, according to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy; a Guardian report that EU gas reserves may fall to their lowest level since 2013; and Ontario Premier Doug Ford unveiling a sign at Lake Ontario after US President Donald Trump ordered it renamed 'Lake America'.

title_en: Kyrgyzstan Figures Welcome President Xi Jinping's State Visit, Aiming to Elevate China-Kyrgyzstan Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in the New Era
summary_en: People from various sectors in Kyrgyzstan welcomed President Xi Jinping's state visit to Kyrgyzstan, expressing hope that under the guidance of the two heads of state, the countries will deepen strategic mutual trust, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and carry forward generations of friendship. They said the visit carries strategic significance for advancing bilateral relations and will inject strong momentum into comprehensive cooperation and contribute to regional stability and development.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China aims to basically complete a modern agricultural product origin market system by 2030, the Ministry of Natural Resources has released the country's first national geometric reference imagery covering all land territory, Xinjiang's 750kV ultra-high-voltage transmission lines have surpassed 15,000 km, and Guangzhou's China-Europe freight trains have handled over 110 billion yuan in cumulative import-export value over ten years.

title_en: China Improves Multi-Tiered Medical Insurance System to Meet Diverse Coverage Needs
summary_en: China's Medical Security Law has been introduced and will take effect on January 1 next year, as the country builds a multi-tiered medical insurance network with basic medical insurance as the mainstay supported by critical illness insurance, medical assistance, commercial health insurance, charitable donations and mutual aid. The law encourages flexible workers to join employee basic medical insurance, with nearly 70 million such participants in 2025, and provides subsidized coverage for disadvantaged groups.

title_en: Skills Training Enhances Employability
summary_en: CCTV reports that China is expanding targeted vocational skills training tied to industry needs, including digital training for workers in Chongqing's intelligent connected vehicle sector and "order-based" courses for emerging industries such as smart manufacturing and the low-altitude economy. In the first half of the year, 4.819 million people nationwide newly obtained vocational qualification or skill-level certificates, and subsidized training is set to reach over 10 million person-times for the year.

title_en: The Technological Force Behind "Wresting Grain from Insects"
summary_en: CCTV reports that China operates the world's largest insect radar monitoring network, with 65 radar units now connected to the national monitoring and early-warning platform covering the three major migratory pest corridors, and projects more than 150 units by 2030 to build a three-tier defense network combining high-altitude radar monitoring, aerial interception of adult insects, and precise ground trapping.

title_en: Technology aids field management, promotes stable grain production and increased income
summary_en: The segment reports that in late August, as autumn grain crops enter the critical yield-formation period, localities are relying on technology and smart field management to boost stable grain output and income, citing examples from Henan, Anhui, Shanxi, Yunnan and Sichuan including drone-based crop protection, soil monitoring systems and high-standard rice cultivation.

title_en: Rescue and relief work for the Jilong County mudslide disaster in Tibet advances effectively and in an orderly manner
summary_en: CCTV reports that as of 18:00 on the 29th the mudslide disaster in Jilong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, had killed 16 people and left 546 missing, with 2,141 rescuers from the PLA, armed police, fire and rescue services, border defense, public security and China Anneng deployed as search-and-rescue operations continue in the core disaster area at the Jilong port. The segment also notes that China is providing a package of aid to Nepal, with relief supplies delivered to Kathmandu and tunnel rescue experts arriving in the disaster zone.

title_en: 35,000 New Foreign-Invested Enterprises Established Nationwide in First Half of Year
summary_en: Data released by the State Administration for Market Regulation shows that 35,000 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide in the first half of the year, up 7.0% year on year, with 11,000 of them from Belt and Road partner countries, Arab states, and African Union nations combined, and the consumer market emerging as a new draw for foreign investment.

title_en: China Rolls Out New Measures to Accelerate Data Industry Development
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China will launch a series of new measures to speed up data industry growth, including pilot data-annotation programs in 32 cities, new token-based business models, and the opening of over 6 billion high-value data records by 14 central and state-owned enterprises. A report released at the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo shows the data industry has surpassed 6 trillion yuan in scale, with AI-related data products and services accounting for more than 70 percent of total output and over 480,000 data enterprises nationwide.

title_en: Inner Mongolia Accelerates Green Industry Development
summary_en: Inner Mongolia is developing new energy industries and promoting green, low-carbon transformation of traditional industries during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including direct green power supply to computing centers in Horinger New Area, solar panels over coal-mining subsidence areas in Ejin Horo Banner, and plans to add over 30 million kilowatts of new energy capacity annually to reach 325 million kilowatts by 2030.

title_en: Multilingual Edition of 'Classics Quoted by Xi Jinping' Airs on Mainstream Media in SCO Countries
summary_en: On the occasion of Chinese President Xi Jinping attending the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and paying a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, a launch event for the multilingual edition of 'Classics Quoted by Xi Jinping,' produced by China Media Group, was held in Bishkek on August 30, with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov sending a congratulatory letter. The program, which presents classical Chinese quotations cited in Xi's speeches and writings, is airing on mainstream media across SCO countries including Kyrgyzstan, Belarus, India, Kazakhstan, Pakistan, Russia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and Iran.

title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Bishkek for 2026 SCO Summit and State Visit to Kyrgyzstan
summary_en: President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek on August 30 for the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and a state visit to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, who welcomed Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan at Manas International Airport with traditional ceremonies. In a written statement, Xi said he would hold in-depth exchanges with Japarov on bilateral relations, cooperation and shared international and regional issues, and looked forward to the SCO Bishkek summit.

title_en: Xi Jinping leaves Beijing to attend 2026 SCO Summit and pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping departed Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit and, at the invitations of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, to conduct state visits to both countries. Accompanying Xi were his wife Peng Liyuan, Politburo Standing Committee member and Central Office Director Cai Qi, and Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Iran's Revolutionary Guard declared the Strait of Hormuz closed to ships passing without Iranian coordination, while U.S. Central Command reported a continued naval blockade of Iran with about 50,000 U.S. troops in the Middle East; Japan's Ministry of Finance disclosed a record 15.3993 trillion yen (about $96.2 billion) currency intervention from July 30 to August 26 that failed to halt the yen's slide to 160.2 per dollar; and Spanish Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska announced "extraordinary" measures to tighten border control at the North African enclave of Ceuta, where about 5,000 irregular migrants remain.

title_en: CCTV Launches Broadcasts of Premium Programs in Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: China Media Group launched broadcasts of premium film and television programs in Bishkek and Cairo ahead of Xi Jinping's attendance at the 2026 SCO summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, with programs including "Letters from President Xi" and "Xi Jinping's Cultural Sentiments" airing on mainstream media in both countries.

title_en: Kyrgyzstan Voices: President Xi Jinping's Signed Article Charts Direction for a New Phase of High-Quality China-Kyrgyzstan Relations
summary_en: Ahead of his state visit to Kyrgyzstan and the 2026 SCO summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in Kyrgyz media titled "Working Together to Open a New Phase of High-Quality China-Kyrgyzstan Relations." Kyrgyz figures and international observers said the article charts the direction for high-quality bilateral relations and injects new momentum into building an SCO community with a shared future, with expectations that the Bishkek summit will lift that effort to a new level.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Ministry of Finance and other departments urgently allocated 150 million yuan for flood and typhoon disaster relief in Zhejiang, Fujian and Guangxi, and that the National Development and Reform Commission arranged 100 million yuan for post-typhoon recovery in Zhejiang and Fujian; it also covers the expansion of the RMB cross-border payment system, China's trade with other SCO member states reaching $523.5 billion in 2025 and with Kyrgyzstan $11.7 billion in the first seven months of this year, China's first two-way high-speed laser communication between Earth and the Moon, the start of joint testing on the Hengshui-Huanghua Port high-speed railway, the 2026 Lu Xun Literature Prize ceremony in Shanghai, and the close of the 2026 Global Entrepreneurs Summit in Beijing.

title_en: Major Health Indicators for Chinese Residents Continue to Improve
summary_en: China's National Health Commission released its 2025 statistical bulletin on health development, reporting that average life expectancy reached 79.25 years by the end of 2025 and that major resident health indicators continued to improve. Average outpatient and inpatient costs per visit at hospitals fell year-on-year, with community health service center outpatient costs down 11.7% to 150.1 yuan and township health center outpatient costs down 9.4% to 79.4 yuan, while the country had 1.108 million medical and health institutions, 13.455 million health technicians, and 10.65 billion total patient visits for the year.

title_en: China's Logistics Sector Steady with Progress in First Seven Months
summary_en: Citing data from the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing, the segment reports that China's total social logistics value reached 214.5 trillion yuan in January-July, up 5.0% year-on-year, with manufacturing remaining the core growth engine as equipment manufacturing and high-tech manufacturing logistics demand rose 12.3% and 16.9% respectively in July.

title_en: 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services to Open in Beijing on September 9
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 28, where officials from the Ministry of Commerce and Beijing said the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services will open on September 9 at Shougang Park in Beijing, with about 90 countries and international organizations exhibiting and holding events and more than 1,800 companies participating offline. This year's fair will highlight new technologies, solutions and achievements in services trade fields such as information and communications, fintech, digital and intelligent healthcare, smart education, and energy conservation and environmental protection, and will for the first time set up a "China Services" exhibition area in the core zone of the thematic exhibition as well as a dedicated "Going Global Services" area, and will release authoritative reports including the China Services Trade Development Report.

title_en: Digital industry revenue exceeds 20 trillion yuan in first half of the year
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's digital industry generated 20.71 trillion yuan in revenue in the first half of the year, up 13.6% year-on-year, with total profits of 1.79 trillion yuan, up 19.3%, driven by domestic AI demand and strong exports. By the end of June, China had 5.102 million 5G base stations and 52 intelligent computing facilities of more than 10,000 cards, and had built 16 national-level advanced manufacturing clusters in fields such as integrated circuits and artificial intelligence.

title_en: China to Roll Out Multiple Measures to Boost Effective Investment
summary_en: CCTV reports that the National Development and Reform Commission said China will take multiple measures to spur effective investment, noting that high-tech industry investment rose 5.0% year-on-year in January-July and integrated circuit manufacturing investment rose 11.5%. Next steps include advancing "Two Major" construction and central budget investment projects, accelerating local government special bond issuance, deploying new policy-based financial instruments, and launching major projects open to private enterprises.

title_en: All Forces Push Into Disaster Core Area as Mudslide Rescue Continues in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: A mudslide in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, has caused heavy casualties and left people missing; rescue teams are conducting grid searches, air-dropping supplies with drones and helicopters, clearing the destroyed National Highway 216, and monitoring a barrier lake formed upstream, while medical teams visit resettlement sites and, at Nepal's request, the Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched tunnel rescue experts to Nepal for work at a hydropower station tunnel.

title_en: Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) holds autumn semester opening ceremony; Cai Qi attends and delivers speech
summary_en: The Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) held its 2026 autumn semester opening ceremony on the 29th, at which Politburo Standing Committee member and school president Cai Qi spoke, calling for comprehensive study of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, and for cadres to uphold the "two确立" and "two维护." Cai also urged a correct view of the current economic situation, confidence and stable expectations, coordination of development and security for a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan, and stressed that leading cadres coming to the school are first and foremost students; Shi Taifeng attended the ceremony.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Practicing the Global Governance Initiative to Build a Better World
summary_en: The segment marks the one-year anniversary of Xi Jinping's proposal of the Global Governance Initiative at the 2025 SCO Tianjin summit, reporting that nearly 160 countries and international organizations have endorsed it and that China has issued concept papers and white papers and taken steps such as expanding BRICS, supporting the African Union's G20 membership, and launching an international mediation organization.

title_en: News Roundup
summary_en: The segment covers the opening of the 2026 China International Big Data Industry Expo in Guiyang, the 2026 APEC Third Senior Officials' Meeting in Dalian, President Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario "Lake of America" and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's response that Canada will never change the name, and Iran's pledge to counter any US actions escalating economic tensions.

title_en: Shenzhou-23 Crew Completes Spacewalk Successfully
summary_en: During a roughly 5.5-hour spacewalk on August 28, Shenzhou-23 astronauts Zhu Yangzhu, Zhang Zhiyuan and Li Jiaying, working with the space station's robotic arm and ground personnel, completed extravehicular repairs to a solar wing and installed space debris shielding; Zhu Yangzhu and Zhang Zhiyuan returned safely to the Tianhe core module. It was China's second in-orbit repair of a solar wing, and the three astronauts have now been working in orbit for more than three months.

title_en: All parties carry out rescue and relief after mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: A mudslide in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, caused heavy casualties and left people missing; rescue teams, including a fire and rescue unit that reached the worst-hit Gyirong Port area after an 8-hour trek, are conducting search and rescue by land, water and air, while about 500 threatened residents near the port have been placed in four temporary shelters and 555 tourists in Gyirong Town have been evacuated.

title_en: 24th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee Closes in Beijing
summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee concluded its 24th session in Beijing on the 28th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji, passing laws on medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, revised agricultural and national defense mobilization laws, and amendments to the lawyers law, along with personnel appointments and removals including a new minister of civil affairs and changes to the Central Military Commission and National Supervisory Commission. Zhao Leji delivered remarks on legislation for the 15th Five-Year Plan, and a constitutional oath ceremony and a special lecture were held.

title_en: Li Qiang Guides Rescue and Emergency Response Work in Gyirong, Tibet
summary_en: Entrusted by Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang traveled on August 27 to Gyirong County in Shigatse, Tibet, to guide rescue and emergency response work following a mudslide disaster at the Gyirong port, conveying Xi's concern for affected residents and stressing all-out search and rescue efforts, infrastructure repairs, and proper resettlement of victims. Li also chaired a meeting at the disaster front command center on further rescue operations and warned that China remains in its main flood season, urging heightened vigilance against floods and typhoons.

title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in Kyrgyz Media
summary_en: On the eve of his state visit to Kyrgyzstan and the 2026 SCO summit in Bishkek, President Xi Jinping published a signed article titled "Working Together to Open New Prospects for High-Quality Development of China-Kyrgyzstan Relations" in Kyrgyz media, reviewing bilateral ties and outlining cooperation priorities ahead of his meeting with President Sadyr Japarov.

title_en: Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Orders
summary_en: President Xi Jinping signed Presidential Orders No. 80 through No. 85 on August 28, promulgating laws on medical security, farmland protection and quality improvement, agriculture, and national defense mobilization, along with an amendment to the Lawyers Law, all passed by the 14th NPC Standing Committee's 24th session. Order No. 85 removed Lu Zhiyuan as Minister of Civil Affairs and appointed Li Changguan to the post.

title_en: Comrade Chen Wu's body cremated in Beijing
summary_en: The body of Chen Wu, a senior Party member and Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, was cremated at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing on August 28; he died of illness in Beijing on August 24, 2026, at age 72. Xi Jinping, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng and others attended the farewell, and Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Hu Jintao and other leaders expressed condolences to his family.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Nepal's President Over Landslide Disaster; Li Qiang Sends Message of Condolence to Nepal's Prime Minister
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Nepali President Ram Chandra Paudel over a severe landslide at the Gyirong-Rasuwagadhi border crossing between China and Nepal that caused casualties, missing persons and property losses, pledging China's full efforts in search and rescue and its readiness to assist Nepal's relief work. On the same day, Premier Li Qiang sent a message of condolence to Nepali Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli.

title_en: Politburo of the CPC Central Committee Holds Meeting to Study and Deploy Rescue and Relief Work for the Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet; Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Presides Over the Meeting
summary_en: The Politburo of the CPC Central Committee met on August 28, presided over by Xi Jinping, to study and deploy rescue and relief work after a mudslide originating on the Nepalese side caused heavy casualties and missing persons at the Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet. The meeting, which began with a moment of silence for the victims, stressed scientific search-and-rescue, monitoring to prevent secondary disasters, resettlement of affected residents, and emergency assistance and international rescue cooperation for the affected areas in Nepal.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russian State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin urged Japan to face its history of aggression and criticized its leadership's remarks over Putin's visit to Iturup; Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe announced a 50% retaliatory tariff on US liquor imports starting September 8, while US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said no open communication channels remain after US-Canada trade talks broke down; and the WHO reported over 5,600 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 2,715 deaths.

title_en: Iran Says Military Doctrine Shifts from Defense to Offense; US Says No Timetable for Resuming Talks
summary_en: Iranian army spokesman Akraminia said Iran's military doctrine has shifted from defense to offense and its armed forces are prepared to launch preemptive strikes if necessary, while IRGC spokesman Mohbi said the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen unless the US accepts Iran's conditions including lifting the blockade and sanctions; Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi wrote to the UN calling US economic pressure "economic terrorism." US President Donald Trump said he has set no timetable for resuming US-Iran talks, claiming the US has achieved a very big victory and Iran's economy is collapsing.

title_en: Nepal mudslide disaster kills 289, hundreds missing
summary_en: Nepal police announced on August 27 that a mudslide in the Rasuwa district of northern Nepal has killed at least 289 people and left 910 missing, including hundreds of foreign tourists. Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said the disaster damaged 35 motorable bridges, 45 suspension bridges and 40 kilometers of paved road, and the government has launched an emergency response to reopen blocked roads and restore water, power and communications.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on a one-year nationwide special campaign on road motor vehicle production consistency and quality improvement, a joint document on developing intellectual property data resources, the launch of a national medical insurance pathology cloud, the 27th rotation of the PLA Macao Garrison, the completion of pre-navigation trial runs for the Pinglu Canal, and the departure of China's first scheduled China-Laos-Thailand express freight train from Zhengzhou.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of One-Hour Commuting Circles in Metropolitan Areas
summary_en: The segment reports that China is advancing one-hour intercity commuting within metropolitan areas, citing a new cross-provincial bus route between Tianjin and Beijing, a policy plan by the Ministry of Transport and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei governments covering Beijing and 12 surrounding districts and counties, and the start of no-passenger trial runs on Line 22 (Hongmiao–Pinggu), the first urban rail line crossing the Beijing-Hebei border. It adds that construction is being coordinated around four priorities—rapid corridors, convenient hubs, same-city services, and smart travel—with a goal of 75% population coverage under one-hour commuting conditions in major metropolitan areas by 2030.

title_en: China's Energy-Intensive Industries Accelerate Energy Saving and Carbon Reduction
summary_en: CCTV reports that energy-intensive sectors such as steel, glass and cement are cutting emissions through technological innovation, waste-heat power generation and resource recycling, and that China has launched a three-year energy-saving and carbon-reduction campaign covering nine major energy-intensive industries.

title_en: Frontline Research: The New Efficiency of 'Revitalizing' Idle Assets
summary_en: The segment reports on a national platform launched by the Ministry of Finance last year for allocating and sharing state-owned assets among administrative and public institutions, which by the end of June 2026 had gathered over 710,000 supply-and-demand listings and completed transfers of 90,000 units of equipment, saving roughly 1.6 billion yuan in budget funds at original asset value.

title_en: China's Robotics Industry Sees Continuous Innovation
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's robotics industry posted 165.5 billion yuan in revenue from above-scale enterprises in the first half of 2026, up 24.5% year-on-year, with the country holding about two-thirds of global robot patent applications in 2024, domestic-brand industrial robots exceeding 50% market share at home, and embodied-intelligence robots moving from showrooms into real-world applications as the 15th Five-Year Plan lists embodied intelligence as a key future industry.

title_en: New Interest Subsidy Policy Takes Effect for Loans to Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises and Service Sector Entities
summary_en: China's six major state-owned commercial banks announced that a new central government interest subsidy is now in effect for eligible working capital loans to small, medium and micro private enterprises and service sector entities issued since August 1, with subsidies of 1 percentage point annualized for up to two years. The per-borrower loan ceiling eligible for the subsidy was raised to 75 million yuan for SME loans and 20 million yuan for service sector loans, and banks will submit qualifying existing loans for review without requiring action from the enterprises.

title_en: China's New Momentum Index for Economic Development Maintains Relatively Fast Growth
summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released the 2025 index of new momentum for China's economic development on August 27, showing the index at 153.0, up 12.5% year on year. The transformation and upgrading sub-index rose 22.7% to 156.8 and the innovation-driven sub-index rose 12.9% to 156.3, reflecting continued growth of strategic emerging industries and increased innovation input.

title_en: Profits of China's Industrial Enterprises Above Designated Size Maintain Rapid Growth in First Seven Months
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on August 27 shows China's industrial enterprises above designated size achieved total profits of 458.206 billion yuan in January–July, up 17.6% year on year, maintaining rapid growth. Profits in high-tech manufacturing above designated size rose 50.1% year on year over the same period, contributing 9.6 percentage points to overall industrial profit growth, while electronics-related industries saw profits more than double, up 1.1 times.

title_en: Enhancing Citizens' Legal Literacy, Cultivating Rule-of-Law Belief Across Society
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 27, officials from the Ministry of Justice and other departments briefed on implementation of the "Ninth Five-Year" plan for rule-of-law publicity and education. Building on the achievements of the "Eighth Five-Year" period, the new plan takes the Law on Rule-of-Law Publicity and Education as its binding legal basis, marking a shift from policy-driven to law-based implementation, with promoting Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law as the primary task and raising citizens' legal literacy and cultivating society-wide belief in the rule of law as core goals.

title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee Holds 72nd Chairpersons' Meeting
summary_en: The 72nd Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing on the afternoon of the 27th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji. The meeting heard reports on revisions to draft laws including the Medical Security Law, the Farmland Protection and Quality Improvement Law, the Agriculture Law, the National Defense Mobilization Law, and a decision on amending the Lawyers Law, as well as a report on the extradition treaty between China and Hungary, and decided to submit the revised drafts to the Standing Committee session for deliberation.

title_en: All parties make full efforts in rescue operations after mudslide in Gyirong County, Tibet
summary_en: A mudslide originating on the Nepalese side struck the Gyirong Port area in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, causing casualties and hundreds missing, and Xi Jinping issued important instructions; national and regional emergency responses were activated, with over a thousand rescue personnel, helicopters, drones and engineering teams deployed, while a barrier lake upstream poses a high risk of outburst and central funds and treasury channels were arranged for disaster relief and recovery.

title_en: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Li Qiang Arrives in Gyirong, Tibet to Guide Rescue and Disaster Relief Work
summary_en: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, led relevant responsible officials to the mudslide-affected area in Gyirong Town, Gyirong County, Tibet on the afternoon of August 27 to guide rescue and disaster relief work and to visit rescue personnel and affected residents in resettlement.

title_en: First and Second Volumes of 'Selected Cultural Writings of Xi Jinping' Published and Distributed
summary_en: The first and second volumes of the "Selected Cultural Writings of Xi Jinping," edited by the Institute of Party History and Literature of the CPC Central Committee, have been published by the Central Party Literature Press and distributed nationwide. The volumes collect 78 of Xi Jinping's most important writings on cultural development from November 2012 to February 2026, including reports, speeches, letters and instructions, some published publicly for the first time.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed contact between Russian intelligence and CIA Director John Ratcliffe, that Israel's demolition of a UNRWA vocational training center in East Jerusalem drew condemnation, that Spain advanced draft reforms to its immigration and asylum systems amid the Ceuta migrant crisis, and that wildfires in Texas spread rapidly, forcing evacuations.

title_en: Canada Announces Equal Counter-Tariffs on US, Covering Over 700 Goods
summary_en: Canada's federal government announced on the 25th that it will impose counter-tariffs of 15%–50% on more than 700 US goods worth 27.6 billion Canadian dollars, covering steel and aluminum, dairy, home appliances, and agricultural equipment, effective September 8, alongside an aid plan for small and medium-sized Canadian firms hit by the trade war. The same day, US President Donald Trump said on social media that Canada has been "ripping off" the US and that he is considering renaming Lake Ontario "Lake America," to which Canadian Industry Minister Mélanie Joly responded that Canada will not change the lake's name and will defend all of its interests.

title_en: Omani Foreign Minister Visits Iran; Iran Announces Temporary Shipping Route Arrangements for Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: According to a joint statement issued by Iran and Oman on the 25th, Omani Foreign Minister Badr visited Iran that day and discussed with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi a phased framework for restoring navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, including establishing a mutually agreed temporary shipping corridor and jointly conducting minesweeping in the strait. Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi said the temporary corridor arrangement permits only commercial vessels to transit the Strait of Hormuz and does not mean the strait will immediately reopen, while U.S. media reported that Secretary of State Rubio said the United States will temporarily avoid new military action against Iran and instead increase economic pressure through a continued maritime blockade and new sanctions.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, State Grid's cross-provincial power transmission capacity will reach 500 million kilowatts; that three departments including the National Health Commission issued a notice to further improve contracted family doctor services; and that cross-border land-air intermodal transport between Macao and Hengqin officially launched on August 26, with the first batch of cross-border e-commerce goods shipped via Macao International Airport.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists in Beijing on August 26 under the theme 'Strivers on the New Journey.' Five model public security representatives spoke on the theme 'Honoring the Pledge and Original Aspiration, Protecting Peace with Loyalty and Responsibility,' sharing stories from their work in criminal technology, traffic law enforcement, cybersecurity protection, public order, and smart policing.

title_en: BeiDou System Reaches ~90% Penetration in Key Industries
summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reports that BeiDou terminal equipment in key industries has reached nearly 40 million units, with comprehensive application penetration of about 90%. More than 98% of smartphones shipped in the domestic market in the first half of 2026 support BeiDou positioning, and some cities have achieved 100% BeiDou use in shared bikes, taxis, official vehicles, and agricultural machinery.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: Integration and Upgrading Accelerate New-Type Industrialization
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on August 26, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period to accelerate advanced manufacturing, cultivate emerging pillar industries such as integrated circuits, aerospace and biomedicine, and promote future industries including quantum technology, brain-computer interfaces and embodied intelligence, while expanding "AI+", "Robot+" and "Industrial Internet+" applications and prioritizing 6G development.

title_en: Mudslide Disaster at Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet Causes Major Casualties and Missing Persons; All Parties Step Up Rescue Efforts
summary_en: A large-scale mudslide in Nepal's Rasuwa district on August 26 caused major casualties and missing persons at Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, cutting roads and burying buildings; the Armed Police Shigatse Detachment, China Anneng Group rescue teams, and Tibetan local forces are conducting search and rescue, while the Ministry of Emergency Management and other agencies have allocated central relief supplies and 120 million yuan in emergency disaster funds.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Symposium on Pilot Fiscal Science Management in Hefei, Anhui
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended a symposium on pilot fiscal science management and conducted research in Hefei, Anhui, from August 25 to 26, calling for improved fiscal work to support Chinese-style modernization. During his visit he also inspected the Feixi County Finance Bureau and the Center for AI for Science at the University of Science and Technology of China.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Concludes; Wang Huning Presides and Delivers Remarks
summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee concluded its 18th meeting in Beijing, with Wang Huning presiding and speaking on improving livelihoods and advancing common prosperity. The meeting approved personnel changes, including adding Fu Kui as a CPPCC National Committee member and removing Zhao Zongqi and Zhang Zhuohua from their posts and membership, and accepted Zhang Li's resignation.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Holds Plenary Session; Members Deliver Speeches on "Strengthening Efforts to Safeguard and Improve People's Livelihoods and Solidly Advancing Common Prosperity for All"; Wang Huning Attends
summary_en: The plenary session of the 18th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee was held on the morning of the 26th, where 14 standing committee members delivered speeches on safeguarding and improving people's livelihoods and advancing common prosperity for all. Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, attended, and Vice Chairman Yang Zhen presided over the meeting.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with Uzbek Presidential Administration Head Mirziyoyeva
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing on the morning of August 26 with Saida Mirziyoyeva, head of the Uzbek presidential administration, with both sides pledging to strengthen exchanges between their legislatures and deepen cooperation in the economy, transport, education and counterterrorism.

title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee 24th Session Holds Joint Group Meeting
summary_en: The 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee held a joint group meeting in Beijing on the afternoon of the 26th to review the State Council's report on consolidating and expanding poverty alleviation achievements and advancing rural revitalization, and to conduct special inquiries. Ten participants raised questions on topics including village collective economies, urban-rural resident pension insurance, medical insurance assistance policies, sustainable development of assistance industries, east-west cooperation, rural population aging, follow-up support for relocated residents, and agricultural policy insurance, with Vice Premier Liu Guozhong and officials from relevant departments attending to respond.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Discussion with NPC Deputies Attending Standing Committee Session
summary_en: Zhao Leji, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, met on the morning of the 26th with NPC deputies attending the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee, urging them to help consolidate and expand poverty alleviation gains and advance rural revitalization. The deputies spoke on the report reviewed at the session concerning work on consolidating poverty alleviation achievements and promoting comprehensive rural revitalization, and Li Hongzhong presided over the discussion.

title_en: Li Qiang conducts research in Heilongjiang and Jilin
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang visited Heilongjiang and Jilin from August 24 to 26, inspecting farmland, seed-industry and black-soil protection facilities, water conservancy projects, and agricultural cooperatives, and called for efforts to secure an autumn grain harvest, boost agricultural comprehensive production capacity, and ensure stable and safe supplies of grain and other key agricultural products.

title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 2026 SCO Summit and Pay State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: The Foreign Ministry announced on August 26 that President Xi Jinping will attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit in Bishkek from August 30 to September 3, and will pay state visits to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of President Sadyr Japarov and to Egypt at the invitation of President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Mudslide Disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, Stressing All-Out Search and Rescue of Missing Persons, Strengthening Investigation and Rectification of Various Risk Hazards, and Ensuring the Safety of People's Lives and Property; Li Qiang Issues Instructions
summary_en: A mudslide originating on the Nepalese side struck Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse City, Tibet, on August 26, causing heavy casualties and leaving people missing. Xi Jinping ordered all-out search and rescue of the missing, relocation of threatened residents, treatment of the injured, and strengthened monitoring and hazard inspection, while Premier Li Qiang issued instructions on rescue efforts and coordination with relevant countries through the Foreign Ministry; Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing was dispatched to the scene to guide the response.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports UN Secretary-General António Guterres urging cooperation to resolve shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, Houthi claims of attacks on a Saudi oil tanker and military targets, EU climate data showing a record global daily average sea surface temperature, and a tornado in southern France's Aude department that injured 41 people and damaged about 300 homes.

title_en: UK Prime Minister says he has approved sharing missile manufacturing technology with Ukraine; Russia says it will destroy related targets
summary_en: UK Prime Minister Burnham, visiting Ukraine, said he has approved sharing "Storm Shadow" cruise missile manufacturing technology with Ukraine so it can produce the missile independently, according to the report. Russian presidential press secretary Peskov called the move extremely negative and said Russian forces are gathering information to locate and destroy missile production sites in Ukraine.

title_en: US Threatens to Further Raise Tariffs on Canada; Canada Says It Will Not Accept an Unequal Bilateral Relationship
summary_en: US President Donald Trump said on social media on the 24th that the US will raise import tariffs to 50% on Canadian automobiles, auto parts, steel and other products starting January 1, 2027, accusing Canada of having "taken advantage" of the US in trade for years. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded the same day that Canada will return to the negotiating table only if the US changes its attitude and builds a genuine partnership, saying he does not accept the view that "Canada is a subordinate of the US" or an unequal position for Canada in its relationship with the US, while Ontario Premier Doug Ford said Canada needs to use "every means available" to fight back and should be prepared to cut off electricity and critical mineral supplies to the US if the dispute escalates.

title_en: US Announces New Round of Sanctions on Iran; Iran Says US Will Fail Again
summary_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent announced on the 24th a new round of "economic isolation" sanctions expanding to five sectors—aviation, digital assets, gold, shipping, and technology—aimed at cutting off every economic lifeline of the Iranian government. Iranian Supreme Leader adviser Mokhber said Iran's response would be more resolute than ever, and Economy and Finance Minister Madanizadeh said Iran is fully prepared and the US will fail again.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that over 2,800 pocket parks broke ground nationwide in the first half of the year, China's EV charging infrastructure reached over 23.68 million units by end-July, and a personal medical insurance cloud will be built during the 15th Five-Year Plan period; it also covers National Disability Prevention Day activities, outcomes of the 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting, the 29th rotation of PLA Hong Kong Garrison units, the third batch of the Young Lawyers Western Training Program, Beijing port's 15 million inbound and outbound trips this year, the opening of the Jinan Huanggang Road Yellow River Tunnel, and heavy rain forecasts as Typhoon Zitan approaches.

title_en: First Batch of National Parks Achieve Dual Improvements in Ecosystem Quality and Flagship Species Populations
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that China's first five national parks have seen improvements in ecosystem quality alongside growth in flagship species populations, with Tibetan antelope exceeding 70,000, wild Siberian tigers rising from 27 to 72, and wild Amur leopards from 42 to 115, while new species have been discovered in Wuyishan. The segment also describes efforts in Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, where staff built 38 aerial rope corridors to reconnect fragmented gibbon habitats.

title_en: 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade to be held in Xiamen from September 8 to 11
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on August 25, at which the Ministry of Commerce announced that the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade will take place in Xiamen, Fujian, from September 8 to 11, with preparations essentially complete. Delegations from 123 countries and regions have registered to attend, 60 countries and regions will set up exhibitions, and Finland and Saudi Arabia will serve as guest countries of honor; the fair will feature three main sections on "Invest in China," "China Investment," and "International Investment," along with a series of forums and reports.

title_en: China Accelerates Opening and Sharing of Public Data to Empower Industries
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China has stepped up efforts this year to open and share public data, including piloting six categories of new data-security technologies and launching 150 public data application scenarios covering meteorology, transport and healthcare. It adds that the national integrated government data-sharing hub has supported over 550 billion data calls, helping break down cross-departmental "data silos."

title_en: Major Transport Indicators Maintain Growth in First Seven Months of the Year
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's transport sector ran steadily in the first seven months of the year, with cross-regional passenger trips reaching 39.79 billion (up 0.8% year-on-year) and commercial freight volume totaling 32.97 billion tons (up 2.8%). Port cargo throughput rose 1.3% to 10.56 billion tons, with foreign trade throughput up 3.6%, while fixed-asset investment in transport reached 1.8152 trillion yuan, including projects such as the Three Gorges new waterway, the Xinjiang Duku Expressway, and the Dalian Jinzhou Bay international airport transport hub.

title_en: National Summer Grain Purchases Reach Peak; Cumulative Purchases Exceed 90 Million Tons
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's summer grain purchasing has entered its peak period, with various grain operators having purchased over 90 million tons of wheat and the market running basically stable. The segment highlights 24-hour drying operations at a grain depot in Tai'an, Shandong, to address high moisture in newly harvested wheat, and notes that the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration is using the minimum purchase price system to support the market and ensure farmers can sell their grain.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets India's National Security Adviser and Special Representative on the China-India Boundary Question Doval
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing on the 25th with India's National Security Adviser and Special Representative on the China-India Boundary Question, Ajit Doval. Han said the two countries should approach relations from a strategic and long-term perspective and implement the important consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while Doval said India is willing to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation with China and properly handle the boundary issue.

title_en: 18th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee Opens; Wang Huning Attends
summary_en: The 18th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) National Committee opened in Beijing on the morning of the 25th, with Politburo Standing Committee member and CPPCC National Committee Chairman Wang Huning attending; the session focused on strengthening efforts to safeguard and improve people's livelihoods and steadily advancing common prosperity for all. Politburo member and Vice Premier He Lifeng delivered a report on implementing the relevant directives and the 15th Five-Year Plan, while Politburo member and CPPCC Vice Chairman Shi Taifeng presided over the opening, which also heard a report on the CPPCC's work in the first half of 2026.

title_en: 24th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee Held in Beijing, Chaired by Zhao Leji
summary_en: The 14th NPC Standing Committee opened its 24th session in Beijing on the morning of the 25th, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji, hearing reports on draft laws including medical insurance, farmland protection, agriculture, national defense mobilization, lawyers, enterprise bankruptcy, banking supervision, and water resources, as well as State Council bills on road traffic safety and an extradition treaty with Hungary, and reports on plan and budget execution and government debt management.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Strive to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the station aired a CCTV Quick Commentary titled "Strive to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History."

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Delivering Achievements for the People Through Solid Work
summary_en: The segment reports on a nationwide Party education campaign to instill a correct view of political achievements, launched at the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan period under Xi Jinping's guidance, urging officials to pursue results that stand the test of practice, the people and history. It cites local cases such as Dongshan County in Fujian, where former county Party secretary Gu Wenchang's sand-control and seawall work is held up as a model, and efforts in Guizhou, Jiangsu, Jilin and Qinghai to resolve long-standing problems and improve residents' livelihoods.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: A Canadian poll by the Angus Reid Institute found 76% of respondents support the government withdrawing from Canada-US trade talks, while the EU urged Israel to cancel tenders and halt construction of the E1 settlement in the West Bank, warning it undermines the two-state solution and reportedly preparing sanctions over the plan.

title_en: Iran Issues New Regulations on Strait of Hormuz Passage
summary_en: Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority announced new rules on August 23 stating that vessels violating Iran's navigation regulations in the Strait of Hormuz will face fines, seizure, or confiscation, and that shipowners must check a list of "violating vessels" before chartering. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said Iran has not yet received a formal invitation to join the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan on August 7, though it has raised regional security proposals in discussions with member states; Pakistani Army Chief of Staff Asim Munir also visited Iran with a delegation on August 24.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will launch a special campaign using medical insurance to support primary-level healthcare, including lump-sum payments to qualified county-level medical communities and bringing over 98% of village clinics under designated medical insurance management; that the Cyberspace Administration of China has handled more than 7,200 non-compliant group livestream rooms and punished over 2,200 accounts since launching a July campaign against disorder in online entertainment group livestreaming; and that the 21st China Changchun Film Festival opened on the evening of August 23, with 16 films shortlisted for the Golden Deer Awards across 10 categories and nearly 500 screenings planned over six days.

title_en: Comrade Chen Wu passes away
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that Comrade Chen Wu, an outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, a loyal communist fighter, an outstanding leader on China's ethnic affairs and economic development fronts, and Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, died of illness in Beijing at 15:05 on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on August 24, featuring five outstanding representatives from the emergency management system who discussed their work on risk prevention, emergency response, and protecting people's lives and property.

title_en: Typhoons Bring Heavy Rain to Southeast Coast; Multiple Regions Respond Actively
summary_en: Typhoons Shadel, Zitan, and Jianlawi brought sustained heavy rainfall to China's southeast coast, prompting the China Meteorological Administration to raise its emergency response to Level III as Typhoon Jianlawi made landfall in Fujian's Quanzhou; the National Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Committee and the Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level IV national disaster relief response, and the National Development and Reform Commission allocated 50 million yuan in central budget investment to support post-disaster recovery in Guangxi.

title_en: China Accelerates Formation of Full-Chain Science and Technology Service System
summary_en: The segment reports that China is building a full-chain service system for commercializing scientific and technological achievements, including two new national manufacturing innovation centers (bringing the total to 32), a pilot-testing network of 21 national-level manufacturing pilot platforms plus over 1,800 reserve platforms, and the first batch of 14 excellence-level and 402 standard-level science and technology enterprise incubators. It also notes efforts to build a unified national technology trading service platform and, in Shandong, a technology market using large-model technology for intelligent matching.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets Kuwaiti Foreign Minister
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng met with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Jarrah in Beijing on the 24th, with Han noting the 55th anniversary of China-Kuwait diplomatic relations and calling for deeper strategic partnership, while Jarrah affirmed Kuwait's adherence to the one-China principle and thanked China for its support.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets US Representatives of the Third China-US 1.5-Track Dialogue
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, met in Beijing on the 24th with US representatives attending the third China-US 1.5-track dialogue. Wang said China is willing to work with the US to implement the important consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump, respect each other's core interests, and build a constructive strategic stability relationship.

title_en: Wang Huning chairs CPPCC Chairpersons' Council meeting
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), chaired the 54th Chairpersons' Council meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee in Beijing, which conveyed and studied recent important speeches and instructions from Xi Jinping and reviewed a report on the CPPCC's work in the first half of 2026. The meeting also approved a decision to strip Gu Xueming, Hao Rong, Xin Bao'an and Li Heyue of their status as members of the 14th CPPCC National Committee, pending confirmation by the 18th Standing Committee meeting.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 24th with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China; Li said China is willing to work with Jordan on high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and cooperation in trade, green development, digital and cultural fields, and to make unremitting efforts to de-escalate the situation in the Middle East, while King Abdullah II said Jordan firmly adheres to the one-China policy and hopes to advance Jordan-China and Arab-China relations.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Alamgir on Assuming Office as President of Bangladesh
summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Alamgir congratulating him on assuming the presidency of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, noting the two countries' traditional friendship and 51 years of diplomatic ties and expressing willingness to work with President Alamgir to deepen Belt and Road cooperation and build a China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions, Stressing Consolidation and Expansion of Achievements in Education on Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Performance, Striving to Create Achievements That Withstand the Test of Practice, the People, and History; Cai Qi Chairs Meeting of the Central Party Building Work Leading Group and Delivers Remarks; Li Xi Attends and Delivers Remarks
summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions calling for sustained efforts to consolidate the achievements of the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political performance, and the Central Party Building Work Leading Group met on the 24th, chaired by Cai Qi with Li Xi attending, to review the campaign and plan a long-term mechanism for upholding a correct view of political performance.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan
summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks in Beijing with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who was on a state visit to China; the two leaders discussed deepening the China-Jordan strategic partnership and exchanged views on the Middle East situation, after which they witnessed the signing of cooperation documents and issued a joint statement on deepening the strategic partnership.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome King of Jordan on Visit to China
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 24th for King Abdullah II bin Al-Hussein of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China. The ceremony included a 21-gun salute, the playing of both national anthems, and a review of the PLA honor guard, with Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other officials in attendance.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: End of Heat
summary_en: The segment explains the traditional Chinese solar term End of Heat (Chushu), the second term of autumn, describing the seasonal shift as summer heat recedes, crops ripen toward harvest, and coastal fishermen begin the fishing season, while noting the cultural significance of the term and the modern "big food concept" (da shiwu guan).

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the inauguration of Tanzania's Julius Nyerere Hydropower Project, built with Chinese participation and attended by President Samia Suluhu Hassan; Syria's condemnation of an Israeli drone strike near Damascus; a U.S. federal judge's ruling striking down the suspension of immigrant visas for applicants from 75 countries; and a magnitude-5.8 earthquake in Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan, that injured at least 37 people.

title_en: Canada Announces Equal Counter-Tariffs on US to Take Effect September 8
summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on the 22nd that Canada's equal retaliatory tariffs, covering dairy, steel, home appliances, pulp and paper, and electronics, will take effect on September 8 in response to the US imposing 50% tariffs on $20 billion of Canadian goods. Carney said the US raised new demands at the last minute of negotiations that lacked economic rationale and were unfair to Canada, and several Canadian provincial premiers expressed support for the federal government's decision.

title_en: Iran says countries participating in US 'economic war' on Iran will be considered enemies
summary_en: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Rezaei warned neighboring countries and other nations against joining the US 'economic war' on Iran, saying they would be treated as enemies and that 'not a drop of oil' would flow from the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz; Parliament Speaker Qalibaf also accused the US of bullying on behalf of Israel. Separately, Iranian armed forces General Staff commander Bagherzadeh said three Iranian pilots detained by Qatar are in poor health and called for their return to Iran.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
