summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 24, an official from the Ministry of Culture and Tourism outlined plans for high-quality development of culture and tourism during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, focusing on five areas including artistic creation, cultural heritage protection, public services, industry development, and exchanges and cooperation, with four priorities: deepening integration of culture and tourism, improving people's quality of life, advancing digital and intelligent transformation, and empowering economic and social development.

title_en: Wang Huning Chairs CPPCC Chairpersons' Meeting
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), chaired the 56th Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee in Beijing, which conveyed and studied recent important speeches and instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping and decided to convene the 19th meeting of the CPPCC National Committee Standing Committee in early November in Beijing.

title_en: 7th National Ethnic Minority Arts Festival Closes in Beijing; Wang Huning Attends Closing Ceremony
summary_en: The 7th National Ethnic Minority Arts Festival concluded at the Beijing Ethnic Theater on the evening of the 23rd after more than a month, with Politburo Standing Committee member and CPPCC Chairman Wang Huning attending the closing gala. The festival, co-hosted by the National Ethnic Affairs Commission, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the National Radio and Television Administration, China Media Group, and the Beijing Municipal Government, featured 48 outstanding productions in 114 performances across 14 Beijing theaters from August 18 to September 23, drawing about 180,000 attendees online and offline.

title_en: Zhao Leji conducts research in Jilin and Heilongjiang
summary_en: Zhao Leji, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, conducted research in Jilin and Heilongjiang from September 21 to 24, emphasizing the need to practice whole-process people's democracy and improve local people's congress work. He visited Siping, Changchun, Harbin, and Qiqihar, where he inspected legislative and budget supervision work and county- and township-level people's congress election preparations.

title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Revised Regulations on Implementation of the Audit Law of the People's Republic of China
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the revised Regulations on the Implementation of the Audit Law of the People's Republic of China, effective December 1, 2026. The revisions strengthen Party leadership over audit work, refine the scope of audit supervision, improve audit procedures including a registration and reporting system for attempts to probe or interfere with audit matters, and tighten accountability for audit rectification.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Malaysian Prime Minister
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met with Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim in Hangzhou on the 24th, where Li cited Xi Jinping's April state visit to Malaysia as opening a new "golden 50 years" of China-Malaysia relations and called for deeper Belt and Road cooperation and coordination on major issues, while Anwar reaffirmed Malaysia's one-China policy and commitment to practical cooperation with China.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets Kyrgyz Prime Minister
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met with Kyrgyz Prime Minister Akylbek Kasymaliyev in Hangzhou on the 23rd, calling for deeper Belt and Road cooperation and closer coordination within the SCO and China-Central Asia mechanisms; Kasymaliyev reaffirmed Kyrgyzstan's adherence to the one-China principle.

title_en: Li Qiang attends and addresses the launch ceremony of the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended the launch ceremony of the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou on the 24th and delivered remarks, outlining China's views on trends in digital trade, open cooperation on global trade in the digital era, and China's contributions to global digital trade. Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar and Kyrgyz Prime Minister Kasymaliev attended the ceremony along with more than 1,200 representatives from nearly 50 countries and regions and relevant international organizations, and Li Qiang toured the exhibition with the foreign leaders before the ceremony.

title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington for State Visit to the United States
summary_en: President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington on September 23 for a state visit at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, who welcomed him at Andrews Air Force Base with a ceremony including a 21-gun salute and a military flyover. In a written statement, Xi said China and the U.S. should be partners rather than rivals and called for building a constructive, strategically stable relationship.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: Autumn Equinox
summary_en: The segment marks the Autumn Equinox, the fourth solar term of autumn, which coincides with China's Farmers' Harvest Festival, describing seasonal customs such as eating autumn vegetables and the simultaneous harvesting of autumn grain and sowing of winter wheat.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The 81st UN General Assembly General Debate opened in New York under the theme of rebuilding trust and managing change, with UN Secretary-General António Guterres warning of multiple global challenges. The segment also reports that US President Donald Trump said US and Iranian officials held three hours of talks in New York, after which Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmail Baghaei said Tehran conveyed conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz through Qatari mediation, and that the OECD raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 2.9%.

title_en: International community hopes President Xi's US visit benefits both countries and the world
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the international community is closely watching President Xi Jinping's upcoming state visit to the United States, with US and international figures expressing hope that the Xi-Trump summit will boost mutual trust, expand converging interests, and advance cooperation and global prosperity.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that panda bond issuance exceeded 213.98 billion yuan in the first eight months of the year, China's agricultural exports rose 4.2% year-on-year to 492.03 billion yuan over the same period and have grown for five consecutive years, and the top 500 private enterprises posted combined 2025 revenue of 44.93 trillion yuan, up 4.35%. It also covers consumer tips for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, the start of holiday rail transport with an expected 284 million passenger trips, the fifth Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou, a rural tourism promotion event in Huzhou, and the broadcast of the 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival gala.

title_en: Leadership changes at the top of three provincial party committees including Anhui
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee announced personnel changes: Li Lecheng becomes Anhui provincial party secretary, replacing Liang Yanshun; Zhou Zuyi becomes Henan provincial party secretary, leaving his Fujian post, and replaces Liu Ning; and Zhao Long becomes Fujian provincial party secretary.

title_en: [20th Asian Games] China's Sports Delegation Wins Multiple Team Gold Medals
summary_en: China won team golds in women's 10m air pistol and women's skeet shooting, the men's gymnastics team title (its 13th Asian Games men's team gymnastics championship), and additional golds in athletics, wushu, equestrian and swimming, while the women's volleyball team beat Japan 3-0 to claim its 10th Asian Games women's volleyball title.

title_en: CCDI and National Supervisory Commission Publicly Reports Six Typical Cases Violating the Spirit of the Central Eight-Point Regulation
summary_en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission publicly reported six typical cases of violations of the spirit of the Central Eight-Point Regulation, involving officials including Pan Liang, former vice-ministerial-level cadre at the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission; Huang Guilin, former vice governor of Qiannan Prefecture, Guizhou, and former party secretary of Fuquan; Sun Xinchun, former deputy party secretary and deputy director of the Xinjiang Geological Bureau; Zhang Weixing, former party secretary and director of the Huozhou People's Congress Standing Committee and former party secretary and director of the Huozhou Economic and Technological Development Zone; Yu Junfeng, party group member and deputy county head of Menghai County, Xishuangbanna Prefecture, Yunnan; and Li Gen, deputy general manager of the audit department and director of the audit center at Ansteel Group. The violations included improper dining and banquets, accepting gifts and cash, accepting travel and entertainment arrangements that could affect the impartial performance of official duties, and pursuing "image projects" driven by a distorted view of political achievements or failing to perform duties, and the individuals were dealt with severely.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists today (September 23), at which five grassroots frontline representatives from the energy sector shared their personal experiences and stories of overcoming difficulties and pursuing independent innovation in their respective fields under the theme of 'promoting energy supply security and green transition,' vividly demonstrating the sense of mission of energy workers in the new era to safeguard energy security, advance green and low-carbon transition, and build an energy powerhouse.

title_en: Industrial Economy Grows Steadily in First Eight Months; New Quality Productive Forces Cultivated at a Faster Pace
summary_en: Citing the latest invoice data from the State Taxation Administration, CCTV reports that nationwide industrial sales revenue rose 7.3% year-on-year in the first eight months of the year, with equipment manufacturing up 10.1%, while high-tech industry sales revenue grew 15.7%, including 67.7% growth for AI-related integrated circuits and 38.8% for smart in-vehicle equipment.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Strengthening Inclusive, Basic, and Safety-Net Livelihood Development
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 23, a Ministry of Civil Affairs official outlined high-quality civil affairs development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including expanding basic elderly care services, improving the three-tier urban-rural elderly care network, deepening marriage custom reform, strengthening the public-interest nature of the funeral industry, and expanding charity. The plan emphasizes inclusive, basic, and safety-net livelihood construction.

title_en: "15th Five-Year Plan" Off to a Good Start: Anchoring the Blueprint to Accelerate Building a Strong Education Nation
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 23, an Education Ministry official outlined implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan for education, noting China has built the world's largest and quality education system with 270 million people having received higher education. The official said the 15th Five-Year Plan period will focus on six areas, including moral education, strengthening basic education, expanding and improving higher education, developing modern vocational education, cultivating high-level teachers, and deepening reform and opening up.

title_en: Li Qiang attends and addresses opening ceremony of 2026 World Skills Conference
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Skills Conference in Shanghai on the 23rd and delivered remarks, reading out Xi Jinping's message to the 48th WorldSkills Competition and outlining China's commitment to skills development and global skills cooperation. Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and WorldSkills President Uhan also attended, along with about 1,900 representatives from around the world.

title_en: 48th WorldSkills Competition opens grandly in Shanghai; Li Qiang attends and declares it open
summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition opened in Shanghai on the evening of the 22nd, with Premier Li Qiang attending and declaring the event open after a congratulatory letter from President Xi Jinping was read out; Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim also attended the ceremony.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: The Confidence Behind a Bountiful Harvest
summary_en: On the occasion of the ninth Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping sent festive greetings to farmers nationwide and called for solid progress in all-around rural revitalization; the 2026 national main event was held in Dongjiao Village, Zaoyang, Xiangyang, Hubei, as autumn grain crops enter maturity and grain output has held above 1.4 trillion jin for two consecutive years.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Encourage and Guide More Workers, Especially Young People, to Pursue the Path of Success Through Skills
summary_en: CCTV aired a quick comment on September 23 encouraging and guiding more workers, especially young people, to achieve success through developing their skills.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition, which opened in Shanghai on September 22 under the theme "Skills Change the World, Skills Light the Future," stating that China will use hosting the event to encourage more workers, especially young people, to pursue careers through skills and is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation to advance the global skills movement.

title_en: Xi Jinping departs Beijing for state visit to the United States
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 23, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for a state visit to the United States at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump. Accompanying Xi were his wife Peng Liyuan, Politburo Standing Committee member and General Office director Cai Qi, and Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Ukrainian President Zelensky said Russian forces launched a new wave of airstrikes on critical infrastructure in 10 Ukrainian regions, while Russia's Defense Ministry reported capturing two more settlements in the Kharkiv region; separately, UK Prime Minister Burnham said Britain agreed to provide aerial refueling for Saudi aircraft on defensive missions against Houthi attacks.

title_en: International figures look forward to President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States
summary_en: International figures are closely following President Xi Jinping's upcoming state visit to the United States and hope the two countries' relationship will develop healthily, steadily and sustainably under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state. The segment also reports that Xi replied to letters from American university students who took part in China-US youth exchange activities, and that American and other international figures said head-of-state diplomacy plays an irreplaceable strategic guiding role in US-China relations.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 200 million yuan in disaster relief funds to Sichuan, Hainan, Zhejiang and Fujian; the Ministry of Culture and Tourism issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for intangible cultural heritage protection and inheritance; 165 new national food safety standards were released since last year; the 2026 National Day culture and tourism consumption month launched; a data resource development initiative will be carried out in 10 industries; and the Ningbo-Xiangshan intercity railway in Zhejiang opened.

title_en: Leadership Changes Announced for Party Committees in Tibet and Two Other Provinces/Regions
summary_en: The CPC Central Committee announced adjustments to the top party posts in Tibet, Gansu and Qinghai: Hu Changsheng becomes Tibet Autonomous Region party secretary, replacing Wang Junzheng; Wu Xiaojun becomes Gansu provincial party secretary, replacing Hu Changsheng; and Luo Dongchuan becomes Qinghai provincial party secretary, replacing Wu Xiaojun.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China Team in Full Action, Shooting Team Breaks World Record Again
summary_en: On the third day of competition at the 20th Asian Games, China's Sheng Lihao and Wang Zifei won the 10m air rifle mixed team event with 507.1 points, setting a world record, while Guo Li won the women's road cycling race, Zhang Yaling and Li Jianming took wushu all-around titles, and the swimming team added several golds including Peng Xuwei's women's 200m backstroke in an Asian-record 2:05.77 and the men's 4x100m medley relay.

title_en: 36 Projects Promoted to Private Enterprises Are Being Advanced in an Orderly Manner
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission said at a September 22 press conference that it has recently promoted 36 projects in the transportation and logistics sectors to private enterprises, aiming to bring in 15.6 billion yuan of private capital, and that these projects are being advanced in an orderly manner. It added that private capital's scope for participating in major projects continues to widen, citing over 10.8 billion yuan of private investment attracted to water network construction in the first half of the year, up 85.8 percent year on year, and private capital accounting for half of approved green power direct-connection projects.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Gets Underway Across China
summary_en: The segment reports that the autumn grain harvest is beginning across China, with farmers in the southwest, northeast, and Huang-Huai-Hai regions using small machinery for hilly terrain, draining flooded fields in Jilin and Heilongjiang, and rushing to harvest and dry corn in Henan and Shandong during a window of clear weather.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Safe, Efficient and Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 22, officials from the Ministry of Natural Resources and the National Forestry and Grassland Administration outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including implementing the main functional zones strategy through four-level territorial spatial planning, completing the integration and optimization of protected natural areas, advancing the "Three-North" shelterbelt program and the "Mountains, Rivers, Forests, Farmlands, Lakes, Grasslands and Deserts" ecological project, and strengthening farmland protection and geological disaster monitoring.

title_en: 2026 Beijing Culture Forum Opens
summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Culture Forum opened in Beijing on the 22nd under the theme "Cultural Heritage and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations," co-hosted by the Central Propaganda Department and the Beijing Municipal Party Committee and Municipal Government. Chinese and foreign guests said cultural heritage is the common wealth of all humanity and called for strengthened international cooperation and global governance in cultural heritage protection.

title_en: Han Zheng to Attend General Debate of 81st UN General Assembly
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Vice President Han Zheng will travel to New York from September 24 to 26 to attend the general debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly. During the visit, he will also attend a high-level dialogue hosted by China marking the 5th anniversary of the Global Development Initiative, and meet with the UN Secretary-General, the President of the 81st UN General Assembly session, and leaders of relevant countries.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets Cambodian King and Queen Mother
summary_en: On September 22, Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing with Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Queen Mother Norodom Monineath Sihanouk, conveying greetings from Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan and praising the China-Cambodia friendship; the Cambodian side reaffirmed its one-China policy.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with First Deputy Prime Minister of Kazakhstan
summary_en: On the afternoon of the 22nd, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met in Beijing with First Deputy Prime Minister Roman Sklyar of Kazakhstan. The two sides discussed implementing the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, with a focus on trade and investment, artificial intelligence, and green minerals.

title_en: Opening Ceremony of "The Great Expedition — Exhibition Marking the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March" Held in Beijing; Cai Qi Attends and Delivers Speech
summary_en: The opening ceremony of a themed exhibition marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March was held at the Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution in Beijing on the morning of the 22nd, where Politburo Standing Committee member and Secretariat member Cai Qi delivered a speech and declared the exhibition open. Cai Qi and other officials toured the exhibition with representatives from various sectors of society.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with WorldSkills President and CEO
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Shanghai with WorldSkills President Uhan and CEO Hoy, saying China is confident of hosting an excellent 48th WorldSkills Competition and hopes to deepen cooperation on global skills development. Uhan and Hoy praised China's skills development and expressed confidence China will present an unprecedented WorldSkills Competition.

title_en: Li Qiang conducts research in Shanghai
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, conducted a research visit in Shanghai on September 22, stressing deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation and the development of advanced manufacturing, including AI-enabled manufacturing and future industries. Chen Jining and Wu Zhenglong accompanied him on the visit.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Upholding Prevention First to Safeguard Public Health
summary_en: The segment reports on China's shift from a treatment-centered to a people's-health-centered approach, highlighting Xi Jinping's emphasis on prevention as the most cost-effective health strategy, and details Gansu's screening drive for chronic diseases and high-incidence cancers, expanded national immunization including HPV vaccination for over 5.2 million 13-year-old girls, and a multi-department action on children's and adolescents' health.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Striving to Make the Lives of the Broad Masses of Farmers Happier and Better
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the station aired a CCTV Quick Commentary on September 22 titled "Striving to Make the Lives of the Broad Masses of Farmers Happier and Better."

title_en: On the Eve of the Ninth 'Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival,' Xi Jinping Extends Festive Greetings and Sincere Wishes to Farmers Nationwide and Comrades on the 'Three Rural' Front, Stressing Solid Progress in Comprehensive Rural Revitalization and Efforts to Make Farmers' Lives Happier and Better
summary_en: On the occasion of the ninth Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, State President, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, extended festive greetings on behalf of the Party Central Committee to farmers nationwide and comrades working on agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. He noted that this year's summer grain output hit a new high, early rice output remained stable, and an autumn grain harvest is in sight, and he urged Party committees and governments at all levels to advance comprehensive rural revitalization and raise farmers' incomes.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. President Donald Trump said the Houthis agreed not to fight the United States, that Germany's CDU party led by Chancellor Merz suffered defeats in Berlin and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state elections, that Typhoon Dujuan disrupted flights in Japan, and that wildfires spread in Colombia's Boyacá department.

title_en: Preliminary Results of Russian State Duma Elections Announced: Ruling Party United Russia Wins Over Half the Vote
summary_en: Russia's Central Election Commission Chair Ella Pamfilova said that, based on preliminary counts of over 95% of ballots, the ruling United Russia party led with 57.83% of the vote and won 355 of the Duma's 450 seats, remaining the largest party in parliament. Russia's Defense Ministry said Ukraine launched large-scale drone and missile attacks on September 19-20 to interfere with the elections, and that Russia would intensify strikes on military targets in Kyiv.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for the public cultural service system, a Supreme People's Court judicial interpretation on civil-criminal crossover cases, a five-department crackdown on falsified ecological monitoring data, mooncake spot checks with a 97.67% pass rate, the close of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo in Nanning, outcomes from the 8th APEC Human Resources Development Ministerial Meeting, the opening in Wuhan of 2026 International Day of Peace commemorations, and CCTV's new lineup of agriculture, rural affairs and farmers programming.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China Wins 12 Gold Medals in a Single Day
summary_en: On the second day of competition at the 20th Asian Games, Chinese athletes won gold in shooting, triathlon, wushu, gymnastics, swimming, and karate, including a men's 10m air rifle team gold that broke the world record and a men's 4x200m freestyle relay gold won by overtaking Japan in the final 50 meters.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference in Beijing on September 21 titled 'Strivers on the New Journey,' at which four representatives from the space sector met with Chinese and foreign journalists under the theme 'Advancing the New Long March of Space Exploration in the New Era.' They shared personal experiences in overcoming difficulties and pursuing independent innovation in launch vehicle development, the crewed space program, launch mission support, and space application science, and recounted stories of successive generations of space workers tackling key problems and scaling technological heights.

title_en: China Adds Over 2,500 Kilometers of New Main Oil and Gas Pipelines This Year
summary_en: The segment reports that China has built more than 2,500 kilometers of new trunk oil and gas pipelines this year, bringing the total to 112,900 kilometers across 30 provincial-level regions and Hong Kong, while branch lines extend gas supply to counties such as Liancheng in Fujian and Changshun in Guizhou; under the plan, China aims to add 20,000 kilometers of long-distance oil and gas pipelines by 2030 for a total of 220,000 kilometers.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: China Accelerates Building a Modern Grain Circulation System
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 21, an official from the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration briefed on safeguarding national food security, noting that China's intact standard grain warehouse capacity has reached 730 million tons and that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will boost grain depot safety warning and proactive prevention capabilities, advance "AI plus grain reserves," and promote green grain storage technologies. The segment also reported that China has 24,000 grain processing enterprises with sufficient capacity to meet national consumption needs, and that China will deepen implementation of the national food security strategy and accelerate building a modern grain circulation system befitting its status as a major country.

title_en: Forging a Strong Community: One Chinese Family
summary_en: CCTV reported the launch on September 21 of the 2026 Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week, the first since the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law took effect on July 1, featuring representatives of 56 ethnic groups in Beijing and nationwide education activities on forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation. The segment also highlighted development gains in ethnic regions, noting that the combined GDP of the five autonomous regions rose from 6.01 trillion yuan in 2020 to 8.66 trillion yuan in 2025, with per capita disposable income up 34.9%.

title_en: Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli Expelled from Party and Military for Serious Disciplinary and Legal Violations
summary_en: The Central Military Commission's discipline inspection and supervision bodies investigated Politburo member and CMC Vice Chairman Zhang Youxia and former CMC Joint Staff Department Chief of Staff Liu Zhenli for serious violations of political, organizational, integrity, work, and lifestyle discipline, including factionalism, accepting huge sums and gifts, and suspected serious duty-related crimes. A Politburo meeting approved their expulsion from the Party, termination of their 20th Party Congress delegate status, and referral of the suspected criminal case to military prosecutors, following the CMC's earlier decision to expel them from the military.

title_en: China-US Economic and Trade Consultations Held in New York
summary_en: On September 20 local time, He Lifeng, China's lead person for China-US economic and trade affairs and Vice Premier of the State Council, held economic and trade consultations in New York with US Treasury Secretary Bessent and US Trade Representative Greer. The two sides held candid, in-depth and constructive exchanges on implementing previous consultation consensus and promoting bilateral trade and investment, and held a dialogue on issues related to artificial intelligence.

title_en: Han Zheng Meets Speaker of Australia's House of Representatives
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing with Dick, Speaker of Australia's House of Representatives, with Han citing Xi Jinping's July meeting with Prime Minister Albanese as guiding bilateral relations and Dick affirming Australia's commitment to the one-China policy.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Visiting Beijing Delegation of Hong Kong and Macao Youth Flag-Raising Teams from the 'Salute the National Flag' Program
summary_en: On the morning of the 21st, Ding Xuexiang, Standing Committee member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Vice Premier of the State Council, met at the Great Hall of the People with a Beijing delegation of representatives from Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-raising teams under the 'Salute the National Flag' program and posed for a group photo. Ding conveyed greetings from Xi Jinping and urged the students to understand, protect, and bring honor to the national flag and to serve as builders and successors of the 'one country, two systems' cause; Xia Baolong also attended, and nearly 1,200 representatives of Hong Kong and Macao primary, secondary, and university flag-raising teams took part in the delegation.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets with Muzani, Speaker of Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), met in Beijing on the 21st with Muzani, Speaker of Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly. The two sides discussed implementing the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Prabowo Subianto, deepening strategic cooperation, and strengthening exchanges between the CPPCC and Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly.

title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letters from Young Students at 10 U.S. Universities
summary_en: President Xi Jinping replied to a letter from young students at 10 U.S. universities, including Harvard, who visited China for Sino-U.S. youth exchange activities such as the "2026 China-U.S. Youth Asia-Pacific Journey of Shared Hearts." Xi praised their interest in Chinese civilization and encouraged them to serve as messengers of friendship and carry forward friendly China-U.S. cooperation.

title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to the United States
summary_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25.

title_en: CPC Politburo Holds Meeting to Discuss Documents to Be Submitted to the 20th Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session; Xi Jinping Presides
summary_en: The CPC Politburo met on September 21, chaired by General Secretary Xi Jinping, to review a draft decision on persistently advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance and to hear a report on soliciting opinions on the draft. The meeting decided that the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee will be held in Beijing from October 26 to 29.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Iran has conveyed seven conditions for opening negotiations to the United States through Qatari mediation, that Russia claims control of several settlements in Donetsk and Kharkiv while Ukraine's President Zelensky approved new long-range operations, and that about 10,000 illegal migrants remain stranded in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi forces claim attacks on targets in Saudi capital and Yanbu; Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted Houthi missile
summary_en: Explosions were heard twice in Riyadh on the 19th and smoke rose near King Khalid International Airport; the Houthis said they struck "sensitive targets" in Riyadh and Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu with missiles and drones in response to Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, while the Saudi-led coalition said Saudi air defenses intercepted a Houthi missile fired at Riyadh. On September 20, U.S. embassies in Saudi Arabia, Oman, the UAE and other countries issued security alerts warning of a possible rapid escalation in the Houthi-Saudi conflict and advising U.S. citizens in the Middle East to remain highly vigilant.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's total electricity consumption exceeded one trillion kWh in August, postal and express delivery volumes grew in the first eight months, national railway freight reached 269 million tons from January to August, and the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention opened in Hefei, alongside a satellite launch, a graduate recruitment campaign, the World Mayors Dialogue in Wuhan, and the opening of the 13th Silk Road International Film Festival in Xi'an.

title_en: 20th Asian Games: China Wins Multiple Golds on First Day of Competition
summary_en: On the first competition day after the opening of the 20th Asian Games, China won gold medals in modern pentathlon, women's 10m air rifle team (setting a world record), triathlon, wushu, and multiple swimming events, including a women's 4×100m freestyle relay gold.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on September 20, at which five representatives from the court system discussed their work in civil trials, juvenile trials, intellectual property trials, environmental and resource trials, and enforcement under the theme of making fairness and justice tangible and giving the public a fuller sense of gain.

title_en: Ningxia Expands Wine Industry by Improving Quality and Opening Markets
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Ningxia has combined desertification control with wine-industry development, turning over 400,000 mu of barren land into vineyards and building a 195-kilometer wine-grape planting corridor; by 2025 the region's base covers 607,000 mu, about 40% of the national total, with annual output of 140 million bottles, and its wines are now exported to more than 40 countries and regions.

title_en: News Feature: New Development Opportunities Open New Space for Cooperation
summary_en: The segment reports on the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo, noting that China's vast market and ongoing development are creating cooperation opportunities for ASEAN countries; Timor-Leste, newly admitted to ASEAN, participated as a co-organizer for the first time and saw better-than-expected results, while the full opening of the Pinglu Canal shortens transport distances and lowers logistics costs between southwest China and ASEAN, and the signed Version 3.0 upgrade protocol extends China-ASEAN Free Trade Area cooperation into digital and green economy sectors.

title_en: Actual Use of Foreign Investment in High-Tech Industries Up 35.1% Year-on-Year in First Eight Months
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The Ministry of Commerce's latest data show that from January to August this year, 42,582 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, up 0.3% year-on-year, with actual use of foreign capital totaling 479.95 billion yuan. Actual use of foreign investment in high-tech industries reached 200.26 billion yuan, up 35.1% year-on-year and accounting for 41.7% of the national total, 12.4 percentage points higher than the same period last year, with faster growth in R&D and design services, scientific and technological achievement transformation services, and electronics and communications equipment manufacturing; by source, France and Switzerland posted relatively rapid growth in actual investment in China, up 39.2% and 16.7% respectively.

title_en: [Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start] Accelerating the Improvement of Comprehensive Market Regulation Capacity and Level
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 20, an official of the State Administration for Market Regulation outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including deepening reform of the registered capital subscription registration system, curbing "involution-style" competition through standards, price enforcement and quality regulation, strengthening fair competition review, regulating online sales and livestream selling, and formulating standards for emerging and future industries.

title_en: 2026 World Conference on Public Science Literacy Opens in Beijing
summary_en: The 2026 World Conference on Public Science Literacy opened in Beijing on the 20th, with participants citing President Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter to the first conference as guidance for China's efforts to raise public science literacy and co-found the World Organization for Public Science Literacy. More than 500 guests from 32 countries and international organizations are attending.

title_en: Public memorial ceremony for Mr. Tung Chee-hwa held in Hong Kong
summary_en: A public memorial ceremony for Tung Chee-hwa, the first and second Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and a vice chairman of the 10th through 13th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, was held at the Hong Kong Funeral Home on September 20; he died in Hong Kong on September 8, 2026, at age 89. Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng, Hu Jintao and others expressed deep condolences in various forms, and Shi Taifeng, Liang Zhenying, Wang Dongfeng, Xia Baolong and John Lee attended the ceremony.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Speaker of Australia's House of Representatives
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing with Milton Dick, Speaker of Australia's House of Representatives, with both sides pledging to strengthen exchanges between their legislatures and advance bilateral cooperation. Zhao conveyed China's willingness to implement the consensus reached by Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Albanese, while Dick said Australia adheres to the one-China policy and hopes to deepen exchanges and cooperation with China.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets with Speaker of Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing with Muzani, Speaker of Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly, with Zhao citing the consensus reached by Xi Jinping and President Prabowo Subianto on building a China-Indonesia community with a shared future and calling for closer exchanges between the two legislatures. Muzani said Indonesia hopes to strengthen friendly cooperation between the two countries' institutions and peoples and to enhance exchanges between the People's Consultative Assembly and the NPC.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: The Great River's Calm Waters Reflect the Original Aspiration
summary_en: The segment reports on Xi Jinping's guidance on ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River basin, highlighting water-conservation measures, smart irrigation in Hetao, waterless cooling for data centers in Qingyang, Gansu, water-rights trading, and eco-tourism along a scenic highway in Xin'an county, Luoyang, Henan.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment covers China's statement at a UN Security Council debate that peacekeeping operations must serve political processes, a Denmark-Greenland-US agreement on Arctic security, Putin's remarks that Russia's nuclear triad remains a guarantee of sovereignty, and a rise in West Nile virus cases in Italy.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Forces Say They Were Hit by Intensive Saudi Airstrikes; Saudi Capital Issues First Air-Raid Alert of This Round of Conflict
summary_en: A Houthi spokesman said Saudi warplanes carried out 26 airstrikes on Yemen's Taiz province in the past 24 hours and about 300 over the past week, while Yemen's government forces released video of strikes on Houthi targets in Marib; explosions were heard in Riyadh early on September 19 and residents received an air-raid alert, the first in the Saudi capital since the escalation began. US media reported that Saudi Aramco has told at least two European refinery customers it will not deliver crude next month after an attack on a key pipeline to the Red Sea, a decision said to apply to all European buyers, which Aramco declined to comment on.

title_en: Russia demands Japan withdraw deployed "Typhon" missile system
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Zakharova said on the 18th that Russia demands Japan withdraw the U.S. "Typhon" intermediate-range missile system deployed in Japan, noting that Russia issued a protest note to Japan on the 3rd and that the system must not be forward-deployed on Japanese territory under any pretext. Zakharova also said Japan must fully recognize the results of World War II, including the territorial attribution of the South Kuril Islands, and abandon its remilitarization policy.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for cultural industry development by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, record rail passenger volume of 332 million in January-August, new measures to train interdisciplinary digital economy talent, and a draft regulation on protecting minors' healthy and safe use of the internet issued for public comment by the Cyberspace Administration of China.

title_en: 20th Asian Games opens today
summary_en: The 20th Asian Games opened in Japan on September 19, with basketball player Hu Mingxuan and boxer Wu Yu carrying the Chinese delegation's flag at the opening ceremony. China has sent 815 athletes to compete in 38 sports and 369 events, with the first gold medals of the Games to be contested on September 20 in modern pentathlon and triathlon.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Zhuxi Garden — Living Cultural Heritage Flows into the Present
summary_en: The segment reports on Zhuxi Garden in the Wuyishan National Park in Fujian, where the Southern Song scholar Zhu Xi lectured and wrote for nearly fifty years, and highlights a new cultural-themed tram named after him, his compilation of the Four Books, his community granary system, and the site's status as a UNESCO World Cultural and Natural Heritage site.

title_en: China's Space Health Support System Reaches International Advanced Level
summary_en: At China's first Aerospace Medical Engineering Conference on September 19, officials said China's space health support system has overall reached the international advanced level during the space station's five years of stable operation, with a five-part framework covering weightlessness protection, nutrition, medical monitoring and insurance, psychological support, and environmental safety. The report also noted progress on the "Wangyu" lunar spacesuit for crewed moon missions, brain-computer interaction devices aboard the space station, and the "Dixing-3" bed-rest experiment that concluded in late August.

title_en: Various regions hold diverse public national defense education activities
summary_en: CCTV News reports that localities across China held a range of public national defense education activities on the 26th National Defense Education Day, including air-raid siren tests and evacuation drills in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, a live classroom session at a military museum in Liuzhou, Guangxi, and school programs in Yangzhong, Jiangsu and Hefeng, Hubei; a "National Defense Open Class" program was also set to premiere on CCTV's comprehensive channel.

title_en: Nearly 700 Billion Yuan Invested in Water Conservancy Construction Nationwide in First Eight Months
summary_en: The segment reports that China completed 690.3 billion yuan in water conservancy construction investment from January to August, with 38,000 water projects implemented and 28 major projects newly started, exceeding last year's total; it also notes progress on the Qingyukou Reservoir in Sichuan, the Three Gorges new shipping channel, and the modernization of the Qingtongxia irrigation district in Ningxia, as well as 13.43 billion yuan in private capital introduced, up 80.1 percent year-on-year.

title_en: National General Public Budget Revenue Up 5.7% Year-on-Year in First Eight Months
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reported that China's general public budget revenue reached 15.66 trillion yuan in January–August, up 5.7% year-on-year, with domestic VAT up 5.9% and corporate income tax up 7.3%. General public budget expenditure rose 1.2% to 18.15 trillion yuan, with spending on social security and employment up 6.5% and health up 9.2%.

title_en: China's Manufacturing Sector Accelerates High-End Transformation
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's manufacturing upgrade is accelerating, with August value-added output of high-tech manufacturing up 16.7% year-on-year and digital product manufacturing up 15.7%, together contributing over 60% of growth in large-scale industrial output; the segment also highlights advances such as domestically developed memory chips and flexible screens, over 56,000 basic-level smart factories built to date, and August industrial export delivery value up 11.1% year-on-year for a fifth straight month of double-digit growth.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Hunan, a Red Land Moving Toward the New
summary_en: The segment reports on Hunan as one of the 15 provinces the Red Army's Long March passed through, recalling the December 1934 "Channel Troop Diversion" meeting in Tongdao, Huaihua, and noting that the site now draws over one million visitors a year. It also describes Hunan's push to strengthen advanced manufacturing clusters and upgrade traditional industries, aiming to rank among the country's top tier in advanced manufacturing by 2030.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: The Great River Nourishes China
summary_en: The segment reports on coordinated ecological protection and governance of the Yellow River across the nine provinces and regions it flows through, citing Xi Jinping's guidance and describing progress in reducing sediment, expanding migratory bird habitats in the Yellow River Delta, establishing ecological compensation mechanisms, and building a digital twin of the Yellow River to support scientific decision-making.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on clashes between Yemeni government forces and the Houthis near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a UN official's statement that Israel continues to violate Syria's sovereignty, the start of voting in Russia's State Duma elections, the Bank of Japan's second rate hike this year, record Canadian sales of US stocks in July, and a study finding that ice loss in Greenland and Antarctica raised global sea levels by about 3.14 cm from 1979 to 2023.

title_en: UN Security Council Rejects Draft Resolution Extending Mandate of Iran Sanctions Committee Expert Panel
summary_en: The UN Security Council voted on 17th on a draft resolution extending the mandate of the Iran Sanctions Committee's expert panel; permanent members Russia and China voted against, and the draft was rejected. China's representative said the priority is to urge the parties to exercise calm and restraint, stop the use or threat of force, ease tensions, and create conditions for resuming the ceasefire and returning to negotiations, while also noting that US media reported Washington had agreed to grant visas to Iranian leaders attending next week's UN General Assembly high-level meeting, with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian expected to speak on the 23rd.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: A CCTV News roundup covering the State Council Food Safety Office's deployment of food safety inspections for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, a campaign against noncompliant compulsory product certification, police handling of over 36,000 cybercrime cases this year, State Grid upgrades to weak county-level grids during the 15th Five-Year Plan, approval of 59 innovative drugs this year, the fifth central-enterprise consumption assistance week for farmers, the maiden voyage of the Nanning–Yangpu river-sea route, Beijing's agricultural innovation space, fast patent pre-examination services for Macao innovators in Hengqin, and an upcoming High-Level Interview with Angolan National Assembly Speaker Carolina Cerqueira de Almeida.

title_en: US returns 64 artifacts and paleontological fossils to China
summary_en: In two batches on September 16 and 18 Beijing time, the United States returned 64 artifacts and paleontological fossils to China, which the National Cultural Heritage Administration received in Washington and New York; the items, including a bodhisattva figure from Tianlongshan Cave 17 and dinosaur fossils, were all seized by US law enforcement, with the return carried out under a 2009 bilateral memorandum of understanding on restricting the illegal import of Chinese cultural property, since renewed three times.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on September 18 featuring four representatives from the veterans affairs field, who discussed their work in grassroots governance, immigration management, honoring martyrs, and building a strong spacefaring nation, and their commitment to contributing to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

title_en: Autumn Harvest Season: Rural Industries Enrich Farmers
summary_en: The segment reports on autumn harvests across China, including fresh corn in Huanan County, Heilongjiang, chili peppers in Shawan, Xinjiang, kiwifruit in Xunwu, Jiangxi, and pomegranates in Huili, Sichuan, highlighting mechanization, processing, and logistics improvements that boost farmers' incomes and rural revitalization.

title_en: 140th Canton Fair to be held in Guangzhou from October 15 to November 4
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on September 18, where officials from the Ministry of Commerce and Guangdong province announced that the 140th Canton Fair will be held in Guangzhou in three phases from October 15 to November 4. More than 11,000 of the 32,000 exhibitors are high-quality enterprises such as specialized and sophisticated "little giant" firms and single-product champions, and more than 210,000 overseas buyers have completed pre-registration.

title_en: "15th Five-Year Plan" Off to a Good Start: Vigorously Implementing Urban Renewal to Promote High-Quality Urban Development
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 18, a Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development official outlined plans for high-quality housing and urban-rural development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including renovating 115,000 old urban residential communities, updating or installing 575,000 residential elevators, upgrading 1,500 old neighborhoods and factory areas, and designating more than 100 new historical and cultural blocks and over 10,000 new historic buildings.

title_en: Events held across China mark 95th anniversary of the September 18 Incident
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that commemorative events were held across China on September 18 to mark the 95th anniversary of the September 18 Incident, with air-raid sirens, moments of silence and flower-laying at memorial halls including the Shanghai Songhu Memorial Hall of the War of Resistance and the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders. The segment also covers themed exhibitions, youth patriotic education activities in Heilongjiang, and commemorations by PLA units honoring martyrs and pledging to strengthen military training.

title_en: Bell-Tolling and Alarm Ceremony Marking September 18 Incident Held in Shenyang
summary_en: A ceremony to mark the 95th anniversary of the September 18 Incident was held on the morning of the 18th at the Remnant Calendar Monument Square of the September 18 Historical Museum in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, where Politburo member and NPC Standing Committee Vice Chairman Li Hongzhong attended and delivered a speech. The ceremony included the national anthem, 14 tolls of the "Warning Bell" symbolizing China's 14-year War of Resistance, and air-raid sirens across Shenyang, with Wang Xiaohong and about 1,000 others, including veteran resistance fighters and families of martyrs, attending.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets Egyptian Senate Speaker
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), met in Beijing on the 18th with Egyptian Senate Speaker Abdel-Wahab Abdel-Razeq (Fareed), with both sides pledging to implement the consensus reached by Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and to strengthen exchanges between the CPPCC and Egypt's Senate.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets Egyptian Senate Speaker Farid
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met with Egyptian Senate Speaker Farid in Beijing on the 18th, with Zhao citing President Xi Jinping's historic visit to Egypt earlier this month and calling for closer exchanges between China's NPC and Egypt's parliament. Farid reaffirmed Egypt's commitment to the one-China principle and said the Egyptian Senate is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with the NPC.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on September 18 that reviewed work on aging, healthy development of sports events, expansion of medical rehabilitation and nursing services, and passed a draft regulation on protecting traditional Chinese medicine knowledge along with draft amendments to 15 laws including the Emergency Response Law.

title_en: Growing and Strengthening Advanced Manufacturing to Consolidate the Foundation of the Real Economy — General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing Spark Enthusiastic Response
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that General Secretary Xi Jinping issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, calling for continued efforts to grow and strengthen the sector, raise the self-reliance and controllability of industrial and supply chains, and build a modern industrial system with advanced manufacturing as its backbone to support Chinese-style modernization. The instructions drew an enthusiastic response among cadres and the public, who pledged to treat advanced manufacturing as a key strategic task and steadily advance toward the goal of building a manufacturing powerhouse.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Houthi claims of strikes on a Saudi oil facility and air base, a building collapse in Gaza City killing at least 20, the U.S. Federal Reserve's first rate hike in over three years, and a World Meteorological Organization report warning of increasingly abnormal global water cycles.

title_en: EU Says It Is Willing to Push for Canada to Become an EU Associate Member; US Calls the Move a Hostile Act
summary_en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in her State of the Union address to the European Parliament on the 16th that the EU will work with the Canadian government to make Canada the first EU associate member, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's office welcomed the proposal. US media reported that US President Donald Trump said on the 16th that allowing Canada to become an associate member is a hostile act and that he may impose high tariffs on Europe and halt trade with Europe in some areas.

title_en: Russia Says Japan's 'Remilitarization' Threatens Russian Security and Northeast Asian Peace
summary_en: Russia's Foreign Ministry said in a statement on the 16th that Deputy Foreign Minister Rudenko told Japanese Ambassador Muto Akira that Japan's continued anti-Russia line—including its reaction to President Vladimir Putin's recent visit to the South Kuril Islands and its expanded military aid to Ukraine—further dims prospects for normalizing dialogue. Russia stressed that Japan's push toward 'remilitarization,' including military training with the United States and its Western allies near Russia's Far East and the deployment of intermediate-range missile systems on Japanese territory, poses a direct threat to Russian national security and Northeast Asian peace, and warned it will take necessary measures if such activities continue.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that national railway fixed-asset investment reached 511.8 billion yuan in the first eight months of the year, up 1.5% year-on-year, and covers the release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for culture and tourism development, new statistics on investment in people, a food-safety risk-control checklist for online food sales, the 2026 SCO Traditional Medicine Forum in Nanchang, the launch of the autumn campus recruitment month for 2027 graduates, two successful space launches, and the opening of the 2026 Beijing Book Fair.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds "Strivers on the New Journey" Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on September 17 featuring five representatives of village first secretaries, who discussed their work in rural revitalization, including developing specialty industries, expanding income channels, strengthening collective economies, improving living environments, and enhancing Party leadership, and shared stories of helping villagers consolidate poverty-alleviation gains and increase incomes.

title_en: Promoting Urban Renewal to Build Livable Cities
summary_en: In the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, localities across China are continuing to advance urban renewal, upgrading community facilities and creating new consumption spaces, with examples including a renovated former boiler room in Beijing's Shijingshan District, upgraded standardized markets in Shanghai's Pudong New Area, restored heritage courtyards in Nanjing's Yihe Road historical district, old housing renovations in Nanchang, and rain-sewage separation projects in Taiyuan.

title_en: China's Logistics Digitalization Level Notably Improved
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that digital R&D investment by key logistics firms rose nearly 30% year-on-year in the first seven months of the year, with smart warehouses, logistics robots, and over 1,000 AI agent application scenarios deployed by leading companies to boost efficiency and coordinate with high-tech manufacturing production.

title_en: 80 Billion Yuan in New Policy-Based Financial Instruments Disbursed at Accelerated Pace
summary_en: CCTV reports that the first batch of this year's new policy-based financial instruments has begun disbursement, with the Export-Import Bank of China providing 100 million yuan to an intelligent suspension industrialization project in Rui'an, Zhejiang, and a private-investment highway project in Wuhan, Hubei, among the first supported projects. The total scale for this year has risen to 800 billion yuan from 500 billion yuan last year, and is estimated to leverage roughly 10 trillion yuan in total project investment.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Culture and Tourism Reshaped, Ningxia Builds an International Tourism Destination
summary_en: During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Ningxia is converting its landscape, forest, farmland, lake, grassland, and desert resources into cultural tourism products, developing specialty and all-for-one tourism, and working to build an international tourism destination. The segment highlights the Shitanjing cultural tourism and film town in Shizuishan, the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, Minning Town in Yinchuan, and Zhongwei's Route 66 and 'Hometown of Stars' tourism IP.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: Accelerating High-Quality Development of Radio, Television and Online Audiovisual Services
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 17, an official from the National Radio and Television Administration outlined plans to accelerate high-quality development of radio, television and online audiovisual services during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, noting that China's online audiovisual user base reached 1.099 billion by the end of last year, with users watching more than 200 minutes per day on average and the industry market exceeding 1.2 trillion yuan, while micro-drama users surpassed 800 million and that market topped 100 billion yuan in 2025.

title_en: Summer Grain Purchases Exceed 100 Million Tonnes; Autumn Grain Procurement Ready
summary_en: China's summer grain procurement is nearing completion with over 100 million tonnes of wheat purchased by various entities, supported by the state's minimum purchase price plan, including 164 collection points opened by Sinograin in Henan and Anhui. Autumn grain procurement is set to run from late September to the end of April next year, accounting for about three-quarters of annual grain purchases, with main producing areas preparing storage, raising funds, and expanding drying and transport capacity.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening of 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and Meets Foreign Dignitaries
summary_en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the opening of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo in Nanning, Guangxi, where he delivered remarks proposing four points on upgrading China-ASEAN cooperation, and met with Myanmar Vice President Nyo Saw, Vietnamese Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc, and Lao Deputy Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Adhere to the Direction of Intelligent, Green, and Integrated Development, Continue to Expand and Strengthen Advanced Manufacturing
summary_en: CCTV aired a Quick Comment on September 17 emphasizing the need to adhere to intelligent, green, and integrated development and to continue expanding and strengthening advanced manufacturing.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing, Stressing Continuous Expansion and Strengthening of Advanced Manufacturing to Provide Strong Support for Chinese-Style Modernization; Li Qiang Attends National Advanced Manufacturing Conference and Delivers Speech
summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, calling for strengthening the sector to support Chinese-style modernization, and Premier Li Qiang attended and addressed the National Advanced Manufacturing Conference held in Beijing on September 16-17, where Xi's instructions were conveyed.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Saudi air defenses intercepted and destroyed a Houthi drone bound for Mecca, that the WTO's 2026 World Trade Report warns the multilateral trading system faces its most serious challenge with potential global GDP losses of up to 10%, and that Israeli strikes in Gaza killed at least four people, with Israel saying it killed a Hamas Rafah brigade commander.

title_en: Iran says it shot down three US military drones in one day
summary_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on the 15th that it downed a US MQ-1 drone over the Strait of Hormuz, the third such drone it claims to have shot down that day, to which the US has not yet responded; separately, US media published photos said to show Middle East bases after Iranian attacks and reported that the Pentagon's military spending on Iran has exceeded $42 billion, while international oil prices rose on the 15th amid regional tensions.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the NDRC allocated 30 million yuan in emergency funding for post-disaster recovery in Hainan, that 2026 second-half military recruit transport began, that the APEC Young Entrepreneurs Conference opened in Hangzhou, that Airbus delivered the first aircraft from its second Tianjin final assembly line, that Fuzhou Changle International Airport's new terminal opened, that China exceeded its phased Kigali Amendment compliance targets, that the second batch of resettlement housing was delivered in Xiong'an's Dahe area, and that 2026 box office revenue surpassed 29 billion yuan.

title_en: All Four Major Sea Areas of China Fully Open to Fishing
summary_en: At noon on September 16, the summer fishing moratorium ended for the Yellow Sea and East China Sea between 35°N and 26°30'N, meaning all four major sea areas — Bohai, Yellow Sea, East China Sea and South China Sea — are now fully open to fishing. In Fujian and Zhejiang, over 1,700 fishing vessels set out, with maritime authorities providing escort, and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reports clear improvements in fishery resource recovery after the moratorium.

title_en: Hong Kong SAR Government Unveils First Five-Year Plan
summary_en: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government published its first Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026–2030), setting out seven guiding principles and five main goals, including new breakthroughs in economic development, enhanced international competitiveness, accelerated construction of the Northern Metropolis, improved livelihoods, and deeper integration into national development. Chief Executive John Lee said the plan, issued in the opening year of the national 15th Five-Year Plan, is a major step to strengthen executive-led governance and align Hong Kong with national development strategy.

title_en: China's modern services sector shows positive development in August
summary_en: Data from the National Bureau of Statistics shows that in August the national services production index rose 4.1% year-on-year, with the information transmission, software and IT services production index up 9.6% and contributing over 20% of the growth, as new technologies such as artificial intelligence expanded and demand for computing power grew rapidly. Service retail sales rose 4.9% year-on-year in January-August, with communications and information services and tourism consulting and leasing services each growing more than 10%.

title_en: Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start: Advancing the Building of a Socialist Rule-of-Law Country to a Higher Level
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 16, Ministry of Justice officials described progress in implementing comprehensive law-based governance and judicial administrative work in service of high-quality economic and social development. The ministry has completed review of 37 legislative items, and from January to August this year administrative reconsideration organs handled 772,000 cases, up 19.1 percent year on year, while localities drew on 3.1 million people's mediators, 69,000 arbitrators and 17,800 administrative reconsideration personnel to resolve disputes at their source.

title_en: Summary Meeting Held for the Central Steering Group and Central-Level Working Group on the Study and Education Campaign to Establish and Practice a Correct View of Political Achievements
summary_en: A summary meeting was held in Beijing on the 16th for the Central Steering Group and the central-level working group of the study and education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements. The meeting stressed that the campaign, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee, was carried out solidly and in depth with notable results, and called for closer unity around the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core and for consolidating and extending the campaign's outcomes.

title_en: Han Zheng Attends and Addresses Welcoming Banquet of the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
summary_en: Vice President Han Zheng attended and spoke at the welcoming banquet of the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum on September 15, proposing four points on upholding the UN Charter, multilateralism, dialogue-based dispute resolution, and people-centered governance of emerging fields. Central Military Commission Vice Chairman Zhang Shengmin also attended, along with official representatives from nearly 100 countries, regions, and international organizations.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang to attend opening of 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang will attend and deliver remarks at the opening ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and the China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit in Nanning, Guangxi, on September 17. Foreign leaders and senior officials attending include Myanmar Vice President Nyo Saw, Vietnamese Politburo member and Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc, and Lao Politburo member and Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith, along with ASEAN Secretary-General Kao Kim Hourn.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Pinglu Canal Navigation Ceremony
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the navigation ceremony for the Pinglu Canal at the Madao hub in Qinzhou, Guangxi, on September 16, declaring the canal open and touring the waterway. Ding said Xi Jinping had repeatedly issued instructions on building the canal to high standards and called for high-level operation of the project, a key part of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor linking Nanning with the Beibu Gulf.

title_en: Loyal Guardians of the Party and the People: General Secretary Xi Jinping's Reply Letter to the 'Zhangzhou 110' Team in Fujian Province Draws Enthusiastic Response
summary_en: A recent reply letter from General Secretary Xi Jinping to the 'Zhangzhou 110' police team in Fujian Province drew an enthusiastic response across China's public security system. Xi praised the team as a shining example of the police force for its work on the front lines serving the public and safeguarding people's safety, and urged public security officers to remain loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: With Advanced Manufacturing as the Backbone, Strengthening the Foundation of the Real Economy
summary_en: The segment reports Xi Jinping's emphasis that advanced manufacturing is the backbone of a modern industrial system, and highlights China's progress in areas such as the Long March 10B rocket's first global rocket net-recovery, the Mengzhou spacecraft's maximum dynamic pressure escape test, the CR450 train's completed full-vehicle trials, and offshore wind development beyond 130 kilometers, alongside claims that China accounts for 60% of global new energy vehicle sales and 97% of humanoid robot shipments.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Carry Forward the Red Gene, Leverage Comprehensive Advantages, and Strive to Cultivate More High-Quality Talent
summary_en: CCTV aired a Quick Comment on September 16 titled "Carry Forward the Red Gene, Leverage Comprehensive Advantages, and Strive to Cultivate More High-Quality Talent." The segment reports on this commentary; no foreign leaders are mentioned.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating Jilin University on Its 80th Anniversary
summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president, and chairman of the Central Military Commission, sent a letter on the 16th congratulating Jilin University on its 80th anniversary and extending congratulations to all faculty, staff, and alumni. In the letter, Xi urged the university to take Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as its guide, carry forward its revolutionary heritage, focus on national strategic needs, and cultivate more high-quality talent to contribute to the full revitalization of Northeast China in the new era and to advancing Chinese-style modernization.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article 'Speech at the Symposium on Strengthening Basic Research'
summary_en: The 18th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on September 16, carries an article by Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled 'Speech at the Symposium on Strengthening Basic Research.' The article stresses that basic research is the source of the entire scientific system and the frontier of global technological competition, and calls for optimizing its layout, expanding the pool of basic research talent, strengthening support and safeguards, and expanding international cooperation.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Yemen's Houthi forces claiming missile and drone strikes on a Saudi air base in Khamis Mushait amid continued Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, Russia's Defense Ministry saying its forces advanced in multiple directions and captured three more settlements in Ukraine while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky voiced support for a mutual halt to strikes on critical infrastructure, and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield briefly topping 5.02%, its highest level since 2007.

title_en: US Says Open to Talks with Iran; Iran Says It Will Not Negotiate Until Its Conditions Are Met
summary_en: US President Trump said Iran is eager for a deal and that the US is open to negotiations, while Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Rezaei said Tehran will not negotiate until its conditions are met. A Pentagon report said the Iran conflict has caused shortages of advanced US weapons and damage to US bases and diplomatic facilities in the region, and a UN fact-finding mission condemned recent US and Israeli airstrikes over civilian deaths.

title_en: Chang'e-6 lunar far-side soil samples presented to UN headquarters in Vienna
summary_en: China's National Space Administration, China's Permanent Mission to the UN and other international organizations in Vienna, and the UN Office for Outer Space Affairs held a handover ceremony at UN headquarters in Vienna on the 14th, formally donating to the UN the first batch of lunar far-side soil samples collected by Chang'e-6, which will be permanently displayed there. Chinese representatives said the move puts into practice President Xi Jinping's four global initiatives and that China is willing to share space development achievements with other countries; UNOV Director-General Ghulam Mohammed Juma and UNOOSA Director Aarti Holla-Maini welcomed the donation.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that new and second-hand home price declines in first-, second- and third-tier cities continued to narrow year-on-year in August; that China's national carbon market has cumulatively traded nearly 1 billion tons with turnover exceeding 60 billion yuan; and that regulators issued administrative guidance to online hotel booking platforms including Meituan, Douyin, JD, Ctrip, Tongcheng and Fliggy. It also covers a pilot pre-approval system for medical service pricing, China leading 214 international standards in the first eight months of the year, the 2026 SCO Digital Economy Forum in Urumqi, the 2026 Yangtze River Civilization Forum in Chongqing, the first commercial rocket launch for a large-scale satellite internet constellation, and the launch of a Hainan recruitment campaign in Xi'an.

title_en: [Cultural China Tour] Shaoxing Historic District Preservation: Keeping Residents, Preserving Heritage, Sustaining Daily Life
summary_en: The segment reports on Shaoxing's Cangqiao Straight Street, a 1.5-kilometer historic district that has pursued a "micro-renovation" preservation model for over 20 years, retaining more than 800 original households rather than relocating them for commercial development, and now attracting young entrepreneurs through rent reductions and startup support.

title_en: Over 130 billion yuan in project funding secured for rural construction from January to August
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has steadily advanced its rural construction drive this year, with more than 130 billion yuan in project funding secured by the end of August for rural roads, water supply and drainage, toilet upgrades, waste and sewage treatment, and elderly care facilities. The segment highlights local projects in Hebei, Anhui, and Shandong, including road hardening, cattle breeding infrastructure, and a village canteen for elderly residents.

title_en: Revenue of Above-Scale Electronic Information Manufacturing Enterprises to Exceed 30 Trillion Yuan by 2030
