summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry," which projects that by 2030 above-scale enterprises in China's electronic information manufacturing sector will see operating revenue exceed 30 trillion yuan, with R&D investment intensity reaching 3.5 percent. During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, the sector's above-scale enterprise revenue ranked first among 41 major industrial categories for 13 consecutive years.

title_en: China's National Economy Remained Generally Stable in August
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 15, National Bureau of Statistics data showed that China's industrial output above designated size rose 5.2% year-on-year in August, 0.7 percentage points faster than the previous month, while high-tech industry investment grew 5.2% in the first eight months and retail sales of consumer goods approached 33 trillion yuan. The report said employment and prices remained broadly stable and energy consumption per unit of industrial value added fell 7.2% year-on-year in August, with the government pledging to strengthen macro policy adjustment and expand domestic demand.

title_en: Seminar on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West Collaboration Theory and Practice Held in Yinchuan
summary_en: On September 15, a seminar on the theory and practice of Fujian-Ningxia collaboration and East-West collaboration was held in Yinchuan, Ningxia. Participants said that since the 18th Party Congress, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has led East-West collaboration to historic achievements, and they called for studying Xi Jinping's important expositions on East-West collaboration, advancing common prosperity for all, developing cultural undertakings and industries to empower western regions, and summarizing valuable experience such as Fujian-Ningxia collaboration.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Guangdong — Red Legacy Shines in Northern Guangdong as Old Revolutionary Areas Begin a New Chapter
summary_en: The segment reports that northern Guangdong, the first province the Central Red Army entered after leaving the Central Soviet Area during the Long March, is preserving that history through the Long March National Cultural Park (Guangdong section) and a newly expanded collection of 13 revolutionary relics at the Shaoguan memorial hall, while Shaoguan now hosts the Greater Bay Area's only national-level data center cluster with over 45,000P of computing capacity and, in March, opened the Southern Test Site for connected vehicles and low-altitude aircraft.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Linking Rivers to the Sea, the New Western Land-Sea Corridor Expands New Space for Opening Up
summary_en: The segment reports that the Pinglu Canal, the backbone project of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, is set to open to navigation on September 16 after its main works passed inspection, and that construction of the corridor has accelerated this year, with routes now reaching 166 stations in 18 provincial-level regions and nearly 600 ports in over 120 countries and regions, helping drive a 20.3% year-on-year rise in western China's imports and exports in the first half of the year.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Resolving the Public's Difficulties with Heart and Sincerity, Diligently Guarding the Lights of Ten Thousand Homes
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program aired a CCTV Quick Comment today (September 15) titled "Resolving the Public's Difficulties with Heart and Sincerity, Diligently Guarding the Lights of Ten Thousand Homes."

title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to All Members of Fujian's "Zhangzhou 110," Stressing Commitment to Serving the People and Loyalty as Guardians of the Party and the People
summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, sent a reply letter to all members of Fujian's "Zhangzhou 110" police unit, encouraging them and expressing his expectations. In the letter he praised the unit's work serving the public and safeguarding people's safety, and urged public security officers to remain true to their original aspiration of serving the people and to be loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Oman and Iran postponed a regional meeting on Gulf shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, Israel's defense minister said the military will maintain control of a southern Lebanon ridge, the Kremlin said Russia is taking measures to secure Kaliningrad after Poland's call for larger NATO drills, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada is taking charge of its own future ahead of an investment summit, and Japan's Chubu Electric Power withdrew restart applications for two reactors at its Hamaoka nuclear plant amid a data falsification scandal.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Armed Forces Say Multiple Areas Attacked; Government Forces Say They Retook Some Positions
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi armed forces said Saudi Arabia carried out 58 airstrikes with F-15 fighter jets over the past 24 hours on six provinces including Taiz, Lahij and al-Jawf, while Yemeni government forces said they retook some positions in western Taiz province and expanded their operational scope there. The International Organization for Migration said the number of displaced people in Yemen has reached 85,818, an increase of nearly 10,000 from the figure reported the previous day.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the distribution of a military theory reader to the PLA, an eight-department action plan to boost smart home consumption, a plan to build a multi-tiered agricultural insurance system by 2030, the arrival of all inbound exhibits for the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo, the Han-to-Wei water diversion project's cumulative supply of over 450 million cubic meters to Xi'an, and the launch of the 2026 National Common Language and Script Promotion Week.

title_en: Pleasant Autumn Scenery: Enjoying the Good Autumn Days
summary_en: With autumn deepening, localities across China are offering distinctive autumn-viewing routes, from tourist trains through the forests of Mohe in Heilongjiang and forest trains in Ergun, Inner Mongolia, to the sun-drying autumn harvest displays in Huangshan, Anhui, and Wuyuan, Jiangxi, sunflower harvesting in Delingha, Qinghai, and jujube picking in Xinzheng, Henan.

title_en: 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week Launches Today
summary_en: The 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week, jointly organized by the Central Propaganda Department, the Cyberspace Administration of China and eight other departments, opened today (September 14) in Jinan, Shandong, under the theme "Cybersecurity Safeguarding in the Intelligent Era." At the opening ceremony, cyberspace authorities released the AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0 and other key outcomes, alongside recruitment fairs for cybersecurity and informatization talent and technology application experience zones.

title_en: County-Level Consumption in China Accelerates in Scale and Quality
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that county-level commercial facilities and consumer goods and services have continued to improve this year, with 3,159 county comprehensive commerce service centers, 15,000 township commerce centers and 168,000 village convenience stores built or upgraded nationwide, and more than 100 million parcels circulating between urban and rural areas daily as county and township logistics networks are strengthened.

title_en: China to Join Ranks of World Automotive Powers by 2030
summary_en: Nine Chinese government departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission, released a plan for the intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to consolidate China's position across the full industrial chain and join the ranks of world automotive powers by 2030, with new energy passenger and commercial vehicles to account for 70% and 40% of new vehicle sales in their respective segments. The plan also targets scaled application of autonomous driving features, cultivation of整车 makers in the global top ten and parts suppliers in the global top 100, a stronger voice in international standards, and peak carbon emissions for the auto industry before 2030.

title_en: Ensuring Autumn Grain Production and Safeguarding a Bumper Harvest
summary_en: The segment reports that China's autumn grain crops have entered the critical yield-formation period, with localities implementing measures to support production. It details corn field management in Heilongjiang and Hebei, including drone-assisted cultivation and green pest control, and describes pest monitoring and water management for mid- and late-season rice in Hubei, Jiangxi, and other areas.

title_en: State Council Elevates Investigation into '9·10' Major Fire Accident at China State Shipbuilding Corporation Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding Co., Ltd.
summary_en: A fire aboard a foreign cargo ship undergoing repairs at China State Shipbuilding Corporation's Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding Co., Ltd. on September 10 killed 25 people and injured 5; the State Council has formed an elevated investigation team led by the Ministry of Emergency Management, which held its first plenary meeting on September 14 chaired by Vice Minister Song Yuanming.

title_en: Multiple Departments Join Forces to Address Payment Collection Difficulties for SMEs
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office policy briefing on September 14, officials said China will improve industry payment rules and set reasonable payment periods by sector, encourage leading firms to commit to paying SMEs in cash within 60 days, and strengthen oversight of large enterprises' payment behavior, including joint regulatory talks for those that deliberately extend payment periods. Authorities will also tighten enforcement against abuse of competitive advantage, cap payment periods for accounts-receivable electronic vouchers at six months, and support large firms in refinancing payables through loans and bonds so they can pay SMEs in cash promptly.

title_en: Steady Growth in Total Financial Aggregates Provides Strong Support for the Economy's Development Toward New, Better, and Improving Trends
summary_en: CCTV News reports that People's Bank of China data released on September 14 show M2 money supply at 356.81 trillion yuan at end-August, up 7.5% year on year, and outstanding total social financing at 464.8 trillion yuan, with RMB loans to the real economy at 278.63 trillion yuan, up 5%. Total financial aggregates grew reasonably, social financing conditions remained accommodative, and loan interest rates stayed at historic lows, with corporate new-loan weighted average rates slightly below 3% in August, about 0.2 percentage points lower than a year earlier.

title_en: Sichuan Accelerates Building a Strong Clean Energy Province
summary_en: Sichuan is expanding clean energy development and new-type power grid construction to boost local consumption of clean energy, aiming by 2030 for hydropower and new energy installed capacity to exceed 110 million and 100 million kilowatts respectively.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: Advancing Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 14, the National Health Commission and other agencies outlined plans to build a Healthy China by 2035, with the 15th Five-Year Plan period described as critical. Officials said China will prioritize health in development, shift grassroots medical services from availability to quality, and ensure that by the end of this year more than 95% of community health centers and township hospitals nationwide can provide pediatric care.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Seize Historical Initiative, Strengthen the Power of the Global South
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the station aired a CCTV Quick Comment titled "Seize Historical Initiative, Strengthen the Power of the Global South."

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in India, Visit Concludes Successfully
summary_en: State Councilor and Foreign Minister Wang Yi briefed accompanying reporters on President Xi Jinping's September 12-13 trip to New Delhi for the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting, where Xi held nearly 10 events in under 24 hours and held in-depth talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on bilateral relations.

title_en: Xi Jinping returns to Beijing after attending the 18th BRICS Summit
summary_en: On the evening of September 13, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully concluding his attendance at the 18th BRICS Summit. Accompanying personnel including Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, returned on the same flight.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthis said Saudi Arabia carried out over a hundred airstrikes on seven Yemeni provinces in 48 hours and that the Houthis struck a Saudi military base in response; that Iraq temporarily closed two border crossings with Iran and opened a joint investigation with Iran into drone launch sites found near the border after an attack on a Saudi east-west oil pipeline; that US President Donald Trump said Irish unification would be a good thing and would eventually happen, with the UK Prime Minister's office responding that a border poll is not under consideration; that Argentina plans to build a naval base near the Falklands/Malvinas at Ushuaia; and that an Indonesian passenger ferry carrying about 240 people sank in the Java Sea, with 6 confirmed dead and more than 110 rescued.

title_en: Sharing Responsibility of the Times, Jointly Opening a New 'Golden Decade' of BRICS Cooperation — International Community Highly Praises President Xi Jinping's Important Speech at BRICS Summit
summary_en: People from multiple countries said that President Xi Jinping's important speech during the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting provided clear guidance for the 'BRICS family' to jointly move toward the next 'Golden Decade' and injected vigorous momentum into countries' joint efforts to build a community with a shared future for mankind. They expressed willingness to strengthen cooperation with China under the BRICS framework and contribute to high-quality development of 'greater BRICS cooperation.'

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on a new MIIT action plan for "AI plus software" targeting 20,000 large software enterprises by 2028, NDRC promotion of investment projects to private firms worth 15.6 billion yuan in intended private capital, the launch of a Yangtze River Delta basic research joint fund, abolition of over 7,400 local standards in the first half of the year, nationwide integrated computing power monitoring, completion of all main towers on the Ningbo-Zhoushan railway bridges, Jiangsu's 20 measures on commercializing scientific results, and Inner Mongolia's new energy trading volume surpassing 500 billion kilowatt-hours.

title_en: 2026 CIFTIS Achieves Over 1,200 Outcomes of Various Types
summary_en: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) closed on September 13 at Shougang Park in Beijing, with 134 promotional and matchmaking events held over the five-day session, nearly 80% more than a year earlier. Guest country Norway's delegation signed six cooperation agreements with Chinese enterprises and institutions, the "Invest Beijing" promotion event saw 36 key projects signed on site, and the fair produced more than 1,200 outcomes of various types.

title_en: Central Organization Department, with Relevant Ministries, Revises and Issues "Five Measures" to Further Strengthen Management of Leaders of Public Institutions in Various Sectors
summary_en: The Central Organization Department, together with the Central Propaganda Department, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Science and Technology, and the National Health Commission, issued five management measures covering leaders of public institutions in the propaganda, ideological and cultural system, higher education institutions, primary and secondary schools, scientific research institutions, and public hospitals. The newly revised measures are guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and Xi Jinping's thought on Party building, and aim to provide stronger institutional guarantees for building a high-quality, professional corps of leaders for public institutions.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Bravely Serve as Pioneers of the Era and Jointly Promote the Building of a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program broadcast a CCTV Quick Comment titled "Bravely Serve as Pioneers of the Era and Jointly Promote the Building of a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind." The segment consists of this announcement and does not name any foreign leader.

title_en: Xi Jinping Successfully Concludes Attendance at the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
summary_en: President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing on the afternoon of September 13 local time after successfully concluding his attendance at the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit. As he departed New Delhi, senior Indian government officials saw him off at the airport, and local overseas Chinese and representatives of Chinese-funded enterprises waved the flags of China and India along the route to the airport to warmly congratulate him on the success of the summit.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Indian Prime Minister Modi
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, where the two leaders held a candid and in-depth exchange of views and reached an important consensus that China and India should be partners. Xi set out four points on steadily advancing China-India relations, and Modi said India views India-China relations from a strategic and long-term perspective and is willing to be a partner rather than a rival to China.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Second Session of 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: On the morning of September 13 local time in New Delhi, President Xi Jinping attended the second session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting and delivered a speech titled "Strengthening the Foundation of BRICS Cooperation and Boosting the Power of the Global South," proposing five initiatives on AI, trade and investment facilitation, digital industry, smart manufacturing, and science and technology talent development. The meeting, chaired by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, was also attended by Russian President Vladimir Putin, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto, Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, UAE Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Khaled, and UN Secretary-General António Guterres, among others.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends First Session of 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the first session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi on September 12, delivering a speech titled "Shouldering the Responsibility of the Times and Being Pioneers," with Russian President Putin, South African President Ramaphosa, Iranian President Pezeshkian, Egyptian President Sisi, Indonesian President Prabowo, Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy, UAE Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Khaled, and Brazil's foreign minister attending, and Indian Prime Minister Modi chairing. Xi called for BRICS to be pioneers in innovation, peace and stability, mutual learning among civilizations, and reform of global governance, and announced China will host the 19th BRICS Leaders' Meeting as chair next year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthi forces seized the strategic island of Perim and the Zubab area near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, that Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei blamed the US for insecurity in the Strait of Hormuz and announced a regional meeting in Oman on September 14, that US consumer confidence fell in September while inflation expectations rose, and that the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 7,000 confirmed cases.

title_en: International figures say China will steer 'greater BRICS cooperation' steadily forward, strongly promoting world peace and development
summary_en: International figures say the BRICS cooperation mechanism has become an important multilateral platform with global influence and that China has played a key role in it, expressing confidence that China will continue to lead 'greater BRICS cooperation' and contribute to safeguarding the common interests of the Global South and promoting world peace and development. Figures from multiple countries note that China will take over the BRICS chairmanship in 2027 and say that under China's guidance the mechanism will keep advancing toward high-quality development and continue to inject confidence and momentum into the common development of Global South countries.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China ranks first in the world in reserves of 14 minerals, including rare earths and tungsten, and that a joint sediment-flushing operation began at key reservoirs on the upper and middle Yellow River. It also covers 499 million border crossings in the first eight months of 2026, with visa-free foreign entries up 26.8% year on year; progress in preventing birth defects; trial through-operation of the Beijing-Xiong'an Express Line; and the extradition of Zeng Nenggui, a Red Notice fugitive and former official in Ruijin, Jiangxi, suspected of taking bribes in poverty-alleviation projects.

title_en: Vital China Research Tour: From 'Buying Goods' to 'Buying Experiences,' Changsha's Consumption Accelerates
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Changsha, a national pilot city for new consumption formats, models and scenarios, is shifting consumption from simply buying goods to immersive experiences, citing the Wuyi commercial district where the Yuefang mall added traditional-style markets, anime-themed streets and five small theaters and saw over 50 million yuan in new sales in 2025. The segment says Changsha has incubated more than 150 local new-consumption brands, over 20 of which have annual revenue above 100 million yuan, and has repurposed abandoned spaces and old industrial sites into new consumption destinations.

title_en: New Digital Professions Unlock New Employment Potential
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's booming digital economy is spawning new professions and jobs, noting that over 20 new occupations have emerged around embodied AI robots alone with a talent gap exceeding one million, and that the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security has so far released 113 officially designated digital professions.

title_en: 2026 CIFTIS Holds Public Open Day
summary_en: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) held its public open day on September 12, showcasing consumer-oriented technological achievements such as fast-charging platforms for new energy vehicles and VR sports experiences. The fair also hosted 11 forums, 19 matchmaking and promotion sessions, and 24 companies and institutions released 53 new results.

title_en: China's Direct Investment in Other BRICS Countries Grows Steadily
summary_en: China's stock of direct investment in other BRICS countries reached $82 billion by the end of 2025, with about $4 billion invested in January-July of this year, mainly in manufacturing, construction and power. Over the past five years, China has trained more than 30,000 professionals for BRICS countries including Egypt and Indonesia in fields such as commerce, health, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fisheries, and information technology.

title_en: Multiple Leading Indicators Send Positive Signals as Economy's Internal Momentum Continues to Strengthen
summary_en: Citing the latest data from the National Information Center under the National Development and Reform Commission, the segment reports that in August multiple leading indicators sent positive signals, with major project construction accelerating, investment shifting toward computing infrastructure and frontier fields such as AI and humanoid robots, and offline consumer spending rising 2.6% year-on-year for a second consecutive month.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Fujian — Red Heritage Casts the Soul, Green Empowerment Drives Development, Painting a Picture of Comprehensive Revitalization
summary_en: The segment reports on Fujian's former Central Soviet areas in western Fujian, highlighting Ninghua County's ten-thousand-mu national hybrid rice seed-production base entering the heading and flowering stage, red-tourism study routes built around revolutionary sites in Longyan and Sanming under the Long March National Cultural Park, and Changting County's achievements in soil and water conservation, with its experience selected as a UN ecological restoration case. It also notes Fujian's two trillion-yuan industrial clusters in electronics and new energy, including offshore wind and battery production.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends First Session of 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time in New Delhi, President Xi Jinping attended the first session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting and delivered a speech titled "Shouldering Responsibility for Our Times and Being Pioneers of Our Era," marking 20 years of BRICS cooperation and calling on members to be pioneers in innovation, peace and stability, mutual learning among civilizations, and reform of global governance. China will take over the BRICS chairmanship next year and host the 19th BRICS Leaders' Meeting; Cai Qi and Wang Yi also attended.

title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in New Delhi for the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
summary_en: President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi on September 12 at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, where he was warmly received by senior Indian officials at Palam Air Force Base. Cai Qi and Wang Yi accompanied him on the flight, and Chinese Ambassador to India Xu Feihong greeted him at the airport, while local overseas Chinese and representatives of Chinese enterprises waved the flags of China and India to welcome his visit.

title_en: Xi Jinping Leaves Beijing for New Delhi to Attend 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
summary_en: On the morning of September 12, President Xi Jinping flew to New Delhi at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit. Accompanying Xi were Cai Qi, Standing Committee member of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Wang Yi, member of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Foreign Minister.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy claimed it destroyed a US unmanned vessel near the Strait of Hormuz and warned any hostile force would be targeted, while US President Trump denied that US warplanes at a base in Jordan were damaged by Iranian attacks and said he did not regret striking Iran; Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude above $107 a barrel. The segment also reported that Israel said it used over 1,100 tons of explosives to destroy a Hezbollah underground facility in southern Lebanon, and that the flame for the 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games, the first Olympic event in Africa, was handed over in Athens and began its journey to Senegal.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Forces Seize Strategic Red Sea Port City
summary_en: Yemeni government military sources said Houthi forces captured the strategic Red Sea port city of Mocha in Taiz province in southwestern Yemen on the 10th, forcing government troops to withdraw southward, and the same day government forces pulled out of the Hanish Islands, another strategic Red Sea position, where Houthi forces subsequently deployed and established positions. The Houthis said on the 11th that fighting along the Red Sea coast had stopped and that Saudi-assembled forces had been driven out, while Yemeni officials said recent Saudi airstrikes on Houthi targets focused on northern front lines in al-Jawf and Marib provinces, and U.S. media reported that more than 100 U.S. military advisers were providing intelligence support for Saudi operations, with Saudi and U.S. officials not yet responding.

title_en: Pooling Strength to Advance High-Quality 'Greater BRICS Cooperation' — International Figures Eagerly Await President Xi Jinping's Attendance at the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
summary_en: Ahead of President Xi Jinping's trip to India for the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, international figures said China is a firm supporter and participant in the BRICS cooperation mechanism and expressed hope that Xi's visit will help chart a blueprint for high-quality 'Greater BRICS cooperation.' They also noted that China will assume the BRICS chairmanship again next year and voiced expectations that China will pool the collective wisdom and strength of BRICS countries.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the closing of the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade in Xiamen, which drew over 100,000 offline business attendees from 129 countries and regions, along with new cost-accounting rules for important industrial goods aimed at curbing low-price disorderly competition, the completion of more than 5,600 green mines at or above the provincial level, the launch of a market regulator's overseas antitrust compliance service platform, and the opening of the Xiong'an Digital Trade Innovation Development Conference during the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services.

title_en: China Formally Implements Data Property Rights Registration System
summary_en: The National Data Administration announced that China has formally implemented a data property rights registration system, under which registration agencies will issue "identity certificates" for data in various forms, clarifying ownership of rights such as data holding, use, and operation to better support data circulation and trading, inclusion of data assets on balance sheets, financing guarantees, and equity contributions. The national data property rights registration service system also began trial operation the same day, with several data exchanges, including the Beijing International Big Data Exchange, selected as the first registration agencies.

title_en: E-commerce logistics index rebounds month-on-month, sector vitality improves
summary_en: China's e-commerce logistics index rose to 111.5 points in August, up 0.3 points from July, with 8 of 9 sub-indices improving as the rural business volume index climbed 1.1 points to 127.6 and total and rural business volumes both grew over 20% year-on-year, according to the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing.

title_en: Special Presentation Event Held on "The Story of the CPC: The Practice of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era in Shaanxi"
summary_en: The International Department of the CPC Central Committee and the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee co-hosted a special presentation event in Yan'an, Shaanxi, on the 10th under the theme "The 'Two Integrations' Opening the Path to Chinese Modernization," with more than 200 participants from over 50 countries, including political party leaders, think tank scholars, business figures, and media representatives. Foreign guests congratulated the CPC on its 105th anniversary and praised its achievements, expressing willingness to strengthen exchanges with the CPC and promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends and Addresses Opening of 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting
summary_en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the opening of the 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting in Beijing on December 10 and delivered remarks, outlining China's energy achievements under Xi Jinping's "four revolutions, one cooperation" strategy and proposing three points on inclusive sharing, innovation cooperation, and coordinated governance. The meeting, themed "Building an Inclusive, Innovative and Collaborative APEC Energy Community," drew about 300 participants including APEC economy energy ministers and representatives and heads of relevant international organizations.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets with Angolan National Assembly Speaker De Almeida
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, met in Beijing on the 11th with Angolan National Assembly Speaker De Almeida; the two sides discussed implementing the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Lourenço on elevating bilateral ties to a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership, and deepening cooperation in energy, trade, and transportation.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Angolan National Assembly Speaker De Almeida
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks in Beijing with Angolan National Assembly Speaker De Almeida, discussing bilateral cooperation and the comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership between China and Angola, after which the two signed a memorandum of understanding between the NPC and the Angolan National Assembly.

title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Regulation on Market Supervision and Administration Offices
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the Regulation on Market Supervision and Administration Offices, which takes effect on November 1, 2026. The regulation requires these offices, as dispatched agencies of county-level market supervision departments, to uphold Communist Party leadership and a people-centered approach while handling registration of individual businesses, routine food safety oversight, complaint handling, and enforcement of violations within their jurisdictions.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on September 11 that further deployed work on strengthening workplace safety, studied the construction of computing power networks and the comprehensive upgrading of aging reservoirs, heard a report on implementing the spirit of the national education conference and accelerating the building of an education powerhouse, and reviewed and approved the revised draft regulations on the administration of foundations.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Implementing the Global Development Initiative, Pooling Strength for Development and Revitalization
summary_en: The segment reviews the five-year record of the Global Development Initiative that Xi Jinping proposed at the UN General Assembly in September 2021, noting that more than 130 countries and international organizations support it, nearly 100 countries and organizations have signed cooperation documents with China, and the Group of Friends of the GDI has grown to 88 countries. It cites projects including the global development project and funding pools that have mobilized over $23 billion for more than 1,800 projects, juncao technology in Fiji, zero-tariff treatment for 53 African countries, the China-Laos Railway, and a power transmission line in Brazil.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Saudi Arabia and the Houthis struck each other's targets, with the Saudi-led coalition condemning Houthi attacks on Khamis Mushait, Abha and Jizan and vowing a response, while the Houthis reported dozens of Saudi airstrikes in Hodeidah and Taiz; Syria's transitional government condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for illegally entering Syrian territory and declaring "absolute control" over large areas of southern Syria from Mount Hermon in the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights; the WTO's Goods Trade Barometer rose to 102.0, indicating resilient global goods trade growth; and the European Commission approved 114.7 million euros in aid to Spain to help it manage the migration crisis in its enclave of Ceuta.

title_en: US President Says US-Iran Conflict Will End After Midterm Elections; Iran Says US Lacks Ability to Maintain Presence in Region
summary_en: US President Trump said he believes the conflict between the US and Iran will end "immediately" after the November US congressional midterm elections and that the US is not currently considering talks with Iran, while Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps spokesman Mohebbi said the US lacks the ability to maintain a presence in the region and that Iran effectively controls the Strait of Hormuz. The segment also reported that Brent crude futures rose above $100 a barrel amid Middle East tensions.

title_en: Russia Says Japan Should Seriously Reflect on Its Historical Crimes
summary_en: In response to Japan's demand that Russia dismantle a recently unveiled monument commemorating the victory over militarist Japan, Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said on the 9th that Russia advises Japan to seriously reflect on its history of aggression and to clearly acknowledge its war crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the launch of an international anti-telecom-fraud alliance in Lianyungang with 46 founding countries, the establishment of a China-SCO basic education cooperation center in Beijing, and a national standards release of 298 standards, among other domestic items.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Keeping Great Wall Culture Alive Through Protection and Inheritance
summary_en: The segment reports on preservation efforts at the Jielingkou section of the Ming Great Wall in Qinhuangdao, Hebei, including the recent restoration of the "Golden Terrace" watchtower under a minimal-intervention approach, the work of a Great Wall protector who has patrolled the section for 22 years, and nearby ancient villages such as Shichengzi that are developing tourism and ecological agriculture around their Great Wall heritage.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov's visit to Iran for talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and President Masoud Pezeshkian on regional issues; Houthi claims of six missile and drone strikes on Saudi oil, aviation and military targets over 48 hours, with local authorities in Yemen's Shabwa province reporting 53 dead and over 200 wounded in an attack on a military base; US media reporting that Washington has not approved transferring Patriot interceptors to Ukraine, with President Trump again criticizing Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky; France imposing curfews in parts of Paris, Lyon, Lille and Nice after violent protests, with over 2,500 arrests; and flooding in Spain that has killed four people, with about 900,000 residents in Valencia and Alicante areas told to shelter at home.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the first phase of the 140th Canton Fair closed with 189,000 overseas buyers from 214 countries and regions, up 13.3% year-on-year and a record high, and that the South-to-North Water Diversion Project's eastern route began its 2026–2027 water transfer. It also covers 192 million inbound and outbound trips in the third quarter, postal delivery volume up 3.7% in the first three quarters, a second batch of 155 autumn campus recruitment events, and a themed online campaign held in Yichang, Hubei.

title_en: Industrial Value Added Above Designated Size Grows 5.3% Year-on-Year in First Three Quarters
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 20, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reported that China's value-added industrial output above designated size grew 5.3% year-on-year in the first three quarters, with industry contributing about 35% of economic growth and high-tech manufacturing value added rising 14.3%. Industrial enterprise profits rose 15.7% year-on-year in the first eight months, while telecom business volume grew 7.3% and internet business revenue grew 8.9% in January-August.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan: China Compiles Its First Five-Year Plan for Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on October 20 on the Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance 15th Five-Year Plan, which aims by 2030 to complete a full survey of heritage resources, straighten out the regulatory system, and basically form a broad framework for heritage protection. Officials from the National Cultural Heritage Administration, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, and the Office of the Central Cultural Heritage Protection Commission outlined plans including a second national survey of movable cultural relics, a second national survey of intangible cultural heritage, protection and upgrading projects for historic and cultural cities, districts, towns and villages, and legislation on cultural heritage protection.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Founding Meeting of China National Data Group in Xiong'an New Area, Hebei, and Conducts Research
summary_en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the founding ceremony of China National Data Group Co., Ltd. in Xiong'an New Area on the 20th and unveiled the company, describing its establishment as a major strategic decision by the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core and calling for building a world-class data technology enterprise. Ding also visited China Satellite Network Group, the Xiong'an campus of Beijing Jiaotong University, the Xiong'an branch of Peking University People's Hospital and the Xiong'an Zhongguancun Science Park, urging solid progress in relocating and absorbing Beijing's non-capital functions and high-quality development of the new area.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Belarusian Prime Minister
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 19 local time in Dushanbe, Premier Li Qiang met with Belarusian Prime Minister Turchin on the sidelines of the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, with both sides pledging to deepen bilateral cooperation and the all-weather comprehensive strategic partnership. Wu Zhenglong attended the meeting.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Iran's First Vice President
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 19 local time in Dushanbe, during the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, Premier Li Qiang met with Iran's First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref. Li said China has been doing its utmost to promote peace talks and will continue working for regional peace, stability and development, while Aref expressed Iran's support for President Xi Jinping's initiatives on Middle East peace and security and its willingness to resolve differences through dialogue.

title_en: Li Qiang Attends the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) of SCO Member States
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended the 25th meeting of the Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) of Shanghai Cooperation Organization member states in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, on October 20, where he cited Xi Jinping's remarks at the Bishkek summit and called for deeper SCO cooperation and stronger multilateralism. Li and the leaders of other member states signed and issued a joint communique and approved cooperation documents and resolutions on SCO development.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit and Striving on the Road to Rejuvenation: Passing On the Red Bloodline and Winning the Tough Battle to Achieve the Centenary Goal of Military Building
summary_en: The segment reports on the PLA's efforts to carry forward the Long March spirit, highlighting units such as the 'Red Fourth Company' and the 'Dadu River Company,' and cites Xi Jinping's remarks at the 'Half a Quilt' exhibit that the military is the people's army; it also notes that the PLA is focused on combat readiness and training and is determined to meet the centenary goal of military building by 2027.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Continuously Strengthen Political Training, Broadly Build Political Consensus
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program aired a CCTV Quick Comment today (October 20) titled "Continuously Strengthen Political Training, Broadly Build Political Consensus."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating Central Institute of Socialism on 70th Anniversary, Stressing Continued Strengthening of Political Training and Broadly Consolidating Political Consensus to Better Serve the Party and State Work Overall; Wang Huning Attends Celebration and Delivers Speech
summary_en: On the 70th anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter praising the institute's role in training non-Party representative figures and building the patriotic united front, and urging it to strengthen political training and consensus under Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Wang Huning attended the celebration in Beijing, read out the letter, and delivered a speech on implementing Xi's instructions.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on French President Emmanuel Macron condemning violence during protests across France, Iran's declaration of readiness to counter any "adventurist acts" by the US and Israel, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu unveiling new national security principles prioritizing prevention and offense, Canada ruling out external causes in a military base fire that killed four soldiers, and Indonesian forest fires spreading haze across the region.

title_en: Houthi Forces Say Yemen Hit by Hundreds of Saudi Airstrikes; Saudi Arabia Says Houthi Projectile Landed on Its Territory
summary_en: Yemeni media reported that a Saudi airstrike on a house in Saada province killed 10 people and wounded 23, while Houthi forces said Yemen's capital Sanaa and other areas were hit by hundreds of Saudi airstrikes over 24 hours. Saudi civil defense said a projectile fired by Houthi forces landed in a residential area of Najran in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring six Saudi citizens, and the Gulf Cooperation Council condemned the Houthi attacks.

title_en: Russia says it is conducting systematic strikes on Ukraine; Ukraine says it struck a Russian data center
summary_en: Russia's Defense Ministry said Russian forces used precision weapons and drones to carry out large-scale strikes on military-industrial enterprises, cruise missile and drone storage facilities, and a data processing center in Kyiv city and Kyiv Oblast, and Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on the 18th that systematic, large-scale strikes on Ukraine were ongoing and effective. Ukraine said on the 18th that its forces struck a data center in St. Petersburg, causing serious damage, and also hit two Russian oil facilities, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in an interview with U.S. media that he would be willing to consider holding elections before the war ends if Russia agrees to a ceasefire of at least 60 days without additional preconditions.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the 2026 Financial Street Forum in Beijing, where financial regulators released a series of reform and development policies, along with brief items on China's new-type energy storage industry chain, 687 national standards for traditional industries, a consumer environment campaign, China's gold medals at the 5th Asian Para Games, the Jingdezhen International Ceramic Expo, CMG's national short-drama conference, and a cold wave bringing temperature drops to central and eastern China.

title_en: China's Outdoor Sports Industry Thrives
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's outdoor sports industry is booming, citing a National Sports Administration report showing 182,000 fitness trails totaling 430,300 km, 2,626 ice and snow venues, and 308 million participants in ice and snow sports during the 2025-2026 season with consumption of about 205 billion yuan, up roughly 9.3% year on year. It also notes that the National Film Administration and the National Sports Administration launched a "Follow Movies to Sports" initiative to promote cross-sector cooperation between film and sports.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of 'Golden Outer Ring' Linking Border and Coastal Regions
summary_en: CCTV reports that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will fully connect three major land corridors—National Highways 219 and 331 along the borders and Highway 228 along the coast—forming a 'Golden Outer Ring' spanning the country's border and coastal areas. The total construction and upgrading is expected to cover about 7,400 kilometers at an investment of roughly 370 billion yuan.

title_en: 140th Canton Fair: Enriched Full-Chain Supporting Supply Strengthens the Foundation of Global Trade Cooperation
summary_en: The first phase of the 140th Canton Fair, focused on advanced manufacturing, closed on October 19, showcasing a display chain running from core components and intermediate products to finished machines that reflects China's comprehensive industrial system and full-chain supporting capacity. Of the 32,000 exhibitors, nearly 20% have made outbound investments, contributing more than 200,000 local jobs, while the second phase, themed "Quality Home Furnishings," runs October 23-27.

title_en: China Advances Science and Technology-Driven Commerce Through Multiple Measures
summary_en: At an October 19 State Council Information Office press conference, officials from the Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and Ministry of Culture and Tourism outlined the Opinions on Accelerating Science and Technology-Driven Commerce, including 18 measures to deepen integration of technology and commerce. The ministries described efforts to apply AI in manufacturing, consumer goods supply, and cultural and tourism services, with 14 pilot projects selected for "AI plus culture and tourism" applications.

title_en: Central Archives Opens Over 5,000 Long March-Themed Files to the Public
summary_en: To mark the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's victory in the Long March, the Central Archives opened a batch of more than 5,000 Long March-themed archival files to the public starting October 19, mainly documents from October 1934 to October 1936 including CPC programs and declarations, Red Army telegrams and reports on operational deployments and strategy, and Party-run publications. The public may consult the materials at the Central Archives with valid identification such as an ID card or work certificate.

title_en: GDP Grows 4.6% Year-on-Year in First Three Quarters; High-Quality Development Achieves New Results
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on October 19 at which the National Bureau of Statistics reported that GDP for the first three quarters totaled 107.1071 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year at constant prices, in line with the full-year growth target, with the increment reaching 5.7 trillion yuan, the largest for the period in five years. The data showed an improved economic structure, with manufacturing accounting for 25.7% of GDP and domestic demand contributing over 70% of growth, while new drivers such as high-end manufacturing, the digital and intelligent economy, and modern services contributed more than 40% of growth.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets Tajik President Rahmon
summary_en: On the morning of October 19 local time in Dushanbe, Premier Li Qiang met with Tajik President Emomali Rahmon; Li said China is ready to deepen political trust and cooperation with Tajikistan in trade, infrastructure, mining, and law enforcement and security, while Rahmon said Tajikistan firmly upholds the one-China principle and is willing to deepen cooperation across fields.

title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Tajik Prime Minister
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 18 local time in Dushanbe, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Tajik Prime Minister Rasulzoda, discussing deepening bilateral cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative and in trade, energy, and AI, after which the two witnessed the signing of agreements on infrastructure, education, anti-corruption, and standardization; Li also laid a wreath at the Monument of National Reconciliation and Revival.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit on the Road to Rejuvenation: Unwavering Original Aspiration, Enduring Spirit, Writing a New Answer Sheet on the New Long March
summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, the segment recounts Xi Jinping's remarks on the Great Long March Spirit and his visits to revolutionary sites along the route, and highlights recent achievements presented as embodying that spirit, including the Pinglu Canal, the "Heart of Sea Wind" offshore converter station, the Tianwan nuclear plant's Unit 7, the Three Gorges water transport channel, deep-sea neutrino telescope trials, and youth-led rural revitalization in Baini Village, Guangxi.

title_en: Traditional Chinese Festivals: Double Ninth Festival
summary_en: The segment explains the cultural meaning of the Chongyang (Double Ninth) Festival, noting that respect for and care of the elderly has become its most prominent theme, and describes customs such as climbing heights to enjoy autumn scenery, wearing zhuyu, eating chongyang cake, and drinking chrysanthemum tea.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Russia claiming to have downed over a thousand Ukrainian drones while Ukraine says substations were attacked; a convoy of European diplomats, including a French mayor and Belgian and Polish personnel, was attacked by Jewish settlers in the West Bank, drawing condemnation from Palestinian Vice President Hussein al-Sheikh; a fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta caused casualties; wildfires continue in Southern California; and Kenya reported four new Ebola cases.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Forces Claim Downing of Saudi Armed Helicopter; Saudi-Led Coalition Says It Intercepted Multiple Drones
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi forces said Saudi aircraft carried out 53 airstrikes on Sanaa and other areas over the past 24 hours, killing nine people in Taiz province, and claimed to have downed a Saudi armed helicopter near Najran; the Saudi-led coalition said an AH-6i helicopter crashed there due to a technical fault, killing two, and that it destroyed two ballistic missile launch platforms in Saada and intercepted four drones. Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi said Egypt is ready to provide defensive support to Saudi Arabia if requested, and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said during talks with Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty that Iran is willing to help end the Saudi-Houthi conflict and that military means are not the solution in Yemen.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China has completed this year's issuance of 1.3 trillion yuan in ultra-long special treasury bonds, and covers the opening of the fourth Liangzhu Forum in Hangzhou, a 40% year-on-year rise in Shenzhen's trade with APEC economies in the first three quarters, and other domestic items including agricultural, railway, and cultural events.

title_en: Fifth Asian Para Games Opens Today
summary_en: The Fifth Asian Para Games opened today (October 18) in Japan, with Chinese flag bearers Yan Panpan (men's para powerlifting) and Li Yujie (women's para taekwondo) leading the Chinese delegation into the opening ceremony. China has sent 312 athletes to compete in 17 sports and 335 events, with competition for the first gold medals beginning October 19 in powerlifting, cycling, and swimming.

title_en: China Achieves New Breakthrough in First-Ever Cultivation of Two Generations of Rice in Space
summary_en: The Shenzhou-23 crew, more than four months into their mission aboard China's space station, has collected and stored a new batch of rice experiment samples and planted some of the harvested "space seeds," marking China's first successful cultivation of two consecutive generations of rice in space. The experiment, conducted in the Wentian lab module, aims to breed rice for two successive generations under microgravity and to study the genetic stability and adaptability of space-grown crops, with the samples to be returned to Earth aboard the Shenzhou-23 capsule for analysis.

title_en: Reform of National Railway Train Numbering System Launched
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's national railway train numbering system is undergoing a systematic reform, with the number of EMU train number prefixes increasing from four to seven, including a new X prefix for future Fuxing EMU trains with a maximum operating speed above 350 km/h. The numbering changes will be implemented in two batches in late November and late December, with the 12306 and 95306 platforms updating accordingly.

title_en: Three-Year 'Warmth Project' Action Plan for Urban Heating Launched
summary_en: Six departments including the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued a three-year action plan for urban heating, aiming for clear progress by the end of 2028 in renovating aging heating pipe networks. The plan calls for regular assessments of heating facilities, inclusion of pipe networks and heating stations in operation for 20 years or with major risks in renovation plans, and improved mechanisms for responding to public complaints during the heating season.

title_en: China Has Launched 104 Nationwide Cross-Regional Social Insurance Services
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the national social insurance public service platform has launched 104 nationwide, cross-regional services, serving a cumulative 11.353 billion person-times, with over 80% of social insurance business now handled online. The segment highlights new online retirement pre-review and application services in Qingdao and faster pension insurance transfers in Qinhuangdao, where processing now takes five working days or less, plus nine new cross-provincial service items added in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region this year, bringing the total there to 42.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Gansu — Long March Footprints Mark the Land, Red Longyuan Writes a New Chapter
summary_en: The segment reports on Gansu's role as a key province during the Long March and the site of the 1936 meeting of the three main Red Army forces in Huining and Jiangtaibao, and on contemporary efforts to carry forward the Long March spirit, including the Tao River water diversion project serving nearly 6 million people, red tourism in Huining drawing over 8 million visitors this year, and plans under the 15th Five-Year Plan to build advanced manufacturing and new energy industry clusters and modern cold-arid agriculture.

title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in Dushanbe for Official Visit to Tajikistan and to Attend the 25th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers)
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang arrived in Dushanbe on the 18th for an official visit to Tajikistan at the invitation of Tajik Prime Minister Rasulzoda and to attend the 25th meeting of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers). Rasulzoda greeted him at the airport with a welcome ceremony, and Li said China is ready to work with Tajikistan to deepen cooperation and with all SCO parties to implement the Bishkek summit outcomes and ensure the success of the upcoming SCO prime ministers' meeting.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Uzbek President
summary_en: On October 17 in Tashkent, Premier Li Qiang met with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev; Li said China is ready to strengthen strategic communication and expand cooperation in trade, energy, and connectivity, while Mirziyoyev said bilateral ties are in a "golden age" and affirmed Uzbekistan's adherence to the one-China principle. Wu Zhenglong attended the event.

title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Uzbek Prime Minister
summary_en: During a visit to Tashkent, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Uzbek Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov on deepening China-Uzbekistan cooperation in energy, infrastructure, trade and people-to-people exchanges, after which the two sides witnessed the signing of cooperation documents; Li also laid a wreath at Uzbekistan's Independence Monument.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Painting a Happy 'Sunset Red,' Continuously Improving People's Wellbeing
summary_en: The segment reports on China's efforts to expand elderly care services, citing Xi Jinping's emphasis on ensuring seniors live happily and healthily, and noting that by end-2025 there were over 320 million people aged 60 and above and 396,000 elderly care institutions and facilities, with plans to build a three-tier urban-rural care network by 2029.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russia's Defense Ministry said it struck Ukrainian metallurgical and energy facilities in Kryvyi Rih and Zaporizhzhia with precision weapons and drones, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy asked the EU at its summit to provide another 70 billion euros in aid next year; the segment also reported that the U.S. federal budget deficit for fiscal year 2026 is about $1.99 trillion and that London Brent crude futures briefly hit $110 a barrel.

title_en: Yemeni Government Says Aden Airport Attacked; Houthis Say They Struck Saudi Military Targets
summary_en: Yemeni government officials said two missiles landed near a Yemeni Airways passenger plane preparing to take off at Aden International Airport in southern Yemen on the 16th, with no casualties among passengers or crew, and the government condemned the Houthis for attacking the civilian airport. The Houthis said they struck a Saudi military command post and weapons depot at the Badr military base near the airport, and also claimed that the Saudi-led coalition carried out more than 100 airstrikes and missile attacks across Yemen in the past 24 hours, while the coalition said it intercepted and destroyed four drones and three missiles.

title_en: Japanese Figures Say Japan Should Face History and Reflect on War Crimes
summary_en: According to Japanese media reports, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and several politicians offered ritual offerings to Yasukuni Shrine on October 17, and Economic and Fiscal Policy Minister Minoru Kiuchi visited the shrine, which honors 14 Class-A war criminals; Japanese figures criticized right-wing politicians for glorifying the history of aggression and called on Japan to face history and deeply reflect on its war crimes.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that 45 countries jointly released the World Technical and Vocational Education Standards Framework (the Beijing Accord), China's first internationally led vocational education standard; that the Guangzhou Knowledge City Comprehensive Bonded Zone, the Greater Bay Area's first knowledge-oriented bonded zone, began closed operations; that China's outdoor sports industry totals about 3.17 trillion yuan with over 500 million participants; that four more Chinese sites were added to the World Heritage Irrigation Structures list, bringing China's total to 46; and that heavy rain hit North and Northeast China amid a cold snap.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: From Wartime Classrooms and Books on Horseback to the Long March of the New Era
summary_en: The segment profiles Xi'an University of Electronic Science and Technology and Yan'an University, tracing their origins in Red Army radio training and wartime education during the Long March, and highlighting their modern roles in electronic information research and the preservation of revolutionary-era documents.

title_en: Localities Optimize Services to Ensure Warm Winter for Residents
summary_en: With colder weather arriving, northern regions have entered the winter heating season, and localities are proactively assessing needs and upgrading services—including earlier heating in Gansu's Baiyin and parts of Jilin, AI-enabled heating systems in Jinan, and household visits in Xinjiang—to keep residents warm.

title_en: Canton Fair: AI Products Inject New Momentum into Foreign Trade Growth
summary_en: The 140th Canton Fair's offline exhibition entered its third day, with a large batch of AI innovation products showcased as new technologies and applications accelerate, injecting new momentum into foreign trade growth. The fair features 235,000 AI products, and more than 20,000 exhibitors have applied new technologies and models such as the industrial internet and artificial intelligence.

title_en: China's Services Trade Maintains Rapid Growth in First Eight Months
summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce reported that services imports and exports totaled 5.07 trillion yuan in the first eight months of the year, up 7.9% year-on-year, with services exports rising 14.8% and imports up 3.8%. Travel and transport exports drove growth, rising 15.3% and 28.2% respectively, while knowledge-intensive services exports grew 10.9% and accounted for 53.7% of total services exports.

title_en: Wang Huning Conducts Research Visit in Sichuan
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and CPPCC National Committee Chairman Wang Huning visited Chengdu, Deyang, and the Garze Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan from October 13 to 16, where he called for implementing the spirit of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, strengthening the sense of community for the Chinese nation, and advancing the Sinicization of religion and the rule of law in religious affairs. He also inspected CPPCC organs in Sichuan Province and Seda County and visited the Tianfu New Area, research institutions, and Taiwan-funded enterprises.

title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in Tashkent, Begins Official Visit to Uzbekistan
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang arrived in Tashkent on the afternoon of the 17th local time for an official visit at the invitation of Uzbek Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov, who greeted him at the airport with senior government officials and held a welcome ceremony. Li said China and Uzbekistan are good friends, partners and brothers, and that China is ready to work with Uzbekistan to translate the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Bishkek into more practical results.

title_en: Li Qiang Attends and Addresses Opening Ceremony of 2026 World Conference on Traditional Medicine
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Conference on Traditional Medicine in Beijing on October 17 and delivered remarks, citing Xi Jinping's message to the 2024 conference and outlining three points on traditional medicine's role in health and civilizational exchange, China's development path for traditional medicine, and international cooperation; about 1,200 government officials, experts, and practitioners attended, and Yin Li, Liu Guozhong, and Wu Zhenglong also took part.

title_en: Building a Solid Green Foundation, Promoting High-Quality Development Tailored to Local Conditions — General Secretary Xi Jinping's Important Speech During Inspection in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Draws Enthusiastic Response from Cadres and the Public
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia on October 16, giving instructions on coordinating high-quality development with high-level protection and following a path of ecological priority and green development. The segment covers the ecological recovery of Huangqi Lake, progress on the "Three-North" shelterbelt program, and the local green computing industry, with Xi calling on all regions to leverage their comparative advantages to advance high-quality development suited to local conditions.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia's ambassador to Japan protested Tokyo's representations over a Japanese journalist detained in Russia on suspected espionage, that the U.S. Federal Reserve's Beige Book cited broad price pressures from high oil prices, and that the 28th General Conference on Weights and Measures approved abolishing leap seconds starting May 20, 2027.

title_en: Three Chinese women honored with UN FAO 'Women Heroes' award
summary_en: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization held an award ceremony in Rome on the 15th honoring the '100 Women Heroes of Agrifood Systems and Rural Development,' with three Chinese women among the recipients: Yin Yuzhen, a desertification control worker from Inner Mongolia; Yu Jinxiu, a nationally recognized master rural artisan; and Dong Minfang, chairwoman of the Fengrui Agricultural Machinery Cooperative in Yueyang County, Hunan Province. The global initiative, launched by the FAO, commemorates the 2026 International Year of the Woman Farmer and recognizes 100 women for outstanding contributions in agriculture, food systems and rural development.

title_en: Yemeni government says presidential palace attacked; Houthis say they struck Saudi command headquarters
summary_en: Yemeni officials said Houthi forces fired multiple missiles at the presidential palace in Aden on the 15th, killing 5 and wounding 16, while Prime Minister Ahmed bin Daghr was holding a cabinet meeting there and he and attending ministers were safe; the Houthis said the attack targeted Saudi Arabia's military operations command in Aden. The Saudi-led coalition said Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport had been attacked 20 times this month, causing 17 deaths and 333 injuries, while the Houthis said their actions were defensive and that Saudi Arabia had launched more than 2,350 air and missile strikes on Yemen.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's R&D spending reached 3.92882 trillion yuan in 2025, up 8.2% year on year and second in the world, with R&D intensity surpassing the OECD average for the first time; that China's shipbuilding industry has led the global market for 16 consecutive years; and that CCTV's High-Level Interview will air an exclusive interview with Botswana President Duma Boko, who praised Xi Jinping's four global initiatives and called the upgrade of bilateral ties to a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership a milestone.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on October 16, featuring five grassroots representatives from the transportation sector who discussed maintaining the 'sky road' on the northern Tibetan plateau, safeguarding the Three Gorges ship locks through technological innovation, pushing the limits of deep-sea work, honing skills in training, and serving livelihoods on the freight front line.

title_en: China's Smart Grain Storage Construction Achieves Notable Results
summary_en: CCTV reports that autumn grain purchasing is proceeding in an orderly manner nationwide, with over 1,800万吨 of mid- and late-season rice purchased so far, up 1.6 million tons year-on-year, and that a large number of modern smart grain depots have been put into use. It also notes that China's standard grain warehouse capacity has reached 730 million tons, that new technologies such as nitrogen-controlled storage and quasi-low-temperature storage are cutting energy consumption by about 20%, and that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will build more than 100 demonstration sites for integrated green grain storage technologies.

title_en: Over 4,100 Overseas Enterprises to Exhibit at the 9th China International Import Expo
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on October 16, at which a Commerce Ministry official announced that the 9th China International Import Expo will be held in Shanghai from November 5 to 10, with 162 countries, regions and international organizations participating and more than 4,100 overseas enterprises exhibiting, the largest number in the expo's history, including over 2,000 first-time exhibitors. The business exhibition area exceeds 370,000 square meters for the first time, and more than 480 representative products making their global, Asian or Chinese debuts have been confirmed, a record high.

title_en: 140th Canton Fair: Cutting-Edge Innovative Exhibits Connect Global Supply and Demand
summary_en: The first phase of the 140th Canton Fair, focused on advanced manufacturing, showcased the latest products across five sectors—electronics and home appliances, industrial manufacturing, lighting and electrical, hardware and tools, and vehicles and two-wheelers—with more than 12,000 exhibitors, including over 6,000 high-quality firms such as high-tech and specialized SMEs, up about 8.2% year on year. Seventeen zones for emerging future industries featured drones, new energy storage, brain-computer interfaces and new display technologies, drawing foreign buyers to compare specifications and discuss customized solutions.

title_en: China Further Standardizes Pricing of Elderly Care Services
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the National Health Commission jointly released guidance on improving price formation mechanisms to expand affordable elderly care services, classifying care institutions into three types—basic guarantee, affordable support, and fully market-based—and requiring institutions to publish fee schedules, with no charges permitted outside the listed items.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Qinghai — Passing the Torch on the Snowy Plateau, Launching a New Journey of Green Development
summary_en: The segment recounts how Red Army units passed through Baima County in Golog, Qinghai, in July 1936 during the Long March, leaving behind stories of close ties with local Tibetan villagers, and reports that the area now pursues ecological conservation and green development, with herders serving as ecological stewards and developing industries such as Tibetan snow tea cultivation and understory mushroom growing, while Qinghai accelerates construction of a modern green industrial system led by clean energy.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening of 2026 World Vocational and Technical Education Development Conference and Meets Foreign Dignitaries
summary_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Politburo Standing Committee and Vice Premier, attended and addressed the opening of the 2026 World Vocational and Technical Education Development Conference in Tianjin on the 16th, proposing four points on global vocational education cooperation, and met with Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister Ahmad Zahid Hamidi in Beijing on the 15th to discuss bilateral cooperation.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on October 16 that reviewed progress on the "AI Plus" initiative, discussed draft revisions to the Teachers Law and the Price Law for submission to the NPC Standing Committee, and approved amendments and repeals of certain administrative regulations.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating Hunan University on Its 100th Anniversary
summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, sent a letter on the 16th congratulating Hunan University on its 100th anniversary and extending congratulations to all faculty, staff and alumni. In the letter, Xi urged the university to follow Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, carry forward its revolutionary traditions and the heritage of its thousand-year academy, and cultivate more outstanding talent to contribute to building an education powerhouse and advancing Chinese-style modernization.

title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping Article on Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance with Higher Standards and More Concrete Measures
summary_en: The 20th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on October 16, carries an article by Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, titled "Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance with Higher Standards and More Concrete Measures." The article stresses implementing the major decisions and arrangements of the CPC Central Committee, keeping power within institutional cages, and pressing ahead with the anti-corruption struggle, and describes the "15th Five-Year Plan" period as a key stage for laying a solid foundation for basically achieving socialist modernization.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Unswervingly Follow the Path of Ecological Priority and Green Development
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the station aired a CCTV Quick Commentary today (October 16) titled "Unswervingly Follow the Path of Ecological Priority and Green Development."

title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses Coordinating High-Quality Development and High-Level Protection During Inspection in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Firmly Following Path of Ecological Priority and Green Development
summary_en: Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia on the 16th, visiting the Huangqihai Nature Reserve to review wetland restoration and ecological protection, and the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone to learn about the "East Data, West Computing" project and green computing industry, calling for coordinated high-quality development and high-level protection and firm adherence to ecological priority and green development.

title_en: International News Roundup
