summary_en: The segment reports that Russia's Defense Ministry said its air defenses intercepted 69 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones and 4 missiles during an attack on a refinery in Ryazan Oblast, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine had paused strikes on Russian energy infrastructure for three days at the U.S. request and would resume them; it also covers the IEA's warning that tight global diesel supply will persist into 2027, U.S. September CPI rising 3.7% year-on-year, and Japanese Agriculture Minister Ryu Wasei resigning over scandals nearly a month after a cabinet reshuffle.

title_en: Frequent Ship Attacks and Other Incidents in the Strait of Hormuz This Month
summary_en: According to International Maritime Organization data, 22 ships have encountered attacks and other incidents in and around the Strait of Hormuz this month as of the 14th; Singapore's Maritime and Port Authority said two Singapore-registered container ships were hit by unidentified projectiles while transiting the strait since the 13th, with one catching fire and sinking and the other suffering hull damage, while Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said a cargo ship carrying 2,500 containers attempted to pass through an unauthorized dangerous channel, struck a mine, exploded, caught fire and sank, and U.S. Central Command said U.S. forces struck an Iran-related vessel in the Gulf of Oman on the 6th.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Armed Forces Claim Another Attack on Saudi Capital Airport; Saudi Arabia Says It Intercepted Houthi Ballistic Missile
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi armed forces said on the 14th that the Saudi-led multinational coalition carried out 42 airstrikes that day on Sanaa, Taiz Province, Hodeidah Province and other locations in Yemen, and that the group again used a ballistic missile to attack King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Multinational coalition spokesman Maliki said on the 14th that the coalition intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by the Houthi armed forces toward Riyadh that day.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the third round's seventh batch of central ecological and environmental protection inspections has fully begun, that multiple departments launched a two-month campaign against improper online military-related marketing and hype, and that the National Intellectual Property Administration and General Administration of Customs issued guidance on strengthening coordinated intellectual property protection. It also covers the 140th Canton Fair's boost to inbound passenger traffic at Guangzhou ports, China's first cross-border centralized trade of green certificates to Hong Kong, the opening of a communications and sensing network in the Bohai Sea, a rebound in the September China warehousing index, the Zhuque-2 improved rocket's ten-satellite launch, the Ministry of Education's establishment of a Xiong'an teacher development center, the opening of the 115th National Sugar and Wine Fair in Nanjing, and the broadcast of the documentary "The Great Expedition" marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory.

title_en: Construction of China's First Batch of National Parks Achieves Notable Results
summary_en: CCTV reports that five years after the establishment of China's first five national parks, a national park system with Chinese characteristics has basically taken shape, with improvements in ecosystem quality and flagship species populations—including Tibetan antelope in Sanjiangyuan recovering to over 70,000 and Hainan gibbons growing to 44 individuals in seven groups. The segment also notes that 75% of ecological benefit evaluation indicators for the first batch of national parks were rated excellent.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Nationwide Enters Peak Period, Progress Past 60 Percent
summary_en: China's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reports that the national autumn grain harvest has entered its peak period with progress past 60 percent, with favorable conditions in the Northeast, Huang-Huai-Hai, Yangtze River, Southwest, and Northwest regions, and a bumper harvest expected this year.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Passing the Torch to the Future, Writing a New Chapter in Governing Sichuan and Developing the Region
summary_en: The segment recounts the Red Army's campaigns in Sichuan, including the May 1935 seizure of the Anshunchang ferry and the push to take the Luding Bridge, and reports that Sichuan is now building the 96.5-kilometer Luding-Shimian expressway, developing Long March heritage tourism that has boosted red-tourism site visits by over 15 percent annually, and planning under the 15th Five-Year Plan to foster new quality productive forces and build six trillion-yuan-scale industries and five national advanced manufacturing clusters.

title_en: Strong oversight used to resolve urgent public concerns
summary_en: CCTV reports that since 2024 the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission has run a nationwide campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting ordinary people, citing cases in Jiangxi (misuse of township funds for a pond renovation), Gansu (rural collective asset management, with 108.36 million yuan recovered and 76.68 million yuan of village debt resolved), and Zhejiang (property management irregularities). It says the campaign has resolved 6.98 million public concerns and investigated 2.253 million cases harming public interests, with 1.555 million people disciplined.

title_en: Li Qiang to visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, attend SCO Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) Council 25th meeting, and hold 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting in Russia
summary_en: At the invitation of Uzbek Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov, Chinese Premier Li Qiang will pay an official visit to Uzbekistan from October 17 to 18. At the invitation of Tajik Prime Minister Kokhir Rasulzoda, Li will pay an official visit to Tajikistan from October 18 to 20 and attend the 25th meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers); at the invitation of Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin, Li will travel to Russia from October 20 to 22 for the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting.

title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Togo's Prime Minister
summary_en: After a welcome ceremony, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Togo's Prime Minister Victoire Tomegah Dogbé (referred to in the broadcast as "Faure"), discussing deepening China-Togo cooperation in connectivity, infrastructure, agriculture, and finance, and the two sides signed cooperation documents and issued a joint statement on building a China-Togo community with a shared future for the new era.

title_en: Li Qiang Holds Ceremony to Welcome Togo's Prime Minister for Visit to China
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on the afternoon of the 15th for Togo's Prime Minister Victoire Tomegah Dogbé, who is on an official visit to China. State Councilor and Secretary-General of the State Council Wu Zhenglong attended, military bands played the national anthems of both countries, and Li Qiang accompanied the Togolese prime minister in inspecting the PLA honor guard.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Botswana President
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 15th with Botswana President Duma Boko, who was on a state visit to China. The two sides discussed deepening bilateral cooperation under the guidance of the two heads of state, including Belt and Road cooperation and collaboration in mining, digital, green and cultural fields, and Boko reaffirmed Botswana's adherence to the one-China principle.

title_en: Li Qiang delivers video address at opening ceremony of new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang said in a video address that the new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge is an important project jointly promoted by Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un, and that its opening will become a new landmark symbolizing China-DPRK friendship. DPRK Cabinet Premier Pak Thae Song also delivered a video address.

title_en: Building a Balanced, Inclusive, High-Quality and Efficient Healthy China: Xi Jinping's Important Speech Inspires Health Workers to Fulfill Their Duties and Take Responsibility
summary_en: The segment reports that Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the National Health Conference, stressing that safeguarding people's health should be integrated into all policies and reflected in all areas of work. Health workers across China responded enthusiastically, pledging to follow the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and ensure decisive progress in building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, with the goal of completing a Healthy China by 2035.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Russian claims of downing 902 Ukrainian drones overnight and strikes on Kyiv's energy infrastructure, a cargo ship sinking in the Black Sea near Bulgaria with 11 sailors missing, the opening in Hamburg of Germany's first trial over the Nord Stream pipeline explosions involving Ukrainian suspect Serhiy, and European gas prices rising to their highest level in nearly four years.

title_en: Saudi-led coalition and Yemen's Houthi forces strike each other's energy facilities
summary_en: The Saudi-led multinational coalition said on October 13 that it struck key Houthi facilities in Yemen, including the Sabahah central station of the Yemen Oil Company in Sanaa and fuel storage, transport and unloading facilities in Hodeidah, and that it intercepted missiles and drones fired toward Riyadh and Dhahran. The Houthis said on October 14 that they struck Saudi Aramco's headquarters in Dhahran, its refinery in Riyadh and King Khalid International Airport in retaliation for Saudi strikes on Sanaa and Hodeidah, while Yemeni media reported that coalition airstrikes on fuel facilities in Hodeidah killed two people and wounded two others.

title_en: Russia Arrests Japanese National Suspected of Espionage
summary_en: Russia's Federal Security Service said on the 13th that it had arrested a Japanese national, described as a journalist, in Sakhalin Oblast on suspicion of espionage, alleging he collected and stored intelligence related to Russian defense and acted on instructions from Japanese intelligence agencies. Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said Tokyo's actions would further worsen Russia-Japan relations, while Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi said on October 14 that Japan had lodged a protest and requested information from Russia.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Central Office for Law-Based Governance launched an inspection of officials' compliance with the law in eight provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, and covers the 2026 social insurance service campaign, a push to strengthen rural elderly-care worker teams, a September rebound in the e-commerce logistics index, a new mineral resources catalogue, People's Bank of China approval for Visa to prepare a domestic bank card clearing institution, and the autumn poplar viewing season in Xinjiang.

title_en: Preparations for the 33rd World University Winter Games Progress in an Orderly Manner
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 14, officials from the Ministry of Education, the General Administration of Sport, and the Jilin Provincial People's Government briefed on preparations for the Changchun 2027 33rd World University Winter Games, to be held January 15-25, 2027, with Changchun as the main venue and Jilin City as a sub-venue. The Games will feature 12 sports and 97 events, with 3,716 people from 63 countries and regions already registered—the most in the event's history—and China plans to compete in 11 sports, while organizers are renovating 13 existing venues rather than building new ones, to be opened to the public after the Games.

title_en: Outstanding Social Financing Stock Up 7.1% Year-on-Year at End of September
summary_en: The People's Bank of China reported that at the end of September, broad money (M2) stood at 359.63 trillion yuan, up 7.2% year-on-year, while the outstanding stock of social financing reached 468.17 trillion yuan, up 7.1% year-on-year. In the first three quarters, bond and equity financing together accounted for 49.5% of social financing increments, nearly 7 percentage points more than loans, and RMB loans increased by 11.52 trillion yuan, with funds flowing more toward technological innovation, green development, and small and medium-sized enterprises.

title_en: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Total 39.94 Trillion Yuan in First Three Quarters
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 14, the General Administration of Customs reported that China's goods trade imports and exports reached 39.94 trillion yuan in the first three quarters of the year, up 18.8% year on year, with exports at 23.2 trillion yuan (up 16.4%) and imports at 16.74 trillion yuan (up 22.3%). September alone saw imports and exports of 5.16 trillion yuan, surpassing 5 trillion yuan for the first time and growing 27.5%.

title_en: China's Consumer Prices Remain Stable in First Three Quarters
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on October 14 shows that in the first three quarters of this year, China's consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.9% year on year, with September up 0.9% year on year, 0.1 percentage point higher than the previous month, keeping the overall price level stable. The producer price index (PPI) rose 2.3% year on year in the first three quarters and 5.0% in September, marking seven consecutive months of increase.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Road to Rejuvenation: Yunnan Advances on the New-Era Long March Through Concrete Achievements
summary_en: The segment reports on Yunnan's role as a key route of the Red Army's Long March, recalling how 37 boatmen at Jiaopingdu helped the Central Red Army cross the Jinsha River in 1935-36, and highlights the Wudongde Hydropower Station built there in 2020 as part of the world's largest clean-energy corridor. It also outlines Yunnan's plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period to strengthen plateau agriculture, cultural tourism, and green energy, develop strategic emerging industries, and advance ethnic unity, ecological conservation, and its role as a hub for South and Southeast Asia.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Representatives of Tsinghua SEM Advisory Board
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang met in Beijing with representatives of the Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management Advisory Board, discussing AI development and governance and inviting them to support the World AI Cooperation Organization. Advisory Board Chairman Tim Cook and other members praised China's achievements in AI and expressed willingness to deepen cooperation in China.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets Representatives Attending 2026 International Parliamentary Friendship Exchange Forum
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing on the 14th with representatives from various countries attending the 2026 International Parliamentary Friendship Exchange Forum, where he cited President Xi Jinping's vision of building a community with a shared future for mankind and the four global initiatives, and briefed them on China's 15th Five-Year Plan.

title_en: Li Qiang Attends 'Canton Fair Connects the World for 70 Years' Symposium
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended a symposium in Guangzhou marking the 70th anniversary of the Canton Fair, telling about 70 business representatives from nearly 30 countries and regions that China will keep improving its open and innovative ecosystem and foreign investment environment, and vowing to build a smarter, greener and more people-centered Canton Fair. Before the symposium, Li viewed a themed exhibition and presented commemorative badges and certificates to veteran Canton Fair participants.

title_en: Li Qiang attends opening ceremony of 140th China Import and Export Fair and delivers keynote speech
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended the opening of the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou on the 14th and delivered a keynote address, saying China will keep pursuing high-quality development and high-level opening up; WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala also addressed the event by video, and Li toured the fair's enterprise pavilion afterward.

title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at National Health Conference Draws Warm Response, Vowing to Keep Improving Public Health and Ensure Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the National Health Conference convened for the first time in 10 years, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech stressing adherence to a health development path with Chinese characteristics and ensuring decisive progress in building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. The segment says the speech drew warm responses, with participants pledging to implement health-first development, prioritize prevention, and strengthen primary-level medical services.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Continuously Injecting New Momentum into World Development and Prosperity
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reported that the station aired a CCTV Quick Comment today (October 14) titled "Continuously Injecting New Momentum into World Development and Prosperity."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the 140th China Import and Export Fair
summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair), which opened in Guangzhou on October 14, co-hosted by the Ministry of Commerce and the Guangdong Provincial People's Government. In the letter, Xi said the fair has played an important role in promoting trade between China and other countries over its 70-year history and has become an effective platform for China's high-level opening-up, and he expressed China's willingness to work with other countries to uphold the multilateral trading system and keep global industrial and supply chains stable and smooth.

title_en: News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the revised Measures for the Protection and Management of Martyrs' Memorial Facilities will take effect on November 1, that events marking the 77th anniversary of the Young Pioneers were held nationwide, and that a themed online campaign on the Long March was launched in Yudu, Jiangxi; it also covers the 16th China Airshow in Zhuhai in December, Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia and a warning to the United States, a new EU sanctions package against Russia and Moscow's pledge to respond, and a cyberattack on refrigeration systems at hundreds of French supermarkets.

title_en: First-instance verdict in Myanmar Wei family telecom fraud case
summary_en: The Quanzhou Intermediate People's Court and Nan'an People's Court in Fujian Province publicly announced first-instance verdicts in the series of cases involving the Wei family criminal group, sentencing Wei Huairen, Chen Dawei and Liao Jingfang to death and 58 others, including Wei Qingtao, to terms ranging from life imprisonment to three years and three months, along with fines, confiscation of property and deportation. The court found that the Wei family criminal group, led by Wei Huairen and others, ran compounds in Myanmar's Kokang region to carry out telecom and online fraud and intentional homicide, involving more than 12.2 billion yuan in gambling and fraud funds and causing the deaths of four Chinese citizens.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on October 13 featuring five representatives from the meteorological field, who discussed weather monitoring, forecasting and early warning, intelligent typhoon forecasting models, island and plateau meteorological services, and grassroots meteorological disaster prevention and mitigation under the theme 'Monitoring and Forecasting to Protect Against Cold and Heat, Meteorological Services Benefiting People's Livelihood.'

title_en: 140th Canton Fair launches over 50 innovative measures to improve exhibition service efficiency
summary_en: The 140th Canton Fair will introduce more than 50 innovative measures to improve service efficiency, including 22 smart application scenarios and 16 AI-powered applications, as well as over 230 quality service providers offering full-cycle, one-stop support for companies and products going global.

title_en: Zhao Leji Meets Separately with Botswana President and Togo's Prime Minister
summary_en: National People's Congress Chairman Zhao Leji met in Beijing on October 13 with Botswana President Duma Boko and Togo's Prime Minister Victoire Tomegah Dogbé (referred to as chairman of the ministers' council), discussing bilateral cooperation and legislative exchanges; both visiting leaders later laid wreaths at the Monument to the People's Heroes in Tiananmen Square.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Madise on Assuming Estonian Presidency
summary_en: On October 12, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Jüri Madise congratulating her on assuming the presidency of the Republic of Estonia, noting the two countries' traditional friendship and steady development of bilateral relations, and expressing willingness to work with President Madise to deepen political mutual trust, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and enhance people-to-people exchanges, using the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations this year as an opportunity.

title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Togo's Prime Minister
summary_en: President Xi Jinping met with Togo's Prime Minister Victoire Tomegah Dogbé (Faure Gnassingbé) in Beijing, and the two sides announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Togo community with a shared future for the new era. Xi also set out four principles for constructive international involvement in African hotspot issues, while the Togolese leader praised China's modernization achievements and called for deeper cooperation.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Botswana President Duma Boko
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 13, President Xi Jinping held talks at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing with Botswana President Duma Boko, who was on a state visit to China; the two heads of state announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership. The segment also covered Xi's four-point proposal on China-Botswana and China-Africa mining cooperation, the signing of cooperation documents, a joint statement, and the welcome ceremony and banquet held for Boko and his wife.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome Botswana's President on Visit to China
summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 13th for Botswana President Duma Gideon Boko, who is on a state visit to China. The ceremony included a 21-gun salute, the playing of both national anthems, and a review of the PLA honor guard, with Peng Liyuan and Wang Yi in attendance.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Ensure Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The station aired a CCTV Quick Commentary today (October 13) titled "Ensure Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China."

title_en: Xi Jinping stresses unswervingly following the path of health development with Chinese characteristics at the National Health Conference, ensuring decisive progress in building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period
summary_en: The National Health Conference was held in Beijing from the 12th to 13th, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech stressing that the 15th Five-Year Plan period is key to achieving the goal of building a Healthy China by 2035. Li Qiang gave a concluding speech, and Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi attended.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Rezaei said the United States has accepted some of Iran's seven conditions, that a migrant boat capsized off Djibouti killing 139 people, and that Hurricane Simon caused flooding and heavy rain in western Mexico.

title_en: Riyadh Airport Attacked Again; Yemen's Houthis Claim Multiple Strikes on Saudi Facilities
summary_en: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was attacked again on the 11th, killing one person and wounding 11, and Dammam's King Fahd International Airport was also hit; the Saudi-led coalition said on the 12th it intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Yemen's Houthis toward Khamis Mushait. The Houthis said they carried out four missile and drone operations against Saudi airports and energy facilities in 24 hours, calling them a response to intensified Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, while Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal in a phone call that Iran was willing to provide assistance to facilitate dialogue between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on China's launch of a special campaign to systematically renovate and upgrade aging reservoirs, the start of the third round's seventh batch of central ecological and environmental protection inspections covering two ministries and seven provincial-level regions, and a Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission opinion on strictly handling food-safety crimes. It also covers a seven-department push to cultivate quality e-commerce, Supreme People's Procuratorate typical cases on protecting Long March cultural relics, the opening of the 2026 Beijing reform forum on handling public complaints, the first exhibits clearing customs for the ninth China International Import Expo, and the 47th World Congress of Vine and Wine opening in Yinchuan, Ningxia.

title_en: 2026 China Open concludes, multiple records set
summary_en: The 2026 China Open concluded in Beijing on the evening of October 11, with Chinese wildcard Zheng Qinwen defeating fourth seed Mirra Andreeva of Russia 2-0 in the women's singles final to become the first Chinese player to win a singles title in the tournament's 20-year history. A Chinese player also paired with a Czech player to take the women's doubles runner-up spot, China's best result at the event, while match count, attendance and overall ticket revenue all set new tournament records.

title_en: Digital and intelligent upgrading of China's service sector accelerates
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China is accelerating digital and intelligent upgrades across its service sector, with over 60% of large service enterprises using cloud computing and 20.2% deploying AI applications, and cites examples such as digitalized gas stations in Wuhan and credit-based medical treatment in Xiamen's Siming District.

title_en: New energy vehicle production and sales achieve relatively high growth in first three quarters
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers released data on October 12 showing that in January–September, China's new energy vehicle production and sales reached 12.483 million and 12.472 million units respectively, up 11% and 11.1% year on year, with NEVs accounting for 53.6% of total new vehicle sales. The segment also noted the release of the "15th Five-Year Plan" for the intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry, which sets out directions for high-quality development of the sector.

title_en: Forging a Strong Sense of Community: Inner Mongolia Builds a Better Northern Border Homeland Together
summary_en: The segment reports that Inner Mongolia, China's first provincial-level ethnic autonomous region, has made forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation its central task, highlighting community "Red Pomegranate Stations" in Hohhot, the decades-old "Red Backpack" volunteer service in Sonid Right Banner, and achievements in new energy, green computing and border trade, along with 3.539 billion yuan in ethnic minority development funds and 3,640 common-prosperity projects during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: Wang Huning Attends Commemorative Meeting Marking 70th Anniversary of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese
summary_en: Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, attended and addressed a meeting in Beijing marking the 70th anniversary of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, where he conveyed Xi Jinping's emphasis on work concerning returned overseas Chinese and overseas compatriots and called on the federation to unite overseas Chinese in contributing to socialist modernization and national rejuvenation.

title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman, Co-Chairs Second Meeting of China-Vietnam Legislative Joint Committee
summary_en: National People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks in Beijing with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man and co-chaired the second meeting of the China-Vietnam Legislative Joint Committee, with both sides pledging to deepen legislative exchanges and practical cooperation. Tran Thanh Man said Vietnam regards relations with China as a strategic choice and top priority in its foreign policy.

title_en: Li Qiang Speaks by Phone with New Zealand Prime Minister
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang held a phone call with New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon on the 12th, with Li calling for closer China-New Zealand coordination in support of multilateralism and free trade and for expanded cooperation in trade, new energy vehicles and cultural exchanges ahead of the 55th anniversary of diplomatic ties next year. Luxon reaffirmed New Zealand's firm commitment to the one-China policy and expressed support for China hosting the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing on the 12th with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man, with Li calling for continued friendship and expanded cooperation in trade, investment, connectivity, AI, clean energy and people-to-people exchanges, and Tran reaffirming Vietnam's one-China policy and commitment to building a higher-level Vietnam-China community with a shared future. Wang Dongming also attended the meeting.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Putting the People at the Center, Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China
summary_en: The segment reports that since the 18th Party Congress the CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has prioritized public health, citing over 1.1 million medical institutions, more than 16 million health workers, average life expectancy of 79.25 years in 2025, and expanded county-level medical communities, drug procurement, and early screening programs under the Healthy China initiative.

title_en: Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 50th Anniversary of China-PNG Diplomatic Relations; Li Qiang and PNG Prime Minister Exchange Congratulatory Messages
summary_en: On October 12, President Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Bob Dadae exchanged congratulatory messages marking the 50th anniversary of diplomatic ties, with Xi calling PNG a good friend, partner and brother of China and pledging to advance the comprehensive strategic partnership. The same day, Premier Li Qiang and PNG Prime Minister James Marape exchanged congratulatory messages, with Li urging faster high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and Marape reaffirming PNG's adherence to the one-China principle.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Russia partially lifted its diesel export ban, allowing 500,000 tons onto the global market, with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy calling for greater European aid and pressure on Russia and U.S. President Donald Trump urging Ukraine to halt attacks on Russian oil facilities and hold presidential elections; it also covers attacks on two merchant ships near the Strait of Hormuz, rallies in multiple countries in support of Palestine, and the impact of Hurricane Isaias on Gulf of Mexico oil and gas production.

title_en: Riyadh Airport Attack Kills 12, Injures 309
summary_en: Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was attacked by Yemen's Houthi forces on October 10, killing 12 people and injuring 309, including passengers and airport staff, according to statements from Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority and the Saudi-led coalition; the Houthis also said they closed the airport and warned that other Saudi airports and airspace could be targets, while reporting that the Saudi-led coalition struck Sanaa International Airport and communications facilities in Hajjah Province.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that four Chinese government departments issued draft rules tightening safety requirements for automotive products, including banning fully concealed door handles and foldable displays; that nationwide second-hand home transaction area rose 10.7% year-on-year in the first nine months of the year; that China's enterprise credit index rose to 161.32 in August; that the Ministry of Education launched nationwide AI literacy training for teachers; that booth construction for the first phase of the 140th Canton Fair is nearly complete ahead of its October 15 opening; and that the "2026 World Mayor Dialogue · Luoyang" event was held in Henan from October 9 to 11 with mayors and representatives from more than 10 countries.

title_en: Distinctive autumn sightseeing drives cultural and tourism consumption
summary_en: The segment reports that autumn scenery across China is drawing crowds and boosting cultural tourism spending, highlighting destinations such as the 450,000-mu Euphrates poplar forest in Ejina Banner, Inner Mongolia; red maple forests in Benxi, Liaoning; and autumn scenes in Hailin, Heilongjiang, where local authorities are combining scenery with food markets and cultural performances to encourage deeper visitor experiences. It also notes rural autumn harvest tourism in Dongping Village, Quzhou, Zhejiang, where the village's comprehensive tourism revenue exceeded 2 million yuan during the recent National Day holiday, up about 80% year on year, and the sun-drying season in Huangling ancient village, Wuyuan, Jiangxi.

title_en: Frontline Research: The "Careful Calculations" of an Old Street
summary_en: The segment reports on how Nanjing's Laomendong, a historic street over 600 years old, is revitalizing its commercial district by curbing shop homogenization through differentiated positioning and refined operations, including data-monitored store performance, curated tenant selection, and new consumer experiences. It highlights how the street's management analyzes social media feedback to guide offerings and how Nanjing is piloting new consumption formats and scenarios.

title_en: Results of the Third Xinjiang Comprehensive Scientific Expedition Released
summary_en: On October 10, the results of the Third Xinjiang Comprehensive Scientific Expedition were released in Urumqi, reporting that water resources have continued to increase, with average annual river runoff over the past 30 years up about 10 billion cubic meters compared with the previous 40 years, and lake and wetland area expanding by roughly one-third. The expedition, launched in 2021 and involving 46 research institutions and more than 6,000 participant-visits, also identified over 22 million mu of contiguous selenium-rich soil in the Tarim Basin, discovered 33 new species and 243 new records for China or Xinjiang, and confirmed 77.5 billion tons of oil-rich coal reserves in the Turpan-Hami Basin.

title_en: New Huanggang Port Completed, to Open Tomorrow
summary_en: The new Huanggang Port connecting Shenzhen and Hong Kong, rebuilt over seven years on the original site, was completed and will open tomorrow, offering 24-hour customs clearance for passengers and passenger vehicles. The world's largest single land-border checkpoint building, it uses a "co-located two-tier inspection" and "joint inspection, single release" model, cutting passenger clearance time from 30 minutes to 5 minutes, and the old temporary passenger terminal will close when it opens.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Silent Witnesses, Immortal Faith
summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, the segment visits the Xiangjiang Campaign memorial hall and recounts the sacrifices of Red 34th Division commander Chen Shuxiang and Red 1st Corps political commissar Yi Dangping during the 1934 Xiangjiang Campaign, honoring the faith of revolutionary martyrs.

title_en: China's hydrogen energy industry enters fast lane of development
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's hydrogen energy industry has accelerated across production, transport, storage and applications, with pilot integrated hydrogen applications launched in five city clusters including Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. China accounts for over half of global hydrogen capacity and produces more than 39 million tons of hydrogen annually, ranking first in the world, while the 15th Five-Year Plan includes hydrogen in the non-fossil energy supply system for the first time and the country's first inter-provincial hydrogen pipeline, from Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia to Beijing's Yanshan Petrochemical, is under construction.

title_en: Number of major water conservancy projects started in first three quarters exceeds all of last year
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has accelerated construction of its national water network, with more major water conservancy projects breaking ground in the first three quarters of this year than in all of last year, including the Three Gorges shipping new channel project and the Gezhouba shipping capacity expansion, whose upstream and downstream cofferdams began construction on the 10th. The segment also covers the Shangbaishi water conservancy hub in Ningde, Fujian, the Tiaoxi flood control project in the Taihu basin, and progress on rural water supply, with rural tap water coverage expected to reach 97% by year's end.

title_en: China's Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Expands for Fifth Consecutive Month
summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported that the September logistics industry prosperity index rose 0.6 percentage points from the previous month to 51.5%, remaining in expansion territory for a fifth straight month, with the new orders index up for a seventh consecutive month and 10 of 12 sub-indices improving. The segment said business activity expectations jumped 1.8 percentage points and that logistics operations are expected to maintain steady progress in the fourth quarter as the "six networks" construction unfolds.

title_en: Wang Huning Meets with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman
summary_en: Wang Huning, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), met in Beijing on the 11th with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man; the two sides discussed deepening China-Vietnam relations and building a China-Vietnam community with a shared future, with Tran Thanh Man reaffirming Vietnam's adherence to the one-China policy.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Protecting Lucid Waters and Lush Mountains, Jointly Painting a New Picture of Beautiful China
summary_en: The segment reports on ecological protection efforts guided by Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization, citing progress on Erhai Lake in Yunnan, the Three-North Shelterbelt Program's desert-control work in Xinjiang's Hotan region, and drone-assisted afforestation in Yichun and Zhouning, along with targets for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed 136 Houthi targets in Yemen, that Iran's Revolutionary Guard warned its actions against violating vessels would extend beyond the Strait of Hormuz, that UAE prosecutors say a flydubai co-pilot attempted a suicide attack on Tel Aviv's Ben Gurion airport, that a magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck Panama injuring 27 people, and that Hurricane Isaias made landfall in Florida, leaving over 660,000 users without power.

title_en: Russia to Supply Oil to US and Global Markets; US Eases Sanctions on Russian Diesel Trade
summary_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin confirmed in a phone call with US President Donald Trump that Russia will supply oil and petroleum products to the US and global markets, with over 300,000 tons of diesel due this month and 500,000 tons in November, while the US Treasury said it would ease sanctions on Russian diesel trade to relieve tight domestic supply. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said easing sanctions on Russia without a clear and lasting de-escalation agreement is obvious weakness, and Ukrainian media reported that talks in Miami involving Ukraine, the US and European countries ended early.

title_en: Japanese Civil Groups Submit Petition Opposing Government's Military Expansion
summary_en: Forty-one civil groups from Okinawa, Kyushu and other regions of Japan submitted a petition at the House of Councillors members' office building in Tokyo to representatives of Japan's Ministry of Defense and Ministry of Foreign Affairs, expressing doubts and dissatisfaction over the government's continued expansion of defense spending and military deployment. International figures warned that Japan's ongoing remilitarization threatens regional and global security and that the international community should remain highly vigilant.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a roundup of domestic news: the State Council Disabled Persons Work Committee issued the National Disability Prevention Action Plan (2026–2030) with 18 main indicators; the financial regulator released rules on property insurance product development; national railways adopted a new freight train schedule including 96 China-Europe freight train routes; China launched the 27th group of low-orbit satellite internet satellites from Hainan; the national foreign-related legal service platform "Fatong" went online; market regulators reported stable safety conditions for tourism-related special equipment during the National Day holiday; the Yantai-Weihai 1,000 kV ultra-high-voltage project was completed and put into operation; Xinjiang cotton harvesting is nearly halfway done; the 35th Feitian TV Drama Awards and 29th Starlight Awards were held in Yantai; and CCTV launched its 2027 Brand Power Strategy initiative and national brand trusted corpus platform.

title_en: China's Sports Delegation for the 5th Asian Para Games Formed Today
summary_en: China's sports delegation for the 5th Asian Para Games was established in Beijing on October 10, comprising 500 people including 312 athletes from 25 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, with an average age of 28.8, who will compete in 17 sports and 335 events. This is China's largest delegation ever sent to an overseas Asian Para Games; the Games will be held in Japan from October 18 to 24, with more than 3,000 athletes from 45 countries and regions expected to take part.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Meeting with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a 'Strivers on the New Journey' meeting with Chinese and foreign journalists on October 10. Five representatives from the procuratorial system discussed strengthening procuratorial supervision and fulfilling the duties of the state legal supervision organ, sharing stories of combating crime, safeguarding social order, and protecting the rights and interests of minors.

title_en: China's Migratory Bird Populations Grow Steadily
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's migratory bird populations have grown steadily as habitat quality improved, with 1,505 bird species recorded nationwide, 821 key habitats under strengthened protection, and 6.324 million wintering waterbirds counted this year, 81.8% of them in protected areas.

title_en: Strong Demand for Services Consumption During National Day Holiday; Goods Consumption Grows Well
summary_en: Citing the State Taxation Administration's latest VAT invoice data, CCTV reports that nationwide services consumption was robust during the National Day holiday, with average daily sales revenue in related industries up 19.5% year on year, including over 20% growth in tourism and entertainment services, 9% growth in catering services, 20.9% growth in cultural and arts services, nearly 30% growth in sports services, and over 40% growth in home appliance and audiovisual equipment sales, with communications equipment such as mobile phones and smart bands more than doubling.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Passes Halfway Nationwide as Autumn and Winter Planting Begins
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's autumn grain harvest has passed the halfway mark, with concentrated harvesting underway in major producing areas such as Heilongjiang's soybean fields, Jilin's rice paddies, and Shaanxi's corn belt, while winter wheat planting proceeds in Henan. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs has dispatched six working groups and science teams to 12 key provinces to guide autumn harvest and planting work.

title_en: Leading indicators release positive signals; economic recovery and improvement trend continues to consolidate
summary_en: The National Information Center of the National Development and Reform Commission released a range of leading indicators on October 10, showing that China's economy continues to consolidate its recovery and improvement trend. Offline consumption payment amounts rose 2.6% year-on-year in the third quarter and 3.1% in September, departure tonnage of cargo vessels at major ports rose 43.1% year-on-year in the third quarter, and the value of contracts awarded for new infrastructure projects such as computing power and data rose 50.4% year-on-year in September, with capital investment in frontier fields such as AI and humanoid robots more than doubling.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: Implementing the Employment-First Strategy and Building a Dense, Tight Social Security Safety Net
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 10, an official from the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security reported that 10.52 million new urban jobs were created in the first nine months of the year, 87.7% of the annual target, with the surveyed urban unemployment rate averaging 5.2% in the first eight months. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will implement an employment-first strategy and improve the social security system, with basic pension, unemployment, and work-injury insurance enrollment reaching 1.079 billion, 251 million, and 327 million people respectively as of the end of September, and the three social insurance funds holding cumulative balances of 11.2 trillion yuan.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Guizhou Inherits Red Heritage and Writes a New Chapter of High-Quality Development
summary_en: The segment reports on Guizhou's role as the province where the Red Army operated longest and most widely during the Long March, recalling the January 1935 Zunyi Meeting as a turning point for the Party and highlighting the province's construction of the Guizhou section of the Long March National Cultural Park around more than 700 revolutionary sites. It also describes Guizhou's push into the digital economy, with 50 data centers built or under construction and computing capacity of 176 exaflops per second, and its plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period to cultivate six major industrial clusters and three specialty industries.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Breaking Ground at the Source and Foundation to Strengthen the Foundations of a Science and Technology Power
summary_en: The segment reports that China is intensifying basic research in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, citing achievements such as the identification of the new nuclide hafnium-153 at the High-Intensity Heavy Ion Accelerator in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and breakthroughs in astronomy, physics, superconducting magnets, and synthetic cells, alongside multi-ministry coordination to support original innovation and the goal of building a science and technology power by 2035.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Iran's foreign minister said Iran is continuing indirect talks with the United States through mediators and is assessing the U.S. proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days, while U.S. President Donald Trump said the two sides are holding "productive" consultations and that the U.S. will not attack Iran before November 3; it also covers the WTO raising its 2026 global goods trade growth forecast to 3.9%, Chile's foreign minister rejecting U.S. remarks linking support for Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan to cooperation on U.S. concerns, and worsening haze in Southeast Asia that closed about 1,200 schools in Malaysia's Johor state.

title_en: Saudi Arabia says Riyadh airport attack caused deaths and injuries; media report Saudi airstrikes on Yemeni Houthi-controlled areas
summary_en: A Saudi-led coalition spokesman said three Houthi missile launchers were destroyed, while Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority said Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport was attacked twice on October 8, killing three people and injuring several others. The Houthis said they fired missiles at the airport, Najran airport and Khamis Mushait air base, and Houthi-controlled media reported new Saudi airstrikes on Hodeidah airport and communications facilities in Sanaa and Raymah provinces, as fighting continued in Taiz.

title_en: Chinese Representative: Japan Has Become a Prominent Factor Threatening Regional Peace and Stability
summary_en: Speaking at the general debate of the First Committee (Disarmament and International Security) of the 81st UN General Assembly session on the 8th, a Chinese representative said that Japan's current government denies its history of aggression, glorifies war crimes, and is accelerating "re-militarization," making it a prominent factor threatening regional peace and stability. The representative also criticized remarks by current Japanese officials about discussing the possession of nuclear weapons and Japan's proposal to delete the "enemy state clauses" from the UN Charter.

title_en: China Proposes Three Points on Strengthening and Revitalizing the UN General Assembly
summary_en: At a joint debate on implementing UN resolutions and revitalizing the General Assembly at the 81st session on the 8th, China's representative said the UNGA should further build consensus and unity and fulfill its duties under the UN Charter, and put forward three proposals: taking the UN Charter as the fundamental guide, taking solidarity and cooperation as the key path, and taking pragmatic reform as the driving force.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a joint action plan by three ministries to protect agricultural brands through enforcement against trademark and patent violations in farming, along with data showing software industry revenue exceeding 10 trillion yuan in the first eight months of the year, a 2026 silver-age teaching program recruiting 6,000 teachers, a new national sign language and Braille standardization plan, winter-spring relief for disaster-affected people, the opening of the rebuilt Yiwu railway station, a new housing provident fund service window in Xiong'an New Area, the start of main construction on key tunnels of the G3033 Kuitun–Duku highway in Xinjiang, and the broadcast of the TV drama "The Great Long March."

title_en: News Feature: New Opportunities Brought by the 'Six Networks'
summary_en: The segment reports on how the construction of the 'six networks'—including a new national power grid, water network, and computing network—is changing remote areas and creating opportunities, focusing on young people in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia finding jobs at data centers built under the national integrated computing network, and on businesses opening in Letianxi Town on the north bank of the Yangtze as the new Three Gorges shipping channel is built.

title_en: China's Annual Per Capita Express Delivery Volume Exceeds 140 Parcels
summary_en: CCTV reported that China has built the world's largest and most widely covering delivery network, with over 81% of administrative villages having comprehensive village-level delivery and logistics service stations, and per capita express delivery volume exceeding 140 parcels per year. The segment, marking the 57th World Post Day, noted that parcels move at over 6,300 per second and 540 million per day, supported by hub clusters in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Chengdu-Chongqing, and central urban agglomeration regions.

title_en: Tourism Market Booms During National Day Holiday, Domestic Trips Reach 826 Million
summary_en: CCTV reports that during the seven-day National Day holiday, domestic tourism reached 826 million trips with total spending of 738.375 billion yuan, with red tourism accounting for 40 percent of holiday travel and holiday box office exceeding 1.165 billion yuan.

title_en: Ministry of Finance Arranges Use of 550 Billion Yuan in Local Government Debt Carryover Quotas
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has arranged the use of 550 billion yuan in carryover quotas for local government debt, comprising 300 billion yuan in general debt quota allocated entirely to counties and districts to strengthen their general public budget capacity, and 250 billion yuan in special debt quota allocated to regions with actual project funding needs in the fourth quarter, tilted toward major economic provinces. The ministry will guide localities to better align project reserves with bond issuance, accelerate issuance and disbursement, and form physical workload as soon as possible.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Chongqing Passes the Torch and Writes a New Chapter
summary_en: The segment reports on Chongqing's efforts to inherit the Red Army's Long March spirit through building the Long March National Cultural Park (Chongqing section) and themed study activities, and outlines the city's "15th Five-Year Plan" goals, including raising R&D spending intensity from 2.65% to 3.25%, boosting strategic emerging industries to about 39% of above-scale industrial value-added, and exceeding 900 billion yuan in total imports and exports by 2030.

title_en: Symposium on Studying Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Cultural Writings Held in Beijing
summary_en: A symposium on studying Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Cultural Writings was held in Beijing on the 9th. Participants said the volumes record the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core leading cultural development in the new era and provide authoritative material for studying and practicing Xi Jinping Thought on Culture, stressing the need to grasp the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments" and uphold the "Two Upholds."

title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue 'Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces'
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reported the formal release of the CPC Central Committee and State Council's 'Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces,' which calls for innovation-led development, breakthroughs in core technologies, deep integration of technological and industrial innovation, and reform of institutions and talent mechanisms to support high-quality development.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Adapting to Local Conditions to Promote High-Quality County-Level Economic Development
summary_en: The segment reports on high-quality development of county-level economies across China, citing Xi Jinping's call for counties to develop distinctive industries, and highlights examples including Leishan County in Guizhou, where cultural tourism drew over 12 million visitors this year, Kunshan in Jiangsu, which is building an AI server industry chain, and Datong County in Qinghai, where highland cool-climate vegetables exceed 80,000 mu in planting area and 400 million yuan in annual export value.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's Invitation, Botswana's President to Visit China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, President Duma Gideon Boko of the Republic of Botswana will pay a state visit to China from October 12 to 17.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: Cold Dew
summary_en: The segment explains the Cold Dew solar term, the fifth of autumn and the first in the 24 solar terms to contain the character for "cold," describing its natural signs such as heavier dew, late wild goose migration, and the harvest of late rice, hawthorn, persimmons, and cotton, as well as the custom of climbing high to enjoy autumn scenery.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Russia's strikes on Ukrainian defense firms producing and storing Flamingo cruise missiles and drones, with Ukraine claiming strikes on Russian oil facilities and training grounds; Israel's foreign minister Sa'ar announcing the closure of the British consulate in Jerusalem in response to UK sanctions over settlements, with UK Foreign Secretary Miliband vowing to maintain a long-term presence and support a two-state solution; IMF Managing Director Georgieva saying high oil prices will persist into 2027; the IEA agreeing to accelerate a March-announced oil reserve release with about 1.1 billion barrels held; and the WMO warning that El Niño is strengthening and will likely peak in December.

title_en: US Media: Pentagon Orders Preparations to Restart Operations Against Iran
summary_en: US media, citing multiple US officials, reported that the Pentagon has instructed US Central Command to prepare for a possible resumption of large-scale military operations against Iran, though no date was given and President Trump has not made a final decision. Iranian media reported that a senior adviser to the IRGC commander said the Strait of Hormuz remains closed under full Iranian armed forces control, with a few "illegal lanes" soon to be shut, and that the strait will not reopen unless Iran's legitimate demands are met.

title_en: Saudi Arabia says it destroyed 82 Houthi military targets in Yemen; Houthis say they struck Saudi targets near Aden airport
summary_en: Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority said Abha and King Khalid international airports were attacked on October 6-7, killing 3 and wounding 36, and the Saudi-led coalition said it responded with a large-scale operation destroying 82 Houthi military targets including missile launch platforms. The Houthis said they again struck King Khalid International Airport with missiles, claimed attacks on Saudi military targets near Yemen's Aden airport and on Yemeni government troop gatherings in Jawf and Lahij, and reported fighting with government forces in Taiz.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the National Day holiday period saw generally stable national safety conditions, with 15.462 million cross-border trips (up 6.7% year-on-year); the Ministry of Finance issued 150 billion yuan in special treasury bonds for recapitalizing central financial institutions; the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission and the Chinese Academy of Sciences launched a platform to match 100,000 patents with central-enterprise pilot-testing facilities; and Tsinghua University-led teams developed the world's first "nuclear optical clock."

title_en: Series of events held to mark 100-day countdown to Changchun 2027 33rd Winter World University Games
summary_en: The 100-day countdown to the opening of the Changchun 2027 33rd Winter World University Games began on October 7, with the organizing committee unveiling the torch, medals and promotional song; the torch is named "Jixiang" and the medals "Jimeng". International university health runs and dragon and lion dance championships were held in Changchun and Jilin, and all 10 competition venues have been completed, with 8,100 volunteer candidates selected from 120,000 applicants.

title_en: China Accelerates Building of Full-Chain Circular Economy System
summary_en: CCTV reports that China is connecting production, consumption, recycling and reuse across the circular economy, including tracing retired power batteries by QR code and recovering nickel, cobalt, manganese and lithium at high rates, and building recycling bases for retired wind turbines and solar panels as it prepares for a surge in "new three" solid waste through the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: China's embodied AI industrialization accelerates toward real-world deployment
summary_en: CCTV reports that China has built and put into operation more than 70 embodied AI training grounds, with over 40 more under construction or planned, forming three major clusters in the Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and Pearl River Delta regions. The segment notes that a Zhongguancun firm's embodied AI data platform has delivered 1.5 million hours of human video data, and that MIIT and other ministries have launched a special initiative targeting industrial, service, and special-purpose applications to build a closed loop from real-world training to scaled deployment.

title_en: China Implements Medical Rehabilitation and Nursing Expansion and Improvement Project
summary_en: The National Health Commission and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued an implementation plan for expanding medical rehabilitation and nursing services, focusing on primary-level care, building a rehabilitation service network, encouraging rehabilitation hospitals, nursing homes and hospice care centers, and including rehabilitation and nursing services in basic medical insurance coverage. The plan sets a goal for 2030 of a fully functional, coordinated, integrated Chinese-Western medicine, and efficiently accessible service system, with targets of 0.7 rehabilitation physicians and 1.6 rehabilitation therapists per 10,000 people.

title_en: Average Daily Charging Volume for New Energy Vehicles on Expressways Up 51.42% Year-on-Year During National Day Holiday
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Reporters learned from the National Energy Administration today (October 8) that during this National Day holiday, charging volumes for new energy vehicles on China's expressways remained consistently high. From 0:00 on October 1 to 24:00 on October 7, expressway new energy vehicle charging sessions totaled 6.711 million, with charging volume reaching 163 million kWh and average daily charging volume of 23.2566 million kWh, up 51.42% year-on-year. Next, the state will continue to advance the construction of charging facilities at expressway service areas to provide solid and reliable charging service guarantees for the public's green, convenient, and worry-free travel.

title_en: Cross-regional passenger flows average over 300 million per day during National Day holiday
summary_en: CCTV News reports that Ministry of Transport data show 2.142 billion cross-regional passenger trips over the seven-day National Day holiday, averaging 306 million per day, up 0.6% year on year, with 152 million railway passenger trips and a single-day record of 25.204 million on the first day. The segment notes that an integrated national transport network exceeding 6 million kilometers carried an average of 280 million road trips, 2.42 million air trips and 1.56 million waterway trips per day.

title_en: PBOC Releases Policy Position on RMB Exchange Rate
summary_en: The People's Bank of China issued a policy position document on the RMB exchange rate, stating that China has no need or intention to gain trade advantage through currency depreciation and never engages in competitive devaluation. The document also outlines plans during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to expand domestic demand and deepen high-level opening up.

title_en: "The Great Expedition" Themed Exhibition Welcomes 210,000 Visitors During National Day Holiday
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that the Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution in Beijing drew 210,000 visitors over the seven-day National Day holiday to its exhibition marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, featuring 14 reconstructed historical scenes and, for the first time, English captions. The exhibition, open to the public since September 25, has received nearly 390,000 visitors in total and will remain on permanent display.

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Path to Rejuvenation: Guangxi — Passing the Torch Across Northern Guangxi, Strengthening Toward the Sea and Setting Out Anew
summary_en: The segment recounts the Central Red Army's 19-day passage through Guangxi during the Long March and the 1934 Battle of the Xiang River, noting that the Xiang River Battle Memorial Hall now draws over one million visitors a year, and reports on Guangxi's industrial upgrading, opening to ASEAN and Belt and Road countries, and major infrastructure including the newly navigable Pinglu Canal and the Huangtong–Baise railway and Hepu–Zhanjiang high-speed rail projects under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Putting People's Needs at the Center to Energize the Consumer Market
summary_en: The segment reports that China's consumer market is shifting from buying goods toward seeking experiences and services, citing National Day holiday data showing foot traffic at 78 key commercial districts up 2.5% year-on-year and sales up 4.7%, with trade-in subsidies benefiting 6.392 million consumers and driving 33.48 billion yuan in sales. It also highlights the newly issued 15th Five-Year Plan for Expanding Consumption, which prioritizes improving service consumption for people's wellbeing.

title_en: Splendid Landscapes of China
summary_en: The segment presents scenic views of China's green mountains and clear waters, highlighting the beauty of the country's ecology at the close of the broadcast.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports attacks on merchant ships in the Black Sea, including one sinking in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone, as well as continued Israeli strikes in Gaza on the third anniversary of the conflict's outbreak, a U.S. congressional report on 81 U.S. military aircraft damaged or destroyed since strikes on Iran began February 28, and the Atlanta zoo's announcement that giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang will debut in early November.

title_en: Yemen's Houthi Forces Claim Strikes on Major Saudi Airports and Air Base, Repel Government Offensive at Bab al-Mandab
summary_en: Yemen's Houthi forces said they used missiles and drones to strike two Saudi international airports and an air base in Khamis Mushait, and claimed to have repelled repeated advances by Yemeni government forces toward Bab al-Mandab; the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a Houthi missile north of Riyadh, while Yemen's government reported progress in its operations against the Houthis and said the Houthis attacked Aden's international airport.

title_en: Russia Says It Will Take All Measures in Response to Lithuania Lifting Ban on Nuclear Weapons Deployment
summary_en: Lithuania's parliament held a first-round vote on a constitutional amendment aimed at lifting the ban on deploying nuclear weapons on its territory, with the bill still requiring a second vote. In response, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said NATO's military infrastructure moving toward Russia's borders and the deployment of nuclear weapons in neighboring countries would only escalate tensions, and that Russia would be forced to take all necessary measures to safeguard its security.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that a partial revision to the architectural design standard for elderly care facilities has been released and will take effect on January 1, 2027; that cumulative import and export value on the China-Laos Railway has surpassed 100 billion yuan since it opened; and that the Three-North Shelterbelt Program has completed 265 million mu of construction tasks over more than three years, with a goal of finishing 70% by 2027 and all tasks by 2030.

title_en: Frontline Research: From Smooth Goods Flow to Production-Marketing Linkage
summary_en: The segment reports on China's push to build a national logistics network, using a large agricultural produce market in Pengzhou, Sichuan, as a case study of how digital supply-chain platforms coordinate small-batch orders, warehousing and delivery across 31 provincial-level regions and 340 cities. It notes that the August implementation plan for logistics network construction aims to shift infrastructure from scattered points and routes to integrated chains and networks, with 181 national logistics hubs to be interconnected during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: Reading Enriches Holiday Life as a Culture of Books Flourishes Across China
summary_en: During the National Day holiday, many Chinese chose reading over travel, with activities such as book-house reading sessions in Qingxi Village, Hunan, a book fair in Tianjin, and classics exhibitions in Jiangsu drawing crowds. Public cultural venues extended opening hours, with Shaanxi Provincial Library receiving 95,000 visits in the first six days (up 22.5% year-on-year) and Jiangxi Provincial Library averaging over 10,000 daily visits (up 43%).

title_en: Inbound Tourism Continues to Heat Up as Foreign Visitors Deeply Experience a Colorful China
summary_en: CCTV reports that inbound tourism has kept rising this year, with foreign visitor bookings growing during the National Day holiday and source markets expanding from East and Southeast Asia to Europe and Oceania; Beijing received 112,000 inbound visitors in the first six days of the holiday, up 24.6% year on year, while Sichuan received 47,903, up 9.2%. The segment also notes that China inspected 61.287 million foreign entries and exits in the first eight months of the year, up 19.5% year on year, and that inbound visitors stayed an average of 5.1 days in China in 2026, up 11%.

title_en: Strong Travel Demand During National Day Holiday, Development Vitality Continues to Be Unleashed
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that cross-regional passenger flows during the seven-day National Day holiday are expected to reach 2.144 billion person-trips, up 0.7% year on year, according to the Ministry of Transport. The segment highlights continued strong rail demand, with more than 20 million passenger trips sent for three consecutive days, road travel exceeding 1.96 billion trips with new-energy vehicle traffic up 35% year on year, and average daily civil aviation passenger volume of about 2.4 million.

title_en: Over 210 Million Visits to Parks During National Day Holiday, Enjoying Holiday Time
summary_en: During the National Day holiday, parks across China hosted a wide range of cultural activities, drawing more than 210 million visits, according to data from the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development. Parks held 11,000 special events including flower shows, cultural performances, and intangible cultural heritage experiences, generating over 5.2 billion yuan in consumer spending.

title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Accelerates Across China
summary_en: The segment reports that China's autumn grain harvest has passed 40 percent nationwide, with Northeast China at peak harvest and the Huang-Huai-Hai region advancing, as localities deploy machinery, mechanized harvesting, and grain-loss-reduction measures to ensure the harvest is brought in.

title_en: Guided by Xi Jinping's Thought on Culture, Forging New Splendor for Chinese Culture
summary_en: The segment reports that since the 18th Party Congress the Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has placed cultural development in a prominent position in governance, forming Xi Jinping's Thought on Culture, and highlights cultural achievements during the National Day holiday including revolutionary heritage sites, museum exhibits, and guochao cultural tourism, along with cultural heritage protection, literary and artistic works, and international cultural exchanges.

title_en: Splendid Land of China
summary_en: In the golden autumn season, with grain harvests abundant, the segment closes by taking viewers into the fields of hope to share in the joy of the harvest.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for a lasting peace in Gaza and urged all parties to honor ceasefire commitments, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel would continue military operations in Gaza and Lebanon; the euro fell sharply against the dollar amid concerns over France's fiscal situation and political uncertainty; and a British Airways Boeing 777 bound for Chicago made an emergency return to London Heathrow after descending more than 8,000 meters in minutes due to a technical problem.

title_en: Russia Says It Will Take Reciprocal Countermeasures Against Japan's Anti-Russia Measures
summary_en: Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova said on the 5th that Japan's recent sanctions on Russia over the Ukraine situation, including shipping-related restrictions for the first time, further damage the already frayed foundations of Russia-Japan relations. Zakharova said the Takaichi administration's measures, which it claims aim to promote a peaceful settlement, are actually intended to inflict a "strategic failure" on Russia, and that Russia will certainly take reciprocal countermeasures targeting areas of important interest to Japan.

title_en: Yemeni media say government forces advance on multiple fronts; Houthis say they still control recently captured areas
summary_en: Yemeni media reported on the 5th that government forces made gains on multiple fronts, defeating Houthi fighters and advancing in the Bab al-Mandab area, Zubab airport and the Red Sea port city of Mokha, with operations continuing; a Houthi spokesman said on October 6 that the group still controls all recently captured areas. The Saudi-led coalition said it struck Houthi military targets in Hodeidah province and foiled an attack on southern Red Sea shipping, while the Houthis said they struck Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, the Saudi Aramco refinery in Rabigh, Abha International Airport and other targets, and Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey agreed at an emergency meeting in Riyadh to deploy agreed military forces to Saudi Arabia.

title_en: UN Human Rights Council adopts China-proposed resolution on accessibility for all by consensus
summary_en: At the 63rd session of the UN Human Rights Council on the 5th, a resolution titled "Accessibility for the Promotion and Protection of Human Rights for All," proposed by China on behalf of 47 countries, was adopted by consensus. China's representative said the draft focuses on population aging and accessibility and age-friendly construction, and addresses opportunities and challenges from emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, calling on states to uphold principles of innovation, inclusiveness, openness, fairness, safety and reliability in developing and using emerging digital technologies to promote accessible information exchange; participants said the resolution's call for technical assistance to developing countries and international cooperation meets developing countries' needs.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the State Council Work Safety Committee Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management coordinated National Day holiday safety precautions, that the Western Land-Sea New Corridor's rail-sea intermodal container volume surpassed 1 million TEU this year, that over 80,000 Hong Kong and Macao vehicle trips crossed the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge during the holiday (up 11.1% year on year), and that National Day holiday box office receipts topped 1 billion yuan.

title_en: Cultural China Tour · Campus and Library Songs: Nankai University Library — Knowing China, Serving China
summary_en: The segment visits Nankai University Library, tracing its history from the library's destruction in the 1937 Japanese bombing of the campus and the teachers' and students' relocation to form the Southwest Associated University, to the patriotic scientist Yang Shixian's pesticide research and the university's current network of 114 rural stations for Chinese-style modernization across 31 provincial-level regions.

title_en: 2026 'Foreign Media Look at China' Interview Tour Visits 7 Provinces, Regions and Municipalities
summary_en: The 2026 'Foreign Media Look at China' themed interview tour organized by the State Council Information Office concluded, with journalists from 18 countries including the US, Russia, the UK and Singapore visiting Beijing, Shanghai, Inner Mongolia and other areas to report on high-quality development in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan. The tour covered high-level opening up in Shanghai and Guangdong, modern industrial systems and new quality productive forces in Anhui, scientific and technological innovation in Beijing and Zhejiang, and grain production and green development in Heilongjiang and Inner Mongolia.

title_en: China's New-Type Battery Industry Scale to Achieve Steady Growth by 2030
summary_en: Seven Chinese government departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission, jointly issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" for the Development of the New-Type Battery Industry, which targets steady growth in the industry's scale by 2030, initial large-scale application of all-solid-state batteries, and a cycle life of 15,000 for long-life lithium batteries. The plan says new-type batteries, represented by lithium, sodium, and flow batteries, will support electrification of smart terminals, automobiles, ships, aviation, and intelligent robots, and serve global green and low-carbon development.

title_en: Frontline Research: Activating Private Investment, Opening New Space for Building the 'Six Networks'
