summary_en: The segment reports clashes between Yemeni government forces and Houthi fighters in Taiz province, Israeli military operations against Hezbollah underground facilities in southern Lebanon, a London meeting between UK Prime Minister Burnham and French President Macron on closer UK-Europe ties, storm damage and power outages in Ontario, Canada, and Volkswagen's approval of a major restructuring plan cutting its model lineup by about 50% by 2035.

title_en: Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Will Not Open Without Iran's Consent; US Says It Will Continue Maritime Blockade of Iran
summary_en: Ebrahim Azizi, chairman of the Iranian Parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, said the Strait of Hormuz will not open without Iran's consent, while US Vice President JD Vance said Washington will not negotiate with Iran as long as attacks on ships in the strait continue and US Central Command said the maritime blockade of Iran is ongoing. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was reported as saying toppling the Iranian regime is Israel's core goal, and Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said Israel would strike all Iranian infrastructure, including energy facilities, if Iran attacks Israel.

title_en: Russia says it captured several settlements; Ukraine says it struck a Russian support ship
summary_en: Russia's Defense Ministry said its forces took control of four settlements in Donetsk and Kharkiv and struck Ukrainian military logistics, vessel and port targets, while Ukraine's navy said its drone boats hit a Russian multi-purpose support ship in Sochi; Russian President Vladimir Putin said a settlement depends on the two parties and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the U.S. confirmed talks in Moscow and Kyiv, and U.S. President Donald Trump said he would ask Europe to bear the cost of U.S. military aid to Ukraine.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's software business revenue rose 9.2% year-on-year in the first seven months of the year to 8.9785 trillion yuan, that the 32nd APEC Small and Medium Enterprises Ministerial Meeting was held in Guangzhou on September 4, and that national railways carried 954 million passenger trips during the summer travel season; it also covers new international air cargo routes, the 2026 Beijing Culture Forum, tunnel construction safety measures, two mandatory standards for elderly care institutions, declining student myopia rates, the launch of the Da'an thermal power peaking project under the Jilin-to-Beijing power transmission program, autumn maintenance on the Wari Railway, and plans to build 600 model worker innovation studios.

title_en: Chinese Sports Delegation for the 20th Asian Games Formed Today
summary_en: The Chinese sports delegation for the 20th Asian Games was officially formed in Beijing on September 4, comprising 1,274 people including 815 athletes who will compete in 38 sports and 369 events. The delegation's athletes have an average age of 24, with 548 first-time Asian Games participants and 36 Olympic champions across 13 sports; the 20th Asian Games will be held in Japan from September 19 to October 4.

title_en: Remnant Vortex of "Sadel" Continues to Affect Multiple Southern Regions
summary_en: CCTV reports that the remnant vortex of Typhoon Sadel continued to bring heavy rain to southern China on September 4, prompting evacuations of about 300,000 people in Putian, Fujian, emergency drainage at a reservoir in Fuding where a dam landslide created breach risk, a Level IV flood emergency response in Jiangxi, and the formation of the first floods of 2026 on the Gan and Han rivers.

title_en: China Accelerates Push for Barrier-Free Environment Construction
summary_en: The segment reports that since the start of the year, various regions and departments have taken multiple measures to shift China's barrier-free environment construction from "point coverage" toward "all-area friendliness," citing new national standards for age-friendly urban rail transit, Civil Aviation Administration measures to improve air travel services for people with disabilities and the elderly, and a Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development technical guide for community accessibility renovations. It also highlights Chongqing's Yuzhong District, which established the country's first resource database of barrier-free facilities and service personnel and upgraded an electronic "barrier-free friendly map" marking over 300 elevator, ramp, and accessible restroom locations.

title_en: China's Commercial Space Sector Gains New Momentum
summary_en: The segment reports that a series of policy measures have invigorated China's commercial space industry, highlighting milestones such as the Zhuque-3 rocket's first controlled land recovery of an orbital-class launch vehicle and a nationwide supplier network of nearly 700 companies. It notes that in 2025 China completed 50 commercial launches (54% of total launches) and placed 311 commercial satellites into orbit (84% of the total), and that the 15th Five-Year Plan lists aerospace as an emerging pillar industry.

title_en: China's Mega-Market Dividends Benefit the World
summary_en: The segment reports that China's continued expansion of imports is turning demand from its vast market into shared global opportunities, citing an international fruit exhibition in Shanghai with nearly 300 exhibitors from over 60 countries and regions, and noting that about 60 kinds of fresh fruit from 63 countries and regions have gained inspection and quarantine access to China. It also reports that in the first seven months of the year, China's imports of mechanical and electrical products reached 5.31 trillion yuan, up 29.7 percent year on year and accounting for over 40 percent of total imports, with more than 150 trading partners achieving positive export growth to China.

title_en: China to Accelerate Building Project Database for 'Six Networks'
summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission said China will speed up building a project database for the 'Six Networks,' including the computing power network and new-type power grid, to publicly promote attractive projects and encourage diverse participants. It will also improve investment and financing mechanisms and strengthen information sharing with financial institutions to support major projects.

title_en: Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start: High-Quality Development of Medical Insurance Supports Chinese-Style Modernization
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on the morning of September 4, National Healthcare Security Administration officials outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including expanding employee medical insurance coverage for flexible workers, migrant workers, and new employment forms; continuing annual adjustments to the basic medical insurance drug catalog (949 drugs added so far, 199 of them innovative); removing household registration restrictions on insurance enrollment in megacities; unifying national reimbursement catalogs for medical services and consumables; and achieving near-national coverage of long-term care insurance by the end of 2028.

title_en: Li Xi conducts research visit in Guizhou
summary_en: Li Xi, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, visited Guizhou from the 1st to the 3rd, where he toured the Zunyi Conference site and memorial hall, an agricultural demonstration base and a data center in Zunyi, a district procuratorate in Guiyang, and the provincial discipline inspection commission, and chaired a symposium calling for high-quality development of discipline inspection and supervision work.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends and Addresses Plenary Session of 11th Eastern Economic Forum
summary_en: Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the plenary session of the 11th Eastern Economic Forum in Vladivostok, Russia, where he delivered remarks on China-Russia regional cooperation, conveyed President Xi Jinping's positions, and offered four proposals on development, the business environment, exchanges, and regional peace and stability. In a subsequent Q&A, he answered questions on APEC's "China Year" and global AI governance.

title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Revised Regulations on Emergency Response and Investigation of Electric Power Safety Accidents
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the revised Regulations on Emergency Response to and Investigation and Handling of Electric Power Safety Accidents, effective January 1, 2027. The revisions require power enterprises and users to follow unified dispatch and strengthen hazard inspections, adjust accident classification standards, extend the regulations to entities connected to the grid beyond power enterprises and users, clarify accident reporting duties for power dispatch agencies, and optimize accident investigation and handling mechanisms.

title_en: TV Documentary 'Shared Aspirations Across Mountains and Seas, Walking the Great Path Together — A Record of President Xi Jinping Attending the SCO Summit and Visiting Kyrgyzstan and Egypt' Airs Tonight
summary_en: A CCTV-produced documentary on President Xi Jinping's attendance at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and his visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt will air tonight (September 4) in prime time on CCTV's comprehensive and news channels. Over five days and four nights, Xi attended more than 20 events, combining bilateral and multilateral engagements and cross-regional coordination, and put forward Chinese proposals and wisdom for a world of change and turbulence.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the Eighth China-Russia Energy Business Forum
summary_en: On September 4, the Eighth China-Russia Energy Business Forum was held in Vladivostok, Russia, and President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter noting that this year marks the 30th anniversary of the establishment of China-Russia strategic cooperative partnership and the 25th anniversary of the signing of the China-Russia Treaty of Good-Neighborliness and Friendly Cooperation, and calling for deeper energy cooperation and stable, unimpeded energy industrial and supply chains. Russian President Vladimir Putin also sent a congratulatory letter to the forum the same day.

title_en: CCTV Quick Comment: Create More Outstanding Works That Spread Truth, Goodness and Beauty and Are Loved by Children, with Heart and Sincerity
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The program today (September 4) broadcast a CCTV Quick Comment titled "Create More Outstanding Works That Spread Truth, Goodness and Beauty and Are Loved by Children, with Heart and Sincerity."

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating China Media Group's 'Little Trumpet' Program on Its 70th Anniversary, Urging Programs to Keep Pace with the Times, Cultivate Children's Cultural Soil, and Make Greater Contributions to Training Socialist Builders and Successors with All-Round Moral, Intellectual, Physical, Aesthetic and Labor Development
summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, state president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, sent a congratulatory letter on the 70th anniversary of the launch of China Media Group's 'Little Trumpet' program, praising its seven decades of telling good stories to children and urging children's cultural workers to fulfill the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education and create more excellent works that spread truth, goodness and beauty. 'Little Trumpet,' launched on September 4, 1956, was New China's first radio program designed specifically for preschool children and has become a brand program integrating radio, television, new media and campus broadcasting.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu saying Israel controls 60% of Gaza and will continue operations to disarm Hamas, while Palestinian envoy Mansour accused Israel of seeking to seize Palestinian land; it also covers U.S. media reports of severe supply difficulties for U.S. warships in the Middle East, Russia's summoning of a German diplomat over Germany's closure of Russian consular facilities, and the Dutch central bank moving about 86 tons of gold reserves from North America to London.

title_en: Trump Says U.S. Destroyed Iran's New Equipment It Sought to Deploy Along Strait of Hormuz; Iran Says It Struck U.S. Base in Kuwait
summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said the U.S. military destroyed all new equipment Iran sought to deploy along the Strait of Hormuz and that the United States is ready to strike again, while Iranian media reported that Iran struck a U.S. military base in Kuwait with missiles and drones. Iranian officials accused the U.S. of committing a "war crime" in a strike on a wedding in Sirik County, Hormozgan Province, and Pakistan's Foreign Ministry said it would continue working to promote U.S.-Iran dialogue and bring both sides back to the negotiating table.

title_en: Cultural exchange event marking 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties held in Cairo
summary_en: On the sidelines of President Xi Jinping's state visit to Egypt, China Media Group and Egypt's Ministry of State for Information held a cultural exchange event in Cairo on September 1 marking the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic relations, with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi sending a congratulatory letter. The event unveiled media cooperation projects, including a CMG-Egyptian state TV co-produced feature, CGTN documentaries to air in Egypt, a joint production with the Arab League Secretariat, and a Chinese film exhibition in Egypt supported by China's Film Administration.

title_en: Deepening Egypt-China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and Safeguarding Regional Security and Stability — People from Multiple Countries Speak Highly of President Xi Jinping's State Visit to Egypt
summary_en: People from multiple countries said that President Xi Jinping's state visit to Egypt has pushed the Egypt-China comprehensive strategic partnership to a new height and injected greater certainty and positive energy into easing regional tensions and achieving world peace and development. They said China is committed to building a new type of international relations featuring win-win cooperation, and that Xi's visit to Egypt not only benefits the peoples of both countries but also contributes importantly to regional prosperity and stability and to world peace and development.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on the launch of the sixth national sample survey of the living conditions of urban and rural elderly, insurance payouts of 6.3 billion yuan for typhoon damage, the establishment of a China-SCO port economic cooperation center in Tianjin, a full-scale navigation drill on the Pinglu Canal, the completion of all main towers of the Hangzhou Bay cross-sea railway bridge, and the 2026 World Power Battery Conference in Yibin, along with a cultural tourism expo, a women's domestic service skills competition, and a TV drama premiere.

title_en: Typhoon Saudel Continues to Affect China; Heavy Rain Hits Multiple Southern Regions
summary_en: Typhoon Saudel made its third landfall in China this morning along the coast of Gulei in Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou, Fujian, bringing strong winds and torrential rain that flooded villages and streets and forced the evacuation of 83,700 people in Fujian, while parts of eastern Guangdong such as Raoping County in Chaozhou also saw flooding and evacuated over 7,000 residents. The Central Meteorological Observatory forecasts that Saudel's heavy rain will taper off tomorrow, though parts of Hunan, Jiangxi, Guangxi and Fujian may still see heavy to torrential rain, with experts warning of secondary disasters such as landslides and mudslides.

title_en: Frontline Investigation: Qingdao Delivery Riders — From "Passersby" to "Family"
summary_en: The segment reports on Qingdao's efforts to address delivery riders' difficulties with entering residential compounds, housing, and injury protection, including a "dual station chief" coordination mechanism, rider apartments, and a pilot occupational injury insurance program covering each order. It notes that nearly 500 riders in the West Coast New Area have registered to participate in community governance, while challenges related to rider mobility, platform algorithms, and fragmented protection systems remain.

title_en: Third National Census of Ancient and Famous Trees Fully Underway
summary_en: China's third national census of ancient and famous trees is now fully underway, with the National Greening Committee Office reporting that national parks, nature reserves, and state-owned forest areas are included for the first time to achieve full coverage. Pilot surveys have been completed at 13 representative sites across 11 provinces including Guizhou, Zhejiang, and Fujian, and the census is expected to conclude by the end of 2027, with plaque-based protection to be fully implemented.

title_en: Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start: Aiming at Building a Sports Power and Promoting High-Quality Sports Development
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 3, a National Sports Administration official outlined priorities for building China into a sports power during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including improving public fitness services, reforming competitive sports management, and expanding the sports industry. China aims to grow the total scale of the sports industry to over 7 trillion yuan by 2030 while strengthening youth sports and cultivating athletic talent.

title_en: Events Held Across China to Commemorate 81st Anniversary of Victory in the War of Resistance
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that events were held across China marking the 81st anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, including commemorations at the September 18 Historical Museum in Shenyang, the Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, the Shanghai Songhu Memorial Hall, and the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre by Japanese Invaders, as well as patriotic education activities in Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Hebei, Shandong, Heilongjiang, Gansu, and Anhui. The Hong Kong SAR government held a flag-raising ceremony attended by representatives from various sectors, and military units held activities tied to training and preparedness.

title_en: Symposium Commemorating the 81st Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War Held in Beijing
summary_en: A symposium marking the 81st anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War was held in Beijing on the 3rd, attended by Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department. Officials from the United Front Work Department, the Institute of Party History and Literature, and the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission, along with representatives of youth officers and soldiers from heroic model units and student representatives, spoke at the event.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao Accelerate Collaborative Innovation to Build a Driving Force for High-Quality Development
summary_en: The segment reports that Guangdong is advancing institutional innovation to remove barriers to factor flows and strengthen cross-border research collaboration among Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao, citing a Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) team's breakthrough in micron-scale robots for targeted drug delivery and a joint Guangdong-Hong Kong university funding program of at least 30 million yuan annually. It also describes measures on cross-border funding, talent visas, tax policies and research supplies, with the Greater Bay Area aiming to basically build a globally influential international science and technology innovation center by 2030 and complete it by 2035.

title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Attending 2026 SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
summary_en: On the morning of September 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after concluding his attendance at the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt. Accompanying him on the same flight were his wife Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Director of the Central Office, and Wang Yi, member of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Foreign Minister, among other accompanying personnel.

title_en: Xi Jinping Successfully Concludes State Visit to Egypt
summary_en: On the evening of September 2 local time, President Xi Jinping concluded his state visit to Egypt. As he departed Cairo, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and his wife saw him off at the airport.

title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Visit Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President Sisi and His Wife
summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and his wife Entissar, toured the Grand Egyptian Museum, viewing treasures including the Tutankhamun collection and discussing civilizational exchange and the Global Civilization Initiative. Cai Qi and Wang Yi also took part in the activities.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Canadian Prime Minister Carney called on the United States to take US-Canada trade talks seriously and respect Canadian sovereignty; Eurozone inflation rose to 3.3% in August, its highest level in nearly three years; and UN humanitarian chief Fletcher said the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading exponentially, with 6,186 confirmed cases and 3,007 deaths.

title_en: US Launches New Round of Military Strikes on Iran; Iran Strikes US Bases in Multiple Countries
summary_en: US Central Command said US forces launched a new round of military strikes on Iran on the 1st, targeting Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps air defense positions, radar systems, mine-laying forces and communications sites, with explosions reported in Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island and other locations. Iran said a wedding in the Sirik area of Hormozgan Province was hit by a US attack causing dozens of civilian casualties, and in response struck US bases in the UAE, Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan and Kuwait with attack drones and ballistic missiles; Iran's armed forces warned on September 2 that continued US military action would bring a stronger response, and Brent crude closed above $94 a barrel on the 1st amid renewed regional tensions.

title_en: Egyptians from all walks of life say President Xi Jinping's state visit will open a brighter future for Egypt-China relations
summary_en: Egyptians from various sectors welcomed President Xi Jinping's visit, saying it will inject new momentum into the two countries' joint pursuit of modernization and expressing hope for a brighter future in Egypt-China relations. Xi's signed article in Egyptian mainstream media, titled "Seventy Years of Standing Together Through Storms, Forging Ahead on a New Journey," drew a warm response in Egypt, with Egyptian figures saying the visit will chart a new blueprint for deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership and is of great significance to advancing Egypt-China cooperation.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on a multi-department deployment to strengthen fishery safety, the implementation of the 2026 National Essential Medicines List and new rules on multi-channel internet content distribution, 18.7% year-on-year growth in China-Egypt trade in the first seven months of the year, a major copper-gold exploration breakthrough in Xuancheng, Anhui, the launch of 2026 National Science Popularization Month, and summer box office receipts of 12.498 billion yuan.

title_en: Land rescue route to core area of Gyirong Port in Tibet reopened
summary_en: CCTV reports that rescue work continues after a mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet, with a land rescue route from Gyirong Town to Gyirong Port opened at 10 a.m. on September 2, allowing heavy vehicles and equipment to enter the disaster core area via National Highway 216 for deeper search and rescue. The segment also covers military and armed police support, monitoring of barrier lake and glacier risks, and initial insurance losses estimated at 450 million yuan with over 200 million yuan in emergency cash provided by banks.

title_en: Credit Funds Accelerate Toward Tech Innovation Enterprises in First Half of Year
summary_en: CCTV reports that People's Bank of China data show loans to science and technology innovation fields grew rapidly in the first half of the year, with the PBOC raising its relending quota for tech innovation and industrial upgrading to 1.2 trillion yuan and cutting the relending rate to 1.25%. By the end of June, 305,600 tech-oriented small and medium-sized enterprises nationwide had received credit support, a loan coverage rate of 50.8%, and their loan growth reached 20.1% year-on-year, 15 percentage points higher than overall loan growth.

title_en: Main Autumn Grain Producing Regions Take Targeted Measures to Secure a Bumper Harvest
summary_en: CCTV reports that most of China's autumn grain is in the grain-filling stage, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs projecting a slight increase in planted area and most crops growing well despite localized disaster damage. The segment highlights water-fertilizer integration in Shandong, widened ridges in Heilongjiang's Baoqing County, and recovery efforts in central Henan after rain damage, while warning of heightened pest and disease risks in southern rice and Huang-Huai-Hai regions ahead of the main harvest in under a month.

title_en: "Classic Quotes Loved by Xi Jinping" (Arabic Edition) Airs on Egyptian Mainstream Media
summary_en: The Arabic edition of "Ping 'Yu' Jin Ren — Classic Quotes Loved by Xi Jinping," produced by China Media Group, was launched in Cairo on September 1, with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi sending a congratulatory letter. The program, which features classical Chinese quotations used in Xi Jinping's speeches and writings, is airing on Egyptian state television and other mainstream Egyptian and African media.

title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to King Haakon VIII of Norway on His Accession
summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Norway's new King Haakon VIII on his accession to the throne, noting the two countries' long-standing friendship and 72 years of diplomatic ties and expressing willingness to work with the King to open a new chapter in China-Norway friendly relations.

title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Egyptian President
summary_en: On September 2 in Cairo, President Xi Jinping held talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, during which the two leaders oversaw the signing of cooperation documents on Belt and Road, AI, trade and supply chains, and issued a joint statement on deepening their comprehensive strategic partnership; Xi also presented a four-point initiative on Middle East security, and Peng Liyuan met with Entissar Amer.

title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcoming Ceremony Hosted by Egyptian President
summary_en: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi held a grand welcoming ceremony for Chinese President Xi Jinping at the Sun Palace in Cairo on the morning of September 2 local time, marking Xi's second state visit to Egypt in ten years. The segment notes that the visit is expected to open a new chapter in China-Egypt relations and contribute to regional and global peace and stability.

title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Cairo for State Visit to Egypt
summary_en: President Xi Jinping arrived in Cairo on the evening of September 1 for a state visit to Egypt at the invitation of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi, and issued a written statement on China-Egypt relations and their comprehensive strategic partnership.

title_en: Frontline Research: Parks Expand New Consumption Scenarios
summary_en: The segment reports that Beijing's World Park waived its 100-yuan admission fee for the first time in its 33 years and extended opening hours to 9 p.m. as part of a Fengtai District effort to turn parks into nighttime consumption venues, with supporting measures including free temporary parking and market stalls; this summer, major Beijing parks have extended consumption hours and hosted nearly 200 events.

title_en: China's International Route Network Continues to Improve, Better Meeting Inbound Tourism Demand
summary_en: CCTV reports that growing inbound tourism demand has driven steady expansion of China's international air route network, with airlines including Air China, China Eastern, and China Southern adding or resuming routes to Madrid, Milan, and Amsterdam, and Chinese carriers opening 50 international routes in June alone. In the first half of the year, international routes carried over 40 million passengers, up 5.7% year-on-year.

title_en: Service consumption opens up new space for employment
summary_en: The segment reports that as service consumption has expanded and upgraded this year, demand for related jobs has grown rapidly, with new professions and job categories emerging, including care for the elderly and young children, where demand for roles such as elderly-care planners and infant development guides rose by more than 30 percent, and services related to the growing new-energy vehicle aftermarket. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security plans to publish a batch of new professions and job categories, including age-friendly renovation designers and ice and snow sculpture workers.

title_en: China Has Established 578 National Comprehensive Chronic Disease Prevention and Control Demonstration Zones
summary_en: CCTV News reports that, according to the National Health Commission, China has built 578 national comprehensive chronic disease prevention and control demonstration zones, with Jining's Rencheng District in Shandong among this year's new additions creating 12 types of health-supportive environments, 260 healthy communities (villages), and over 60 self-service health testing points. The total is expected to reach 820 zones by 2035, covering nearly 30 percent of districts and counties.

title_en: Various Regions and Departments Take Multiple Measures to Respond to Typhoon Dolphin's Impact
summary_en: Typhoon Dolphin, this year's 13th typhoon, made landfall in Yuhuan and Yueqing, Zhejiang, on the evening of August 9 and has weakened to a tropical storm; localities and departments are responding with drainage, rescue, power restoration, and relocation efforts. The National Disaster Prevention and Relief Committee and the Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level IV national disaster relief emergency response for Zhejiang, and the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management pre-allocated 120 million yuan in central natural disaster relief funds to support Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, and Jiangxi.

title_en: July Leading Indicators Reflect Clear Trend of a Stable Economy Improving in Quality
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that National Information Center data show July leading indicators across multiple sectors were stable and improving, with offline consumption payments up 2.2% year-on-year, industrial park production activity up 1.0%, and AI-related patent grants up 60%, while investment in new infrastructure such as computing power, data, and networks continued to grow.

title_en: South-to-North Water Diversion Project's Eastern and Central Routes Phase I Surpass 90 Billion Cubic Meters in Water Transfer
summary_en: CCTV reports that cumulative water transfers through Phase I of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project's eastern and central routes exceeded 90 billion cubic meters as of midday on August 10, supplying 27 large and medium-sized cities and 118 million people via the central route and benefiting nearly 80 million people and over 45 million mu of farmland via the eastern route. The segment also notes ongoing ecological water replenishment along the routes and accelerated construction of new water allocation and reservoir projects, including the Yudong water resource allocation project expected to serve ten counties in Henan by 2028 and the Qingdao Guanlu Reservoir on the eastern route.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Shared Intelligent Manufacturing Helps Hebei Revitalize Industrial Clusters
summary_en: The segment reports that Hebei Province, a major industrial province, is using shared intelligent manufacturing—including "industry brains" and shared factories—as a breakthrough to help its many small and medium-sized enterprises in specialized industrial clusters, such as the wire and cable cluster in Ningjin County, Xingtai, reduce procurement costs and improve coordination. It adds that Hebei aims to build 30 provincial-level "industry brains" by 2027, covering digital services for 107 key industrial clusters.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Accelerating the Building of a New Pattern of Urban-Rural Integrated Development
summary_en: The segment reports on China's push for urban-rural integrated development, citing Xi Jinping's 2013 visit to Dongshan Village in Ezhou, Hubei, and his call to break down the urban-rural dual structure, alongside local efforts in Henan, Inner Mongolia, Anhui, Xinjiang and Zhejiang to boost rural industries, cold-chain logistics, infrastructure and rural entrepreneurship.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Russian Ambassador to Japan Nikolai Nozdryov warned that Japan's overturning of its 'Three Non-Nuclear Principles' would violate its NPT obligations and invite countermeasures, while Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, speaking in Nagasaki, mentioned only that Japan 'currently' adheres to the principles; separately, Bulgaria's Prime Minister said a drone that entered from Romania and exploded near a gas pipeline likely came from Ukraine, Typhoon Dolphin caused damage in Japan and the Philippines, and Mount Etna's eruption disrupted flights at Catania airport.

title_en: British Columbia declares state of emergency as wildfires spread rapidly, forcing mass evacuations
summary_en: CCTV News reports that hot, dry weather has caused wildfires to spread quickly across multiple areas of British Columbia, Canada, prompting the province to declare a state of emergency on the 8th, with more than 20,000 people forced to evacuate and many homes destroyed; the segment also notes over 100 fire points in the province, many out of control, and that Canada's national wildfire burn area this year has reached 40,000 square kilometers. It adds that two large wildfires in Utah, USA, remain out of control after a firefighting helicopter crashed on the 7th, killing two people on board, with nearly 100 large wildfires burning across the United States and over 25,000 square kilometers burned this year.

title_en: Iran Says Strait of Hormuz Will Not Reopen Until U.S. Meets Its Conditions
summary_en: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Ali Akbar Ahmadian (Zolghadr) listed conditions including a permanent halt to military action against Iran and its regional allies, an end to the naval blockade, war reparations and the lifting of sanctions, saying the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen until the U.S. corrects its behavior; U.S. Vice President JD Vance said the U.S.-Iran conflict is not over and that Washington is using diplomatic, economic and military means. The segment also reported Iranian media claims that U.S. forces used phosphorus munitions in strikes on Fars and Bushehr provinces, and U.S. media reports that U.S. Patriot interceptor stocks have fallen below 1,700.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's direct geothermal energy utilization ranks first in the world, with heating and cooling capacity reaching 1.65 billion square meters; that national vegetable acreage in late July stood at 106 million mu with ample supply; that the first phase of the Bozhong 19-6 gas field, the Bohai Sea's first trillion-cubic-meter gas field, has fully entered production; and that a university-county talent matching event, the 16th National Fitness Week for Persons with Disabilities, and the 2026 China AI Gala were also held or broadcast.

title_en: Cultural China Tour: Living Protection Brings New Luster to Pingyao Ancient City
summary_en: The segment reports on Pingyao Ancient City, a 2,800-year-old walled town inscribed as a World Cultural Heritage site in 1997 along with the Zhenguo and Shuanglin temples, highlighting its new virtual-reality experience hall, a four-year infrastructure renovation covering 121 streets and alleys, restoration of historic residences, and digital preservation work at Shuanglin Temple conducted with Zhejiang University.

title_en: China's Ecological Restoration and Governance Achieve New Results
summary_en: The segment reports that China is advancing integrated protection and systematic governance of mountains, rivers, forests, farmlands, lakes, grasslands and deserts, citing technological advances in Zhangjiakou, Hebei that raised sapling survival rates on nearly 10,000 mu of sandy land to 92 percent, and a tropical rainforest ecological corridor taking shape in Hainan. It adds that a new batch of landscape projects will launch this year in key areas including the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau ecological barrier zone and the Yellow and Yangtze River regions, and that central fiscal subsidy policies will for the first time support joint cross-provincial project applications.

title_en: China Accelerates Building of 'One Map' Platform for Natural Resources
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reported on August 9 that China is accelerating construction of a 'One Map' platform for natural resources, which has so far aggregated 4.14 billion spatial data records and enables coordinated handling of tasks such as zoning control and land registration across natural resources departments. The report cited examples in Jiangsu and Zhejiang, where the platform supports multi-layer overlay analysis and cross-departmental data sharing, and said China will deepen its construction and application to improve intelligent governance.

title_en: July Consumer Price Index Maintains Moderate Rise
summary_en: Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on August 9 shows that the consumer price index (CPI) for July rose 0.5% year-on-year, a moderate increase, with food prices such as grain, fresh vegetables and fresh fruit declining slightly year-on-year while service prices such as domestic services and dining out rose at a generally stable pace. In the production sector, the producer price index (PPI) rose 3.5% year-on-year in July, with the year-on-year gain easing somewhat due to input factors including a pullback in international crude oil prices.

title_en: Typhoon "White Dolphin" Makes Landfall; Localities and Departments Mount Full Response
summary_en: Typhoon "White Dolphin," the 13th typhoon of the year, made landfall near Yuhuan, Zhejiang, on the afternoon of August 9 with maximum winds of force 14, prompting Zhejiang to raise its typhoon emergency response to Level I and leading coastal areas to suspend work, classes, business and transport. The segment also reports on preparations in Fujian and Shanghai, rail and flight cancellations across the Yangtze River Delta, and emergency responses launched by the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management.

title_en: China Strengthens Long-Term Stable Support for Basic Research
summary_en: CCTV reports that in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China is steadily increasing investment in basic research, with the central government allocating a basic research budget of 116.938 billion yuan for the year, up 16.3% from the previous year's execution figure and well above the 10% overall growth in science and technology spending. The segment also highlights efforts to diversify funding sources, including a 77 million yuan joint fund between the National Natural Science Foundation of China and a Jiangsu pharmaceutical company and participation by eight leading Jiangsu enterprises that leveraged 124 million yuan in social capital.

title_en: China Accelerates Construction of National Computing Power Network
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that China is speeding up the buildout of its integrated national computing power network, with intelligent computing capacity up 177% year-on-year by the end of June and over 60% of national computing resources now under unified monitoring and scheduling.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: The 'Stability' and 'Progress' Behind a Bumper Harvest
summary_en: The segment reports on China's implementation of its national food security strategy, highlighting that summer grain output exceeded 300 billion jin for the first time, and covers high-standard farmland construction, upgrades to agricultural machinery and drones, and new crop varieties, citing Xi Jinping's emphasis on grain security and self-reliance.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: Japan's food self-sufficiency rate fell to a record-low 37% on a calorie basis in fiscal 2025, according to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, while drought pushed the water level of Lake Mead, the largest U.S. reservoir, to its lowest point since it was first filled in 1937.

title_en: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan Sign Joint Defense Agreement
summary_en: The leaders of Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement in Mecca on the 7th, under which an armed attack on any one of the three countries would be treated as an attack on all three, and the pact also promotes stronger defense cooperation across various fields. Turkey's Communications Directorate said the agreement does not conflict with NATO Article 5, the collective defense clause, after some commentary argued that Turkey's signing violated Article 5 and created a parallel alliance structure.

title_en: Iran says it and Oman have defined the general framework of a Hormuz Strait agreement
summary_en: Iran's parliament national security and foreign policy committee spokesman said Iran and Oman have defined the general framework of an agreement on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, with the final text and details to be announced soon; Reuters reported that a US official said Washington would lift its naval blockade of Iran once commercial shipping resumes under the deal, and CNN reported that Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Dan Caine is seeking a way out of the war with Iran.

title_en: Immigration Dispute Sparks Divisions as Spain Introduces Countermeasures Against Italy
summary_en: Spain's government announced on the 7th that from August 8 to September 7 it will carry out border checks on travelers arriving from Italy at airports and ports, after Italy refused to lift border controls imposed on Spain over the Ceuta immigration crisis. The move follows a surge of illegal migrants entering the Spanish North African enclave of Ceuta from Morocco, prompting Italy on July 31 to suspend the Schengen free-travel arrangement with Spain and restore border checks.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that domestic tourist trips reached 346.3 million in the first half of 2026, up 5.4% year-on-year, with total tourism spending of 3.21 trillion yuan; it also covers the release of a national happy rivers and lakes construction plan for 2026–2028, the 15th Five-Year Plan for civil aviation development, and the Yixin'ou China-Europe freight train surpassing 100,000 TEU in exports this year.

title_en: Typhoon "Bailudun" Approaches as Localities Step Up Precautions
summary_en: CCTV reports that Typhoon Bailudun, the 13th typhoon of the year, remains at strong typhoon level and is expected to make landfall along the coast from Zhoushan, Zhejiang, to Fuding, Fujian, between the night of August 9 and the morning of August 10. Zhejiang raised its typhoon emergency response to Level II, suspending coastal passenger routes and ferry crossings and halting port operations, while Fujian halted all 115 offshore construction projects and evacuated more than 59,000 vessels, and Shanghai began lowering river network water levels through its sluices.

title_en: Summer study-tour travel heats up as students gain knowledge on the road
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that students and families make up over 60% of summer travelers this year, up 8 percentage points from last year, with bookings for "follow-the-textbook" study tours rising more than 60% year on year. The segment highlights study-tour activities at venues including the Hubei Provincial Museum, red-tourism sites in Yudu, Jiangxi, the Museum of the Communist Party of China (featuring the newly displayed Shenzhou-17 return capsule), the Zhejiang intangible cultural heritage museum, and the newly opened Shenzhen Natural History Museum.

title_en: Frontline Investigation: Rail Links Spark New Consumer Vitality
summary_en: The segment reports that China's railway authorities are adding customized train services, such as the new G3119/G3120 service between Jinan and Xuchang East, to meet cross-province shopping and sports travel demand, and that in the first half of the year tourist train services rose 84.8% year-on-year, with multi-ride tourist tickets selling over 66,000 and directly driving 4.44 billion yuan in spending along the routes.

title_en: National Power Load Hits Record High; Power Supply Guarantees Respond Actively
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that nationwide electricity demand reached a new high of 1.557 billion kilowatts on August 7, the fourth record this year, with 25 provinces and regions setting new peaks, and that cross-provincial and cross-regional power transmission exceeded 278 million kilowatts alongside new measures such as energy storage stations in Shandong and virtual power plants in Shenzhen to ensure stable summer supply.

title_en: China's Pharmaceutical Industry Sees Accelerated Innovation Breakthroughs in First Half of Year
summary_en: CCTV reports that 38 innovative drugs were approved in China in the first half of 2025, 31 of them domestically developed, and that China now accounts for one-third of the world's 4,751 innovative drugs in research and development. The segment also notes that outbound licensing deals for Chinese innovative drugs totaled $110 billion in the period, with pharmaceutical export delivery value up 9% year-on-year.

title_en: China's Business Entity Structure Continued to Optimize in First Half of the Year
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The State Administration for Market Regulation announced data on August 8 showing that in the first half of this year, 561,000 new enterprises were established in the "8 major emerging industries" and "9 major future industries," including 55,000 new generative AI enterprises (up 28.0% year-on-year) and 116,000 new humanoid robotics enterprises (up 9.5% year-on-year), while 3.957 million new service-sector enterprises were added, including 1.475 million in cultural tourism, and new enterprises in spacecraft and launch vehicle manufacturing and in optical fiber and cable manufacturing grew 185.7% and 129.4% year-on-year respectively.

title_en: Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements: Prioritizing People's Livelihood and Ensuring Learning Outcomes Are Implemented
summary_en: The segment reports that since the launch of the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, Jilin's Changchun and Inner Mongolia's Hinggan League have integrated study, inspection, and rectification, addressing issues affecting residents such as street vendor regulation in Changchun and agricultural service gaps in Hinggan League, where 25 comprehensive agricultural and livestock service centers now serve over 27,000 households.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Improving the Public Fitness Service System So Development Gains Benefit All the People
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Xi Jinping has described nationwide fitness as the foundation for strengthening the people's health and calls for implementing the national fitness strategy; on the 18th National Fitness Day (August 8), the second National Fitness Games are being held across the country with over 6,000 events and an expected 2 million-plus direct participants, alongside official plans to expand sports facilities and public fitness services.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: Start of Autumn
summary_en: The segment explains that the Start of Autumn (Liqiu) is the first solar term of autumn, marking the beginning of the season, and describes traditional customs such as sun-drying crops and the "biting autumn" practice of eating seasonal foods.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports a Reuters/Ipsos poll finding that 50% of Americans believe U.S. military action in Iran will destabilize the Middle East, Saudi accusations that Yemen's Houthis attacked civilian targets in Najran province, Japan's second-quarter yen interventions totaling over 11 trillion yen, ongoing wildfires in Spokane County, Washington, and drought-driven low water levels on European rivers including the Rhine and Danube.

title_en: Iran Says It Plans to Bar Adversaries from Strait of Hormuz
summary_en: Iranian media reported that Salimi, a member of the Iranian parliament's presiding board, made public a preliminary text of a strategic management plan for the Strait of Hormuz that would bar ships from the United States, Israel and other countries from passing through the strait and prohibit military and civilian goods linked to Israel from transiting the area, with violators facing fines of up to 20 percent of the value of the cargo. Separately, U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States has ample supplies of powerful munitions but is slightly tight on some other types of ammunition, and that U.S. defense companies are building production facilities for weapons including Patriot and Tomahawk missiles.

title_en: Japanese citizens rally against dangerous moves by Takaichi administration
summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of the Hiroshima atomic bombing, some Japanese citizens marched in Hiroshima opposing the Japanese government's attempt to revise the "Three Non-Nuclear Principles," and protests were also held in Osaka. Russian Foreign Ministry deputy director Fadeyev urged the Japanese government to remember history and adhere to the path of peace.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters raised its flood and typhoon emergency response to Level III for Zhejiang and Fujian ahead of Typhoon Dolphin's expected landfall, and covers China's foreign exchange reserves, the July warehousing index, fair competition review results, growth in the national medical insurance drug list, 2026 summer box office figures, a CMG film culture event in Wuhan, and an interview with UNFCCC Executive Secretary Simon Stiell.

title_en: China's Key Ecological Protection Areas Show Notable Conservation Results
summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released an assessment finding that 98.9% of China's 452 national-level nature reserves are rated excellent or good, with wildlife populations increasing, and that areas within the ecological protection red lines now exceed 30% of China's land territory and show overall environmental improvement.

title_en: New Energy Heavy Truck Sales Hit New High in First Half of Year
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's new energy heavy truck sales rose 78.6% year-on-year to about 140,000 units in the first half of 2025, with applications expanding from ports and coal routes to urban logistics and cross-provincial freight. The segment notes a 22 billion yuan ultra-long special treasury bond allocation to support scrapping and upgrading old operating trucks, and a plan to build 30,000 km of zero-carbon road freight corridors with over 3,000 electric heavy truck battery-swap and charging stations by 2030.

title_en: Large-scale yield-per-unit-area improvement efforts continue, consolidating the foundation for stable autumn grain production
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that as autumn grain enters its critical yield-formation period, China is expanding a campaign to raise per-unit-area yields, with 20 cities and 1,000 counties designated for whole-area promotion and new technologies such as wide-narrow row dense planting, precision drip irrigation, integrated water-fertilizer systems, and multispectral drone field monitoring being applied in Jilin, Shandong, and Anhui. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs has issued technical guidance on coping with high temperatures and drought for corn, rice, and soybeans ahead of the autumn harvest in about two months.

title_en: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Exceed 30 Trillion Yuan in First Seven Months of the Year
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that China's total goods trade imports and exports reached 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months of the year, up 17.3% year-on-year and surpassing 30 trillion yuan for the first time in the same period in history, with exports at 17.44 trillion yuan (up 14%) and imports at 12.69 trillion yuan (up 22%). In July alone, imports and exports totaled 4.66 trillion yuan, up 19.2% year-on-year, while trade with Belt and Road partner countries grew 15.5% and with other APEC economies 21%.

title_en: Focusing Efforts, Working Diligently to Achieve a Good Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan: Seizing the High Ground, Shanghai Cultivates New Models for Future Industries
summary_en: Shanghai is cultivating future industries under the 15th Five-Year Plan by deploying project manager teams across more than 20 future industry tracks, including brain-computer interfaces, quantum computing, 6G and green fuels, alongside 19 high-quality incubators and a future industries fund of about 15 billion yuan. The segment reports that in the first half of this year Shanghai verified nearly 200 research results in future industries, with goals of nurturing about 20 ecosystem-leading enterprises by 2027 and becoming a globally influential leader in future industries by 2030.

title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Expanding and Upgrading Service Consumption, Unleashing New Vitality in Domestic Demand
summary_en: The segment reports that service consumption is increasingly driving domestic demand in China, with service retail sales up 5.3% year-on-year in the first half of 2025 and per capita spending on services reaching 45.7% of total consumption expenditure. It cites Xi Jinping's calls to expand quality service supply and release consumption potential, and describes central and local measures including 12 policies on service consumption, an "AI plus consumption" initiative, and improved departure tax refund and visa-free policies that helped travel service exports reach 229.2 billion yuan, up 31.1% year-on-year.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that Yemen's Houthi forces claimed to have attacked two Saudi oil tankers in a single day, that Israeli forces struck southern Lebanon amid reports of paused Israel-Lebanon talks, that the UN warned a strengthening El Niño could sharply worsen food insecurity, that a UK report found some AI models engaged in harmful behavior during testing, and that FIFA apologized over a withdrawn commercial proposal for a subsidiary.

title_en: Iran Says Talks with Oman on Strait of Hormuz Near Agreement
summary_en: Iran's Foreign Ministry said on the 5th that Iran and Oman are close to finalizing an agreement on commercial vessel passage through the Strait of Hormuz, having reached consensus on the geographic coordinates of a planned shipping route; Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi stressed that the arrangement should be decided only by Iran and Oman and rejected any outside interference, while U.S. Central Command said on the 5th that U.S. forces continue a maritime blockade against Iran.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the NDRC allocated 50 million yuan for post-flood recovery in Shaanxi, China's commodity price index rose 15.5% year-on-year in July, data property rights registration is being accelerated, a new 1:5,000,000-scale geological map of the Moon was completed, the Supreme People's Court issued the first supporting judicial interpretation of the ecological environment code, the Harbin-Yichun high-speed railway began trial operations, the Xiong'an AI training base was put into operation, and the SCO 'Tianshan-2026' joint cyber counterterrorism exercise was held in Urumqi, Xinjiang.

title_en: China's First Offshore Floating Wind Power Platform Resistant to Category 17 Typhoons Officially Enters Operation
summary_en: The "Haiyou Anlan" tension-leg floating wind platform, installed at a water depth of 136 meters and designed to withstand Category 17 typhoons, has been connected to the Lufeng oilfield grid and is expected to supply 54 million kWh of green electricity annually while cutting 350,000 tons of CO2 emissions. Its commissioning marks China's deep-sea floating wind equipment technology reaching the world's forefront.

title_en: China's "Hualong One" Nuclear Power Technology Undergoes Comprehensive Iterative Upgrade
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Reporters learned from CNNC that China's self-developed third-generation nuclear power reactor "Hualong One" will undergo an iterative upgrade, with the first batch of "Hualong One" 2.0 demonstration projects recently landing at the Zhejiang JinQimen and Guangdong Taipingling nuclear power bases. At the Zhejiang JinQimen nuclear power base, two units of the Phase II project are undergoing preparatory work before construction begins; this is the national-level first-reactor demonstration project for the "Hualong One" 2.0 version.

title_en: Party Flag Flies High at the Grassroots: In a Life-or-Death Moment, Giving Hope to Others
summary_en: Li Yang, 30, party branch secretary and village committee director of Lifeng Village in Hantai Town, Nanzheng District, Hanzhong, Shaanxi, died after his vehicle was swept into a river during a flood inspection amid heavy rain; he pushed his colleague Li Guifu out of the car window and onto the roof, saving him, while Li Yang was carried away by the current and his body was found on August 2.

title_en: China's Rural Specialty Industries Upgrade Across the Entire Chain in First Half of the Year
summary_en: The segment reports that in the first half of the year, new equipment and technologies helped rural specialty industries upgrade across the entire chain, with above-scale agricultural and sideline food processing value added rising 4.8% year-on-year and rural residents' per capita disposable income growing 5.5% in real terms.

title_en: China's Foreign Investment Structure Continues to Improve Toward New Sectors
summary_en: CCTV reports that foreign investment in China has stabilized and improved this year, with high-tech industries attracting 33.2% more foreign capital year-on-year in the first half of 2025, accounting for 42.4% of total inbound investment, as multinationals expand R&D and innovation centers in China.

title_en: China's Machinery Industry Sees Steady Economic Performance with Progress in H1
summary_en: CCTV reports that in the first half of the year, China's machinery industry posted steady growth with accelerating transformation toward new and higher-quality development, with value-added output of above-scale enterprises up 6.4% year-on-year, outpacing national industry and manufacturing growth, and all 14 sub-sectors seeing revenue increases.

title_en: Striving to Open New Prospects for Chinese-Style Modernization — A Chronicle of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Governance Since the Start of This Year: Continuing to Advance the Building of a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind, Injecting More Positive Energy into the World
summary_en: The segment reviews Xi Jinping's head-of-state diplomacy in 2026, including meetings with U.S. President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, Irish Prime Minister Micheál Martin, Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, then-UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer, Slovak President Peter Pellegrini, Uruguayan President Yamandú Orsi, Mozambican President Daniel Chapo and Namibian President Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah, and his AI governance proposals at the July 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on U.S. media claims of critical U.S. munitions shortages that Defense Secretary Hegseth denied, a large-scale Russian strike on Kyiv and Ukraine's air defense response, Brazil's accusation that the U.S. revoked its ambassador's visa, the repatriation of about 70,000 of roughly 72,000 migrants who entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta illegally, European wildfire and heat losses exceeding 3.1 billion euros, and U.S. Customs refunding about $100 billion in tariffs.

title_en: Japanese Figures Oppose Establishment of 'National Intelligence Agency' and Japan's 'Remilitarization'
summary_en: Japanese and international figures criticized the Japanese government's formal establishment of a "National Intelligence Agency" as a dangerous step toward military expansion, warning it threatens regional security and peace. North Korean Workers' Party Central Committee department director Kim Yo Jong, in remarks reported by KCNA on August 5, accused Japan of denying and glorifying its history of aggression and of accelerating its transformation into a "war state."

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's enterprise credit index stood at 161.88 in the first half of the year, the Ministry of Finance issued 15 billion yuan of government bonds in Hong Kong, and over 70 billion yuan in entrepreneurship loans were extended to veterans nationwide. It also covers consumer complaint resolutions, wildlife trafficking enforcement under "Operation Breeze 2026," the Jielong-3 rocket launching two AI-equipped hyperspectral satellites, Hainan duty-free shopping figures, and Typhoon Baihaitun's approach toward East China.

title_en: Vital China Research Tour: Talent Embedded in Industrial Chains
summary_en: The segment reports that Suzhou, a major manufacturing city, has matched universities and research institutes with each of its key industrial clusters, embedding researchers directly in production lines; it highlights a Harbin Institute of Technology postdoctoral researcher whose "data flywheel" system generates 100,000 valid data entries a month for a local firm, and notes that Suzhou now cooperates with over 200 domestic and foreign universities and institutes, with tens of thousands of sci-tech talents embedded in 30 key industrial clusters and nearly 10,000 industry-academia-research projects underway.

title_en: Shenzhou-21 Astronaut Crew Meets Press in Beijing
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reported that the Shenzhou-21 astronaut crew—Zhang Lu, Wu Fei, and Zhang Hongzhang—held their first public press meeting in Beijing on August 5 after returning to Earth and completing quarantine and recovery, and are in good physical and mental condition. The mission, launched on October 31, 2025, from Jiuquan, set a new record of 210 days in orbit, completed three spacewalks and numerous scientific experiments, and marked several firsts in China's crewed space program, including a delayed return due to space debris impact, a crew returning on a different spacecraft, and an emergency launch.

title_en: China's Total Services Imports and Exports Achieve Relatively Fast Growth in First Half of the Year
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Data released by the Ministry of Commerce shows that in the first half of this year, China's total services imports and exports reached 3.77975 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year on year, with services exports up 17.6% and imports up 2.9%. Knowledge-intensive services exports grew 12.8% year on year and accounted for 53.5% of total services exports, while travel services exports, driven by a rise in inbound tourism, maintained growth of more than 30%.

title_en: Industrial Innovation Vitality Further Stimulated in First Half of Year
summary_en: Citing tax data from the State Taxation Administration, the segment reports that tax and fee reductions and rebates supporting technological innovation and manufacturing exceeded 1.9 trillion yuan in the first half of the year, with digital economy core industries' sales revenue up 8.7% year-on-year and emerging industries such as smart vehicle equipment, drones, and robotics growing 43%, 36.2%, and 27.3% respectively.

title_en: Striving to Open a New Phase in Chinese-Style Modernization — A Chronicle of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Governance Since the Start of This Year: Tempering Original Aspiration and Mission, Building the Party Stronger and More Capable
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, the Communist Party of China marked its 105th anniversary, with General Secretary Xi Jinping awarding the July 1 Medal, stressing the need to improve the Party's capacity to lead economic and social development, and launching a Party-wide education campaign on adopting a correct view of political achievements. The segment also covers the Politburo's decision to hold the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee in October to study persistent advancement of full and rigorous Party self-governance, and first-half 2026 disciplinary inspection figures.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that U.S. President Donald Trump said negotiations with Iran are underway and threatened large-scale strikes, that Russia's Pacific Fleet began exercises in the northwestern Pacific, that a Turkish cargo ship was hit by a drone in the Black Sea, that 25 Democratic-led U.S. states sued over new tariffs, that South Korea protested Japan's defense white paper claim to Dokdo, and that Cuba suffered two nationwide blackouts within 24 hours.

title_en: Wildfires Out of Control in Multiple US Locations; US Media Say Fires May Last for Weeks
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): Wildfires are raging in multiple parts of the United States; according to the National Interagency Fire Center, 10 of the 16 large fires still burning in Washington State are out of control, and US media report the fires could last for weeks. Washington Governor Bob Ferguson has asked the federal government to declare a disaster in six counties, while in neighboring Oregon at least 33 large fires remained not fully contained as of the morning of the 3rd; the segment also reports on heat, drought and wildfires in Italy, France, the Netherlands and Greece.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on China's 15th Five-Year Plan for geological disaster prevention, a 99.51% food safety sampling pass rate in the first half of 2026, new Ministry of Education guidelines for hands-on science education in compulsory schooling, a four-track online recruitment drive, and strengthening El Niño conditions expected to peak in autumn and winter.

title_en: Summer Travel Continues to Heat Up, Spurring Urban and Rural Consumption Vitality
summary_en: The segment reports that localities across China are expanding summer tourism and consumption offerings, from coastal and water-based activities in Qinhuangdao, Nanchang and Guiyang to cool-weather forest tourism at Liupan Mountain in Ningxia, alongside immersive museum and archaeological-site experiences for children. It notes that Guiyang's coffee industry, with over 3,000 cafés and nearly 50% annual growth in coffee consumption, has created more than 15,000 jobs.

title_en: Frontline Investigation: After the Storm, Jasmine Blooms
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports from Hengzhou, Guangxi, the world's largest jasmine production base, where nearly 60% of flower fields were damaged by Typhoon Maysak; it covers the recovery of flower farmers, market trading, and government agricultural support as production gradually resumes.

title_en: State Council establishes investigation and assessment team for the '7·17' particularly major landslide disaster in Hanjia Street, Pengshui, Chongqing
summary_en: The State Council formed an investigation and assessment team, led by the Ministry of Emergency Management with participation from the Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, China Meteorological Administration and the Chongqing Municipal People's Government, to investigate the July 17 landslide in Hanjia Street, Pengshui County, Chongqing, which caused major casualties. The team held its first plenary meeting in Pengshui on August 4, chaired by team leader Wang Kun, a member of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Emergency Management and head of the China Earthquake Administration, and observed a moment of silence for the victims.

title_en: Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Continues to Expand, Market Demand Further Improves
summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported on August 4 that China's logistics industry prosperity index stood at 50.4% in July, remaining in expansion, with the new orders index rising month-on-month for a fifth consecutive month and expansion accelerating in July. The segment also noted growth in rail, road, and postal express business volumes, high prosperity in multimodal transport, and a rebound in logistics orders for tourism, outdoor goods, local specialties, and fresh products as summer consumption demand was released.

title_en: Construction of Major Scientific Facilities Accelerates Across China as Innovation Results Emerge
summary_en: The segment reports that China has more than 70 national major science and technology infrastructure projects under construction or in operation, ranking second globally in total scale, with clusters in Beijing Huairou, Shanghai Zhangjiang, Hefei in Anhui, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. It highlights recent results including the LHAASO cosmic-ray observatory in Daocheng, Sichuan, identifying a Cygnus binary system as the highest-energy particle accelerator in the Milky Way, FAST's discovery of nearly 1,300 pulsars, and progress on facilities such as the China Spallation Neutron Source phase II and a high-intensity heavy-ion accelerator.

title_en: Striving to Open a New Phase in Chinese-Style Modernization — A Chronicle of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Governance Since the Start of This Year: Getting Done, One by One, the Things Ordinary People Care About
summary_en: The segment reviews Xi Jinping's domestic inspections and remarks since the start of the year, including visits to a renovated residential community in Shanghai's Huangpu District, a rural household in Leling, Shandong, an elderly-care service block in Beijing's Xicheng District, and a school in the Xiong'an New Area, emphasizing elderly care, employment, health, the environment, and disaster prevention as part of a people-centered approach to governance.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Israeli airstrikes on Gaza that killed at least 18 people, with Israeli Energy Minister Eli Cohen saying Israel has not agreed to halt its military campaign; Russia's Defense Ministry claiming it downed 1,158 fixed-wing drones in a day, a reported single-day record, while Ukraine reported long-range strikes on Russian targets; seven major OPEC+ producers including Saudi Arabia and Russia deciding to raise September output by 188,000 barrels per day; Japan and the United States jointly intervening in currency markets for the first time in 15 years, announced by Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama; and US media reporting that Immigration and Customs Enforcement arrested more than 46,000 people in July, a monthly high for the current administration.

title_en: Washington State Wildfires Destroy Hundreds of Buildings, 60,000 Ordered to Evacuate
summary_en: Wildfires in Washington State have burned over 1,000 square kilometers, destroyed at least 600 buildings in Spokane County, and prompted evacuation orders for about 60,000 people, while the governor issued a statewide ban on most open burning through late September. The segment also reports that wildfires in Greece are approaching Athens, forcing evacuations on Kefalonia, and that two firefighting helicopters collided midair in the Attica region, killing two people.

title_en: US President Says US-Iran Talks to Be Held August 3; Iran Says No Talks with US Currently
summary_en: US President Trump said talks with Iran would begin on August 3, a day after announcing the cancellation of a planned military strike on Iran, but Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei said on August 3 that Iran currently has no talks with the US and no plans to receive or send delegations. Separately, Iran said it is discussing with Oman the designation of a new shipping route in the Strait of Hormuz, with Iranian media reporting that talks on joint management of the strait are in their final stage.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that China's software business revenue reached 771.82 billion yuan in the first half of the year, up 9.5% year-on-year, that 103 new international air cargo routes opened in the first seven months, and that the first phase of the Guangdong Taipingling nuclear power project, the Greater Bay Area's first Hualong One project, was fully completed and connected to the grid.

title_en: Persistent Heavy Rain Across Multiple Western Regions; Localities Actively Respond
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reports that sustained heavy rainfall has hit multiple areas of western China, prompting local evacuations and emergency measures in Shaanxi's Hanzhong and Shangluo, Sichuan's Bazhong, and Chongqing's Kaizhou, while the national disaster and emergency authorities dispatched a work team to Shaanxi and allocated 65,000 central relief items, and the national flood control headquarters launched a Level IV emergency response for Yunnan.

title_en: China-Europe Railway Express Achieves Notable Results in High-Quality Development
summary_en: CCTV News reports, citing the National Development and Reform Commission, that since the China-Europe Railway Express adopted a unified brand in June 2016, cumulative runs have exceeded 130,000 and cargo value has surpassed $520 billion, with service to 236 cities in 26 European countries across 96 routes.

title_en: China Accelerates Building of Green, Low-Carbon Power Supply Structure
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reported the release of the "15th Five-Year Plan" for Building a New-Type Power System, which aims to basically establish a green, low-carbon power supply structure by 2030, with non-fossil energy accounting for 50% of electricity generation and west-to-east power transmission exceeding 420 million kilowatts.

title_en: China's Gross Ocean Product Reaches 5.5 Trillion Yuan in First Half of Year
summary_en: China's Ministry of Natural Resources reported that the country's gross ocean product reached 5.5 trillion yuan in the first half of the year, up 5.1 percent year-on-year and outpacing overall GDP growth, driven by gains in traditional marine industries, marine aquaculture, and emerging sectors such as ocean engineering equipment and marine biopharmaceuticals.

title_en: National Ecological and Environmental Quality Continues to Improve in First Half of the Year
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo): The Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported that in the first half of this year China deepened its battle against pollution and ecological and environmental quality continued to improve. Among 339 cities at prefecture level and above, average PM2.5 concentration was 29.9 micrograms per cubic meter, down 6.6% year on year, and the share of days with good or excellent air quality reached 82.8%, up 4.5 percentage points; the proportion of surface water at Grade I-III reached 87.4%, up 3 percentage points, while the share of sections worse than Grade V fell to 0.9%, down 1.2 percentage points.

title_en: Establishing and Practicing a Correct View of Political Achievements: Benefiting Livelihoods and Promoting Development, Ensuring Learning and Education Achieve Real Results
summary_en: The segment reports that Xi'an in Shaanxi and Dingxi in Gansu have combined a learning and education campaign on a correct view of political achievements with improving livelihoods and promoting development, with Xi'an rectifying 46,000 property management problems and Dingxi recovering more than 60 million yuan in unpaid wages for over 4,000 migrant workers.

title_en: Cai Qi Visits and Greets Experts on Summer Break in Beidaihe
summary_en: Entrusted by Xi Jinping, Politburo Standing Committee member and Secretariat Secretary Cai Qi visited experts vacationing in Beidaihe on August 3 and conveyed greetings from the Party Central Committee and State Council. Cai praised the experts' contributions to talent development and innovation, and Politburo member and Organization Department head Shi Taifeng and State Councilor and Secretary-General Wu Zhenglong joined the visit.

title_en: Striving to Open a New Phase in Chinese-Style Modernization — A Chronicle of General Secretary Xi Jinping's Governance Since the Start of This Year: Solidly Supporting and Leading Chinese-Style Modernization Through Scientific and Technological Innovation
summary_en: The segment reviews Xi Jinping's science and technology initiatives in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, including his keynote at the July 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai, a Politburo study session on future industries, an April symposium on strengthening basic research, and the July 8 national science and technology awards conference, while citing advances such as the Long March 10B rocket's sea-based recovery and the Jiuzhang-4 quantum computer.

title_en: International News Roundup
