summary_en: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met Pakistani Army Chief of Staff Munir in Tehran to discuss regional tensions, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said toppling the Iranian regime is the only way to eliminate the military threat; separately, the UK said it will send Typhoon fighter jets to help Saudi Arabia defend against Houthi attacks, France will deploy counterterrorism forces ahead of protests, and European natural gas prices topped 90 euros per megawatt-hour for the first time in nearly four years.

title_en: US President's Special Envoy Meets Separately with Ukrainian and Russian Leaders to Discuss Ukraine
summary_en: US President's Special Envoy Witkoff met with Ukrainian President Zelensky in Oslo on the 20th, alongside European leaders and EU and NATO representatives, in talks US officials described as making "substantive progress" on a comprehensive peace framework; the next day Witkoff met Russian President Putin in St. Petersburg, where he presented documents outlining ideas for resolving the Ukraine issue and expressed hope that Putin would consider resuming trilateral Russian-US-Ukrainian talks.

title_en: Japanese citizens rally for second day outside Diet against Takaichi administration's military buildup and constitutional revision
summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that Japanese citizens held rallies outside the National Diet on the evenings of the 19th and 20th, opposing the military buildup and constitutional revision moves of the administration of Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and calling for the preservation of peace. The segment also reports that Japanese figures from various sectors criticized Takaichi's offering of ritual goods and祭祀 fees to Yasukuni Shrine and visits to the shrine by some Japanese politicians as evidence of a lack of reflection on Japan's history of aggression.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued a 15th Five-Year Plan for protecting urban and rural historical and cultural heritage, that the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting approved joint statements on digital infrastructure financing and inclusive finance, and that the NDRC released a first batch of 136 landmark major application scenario projects. It also covers new judicial accountability regulations, the launch of a Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei hydrogen energy pilot city cluster, the opening of the 32nd Yiwu International Commodities Fair, and the 2026 Physical AI and World Models Conference in Nanjing.

title_en: State Council Information Office Holds 'Strivers on the New Journey' Press Conference with Chinese and Foreign Journalists
summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on October 21 featuring five representatives from the judicial administration field, who discussed their grassroots work in administrative law enforcement supervision, anti-drug publicity, and public legal services, highlighting their role in building a higher-level peaceful China and rule-of-law China.

title_en: China Achieves Notable Results in Climate Change Response
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 21, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment released the 2026 Annual Report on China's Policies and Actions for Addressing Climate Change, reporting significant progress through measures such as optimizing energy and industrial structures and improving market mechanisms. The report noted that China has issued 113 national carbon emission management standards, built the world's largest carbon emissions trading market with cumulative trading volume exceeding 1 billion tons, and aims to meet its 2030 nationally determined contribution targets on schedule during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

title_en: People's Bank of China Introduces Multiple Financial Policies
summary_en: At the 2026 Financial Street Forum annual meeting, the People's Bank of China announced a series of policy measures to better serve high-quality development of the real economy and high-level financial opening, including steps to support Beijing, Shanghai, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area in building world-class venture capital centers, pilot programs in international science and technology innovation centers, and new liquidity support tools for non-bank institutions facing large redemptions.

title_en: New growth drivers accelerate, driving role continues to strengthen
summary_en: CCTV reports that China's new growth drivers have accelerated this year and are playing an increasingly strong role in driving the economy, citing National Development and Reform Commission data: breakthroughs in core integrated-circuit technologies, global downloads of AI open-source large models exceeding 10 billion, humanoid robot shipments accounting for over 90% of the global total, $130 billion in outbound technology licensing for innovative drugs in the first three quarters, and a 53.6% penetration rate for new energy vehicles.

title_en: China's Consumer Market Continues to Expand in First Three Quarters
summary_en: CCTV reports that total retail sales of consumer goods and services grew 2.6% year-on-year in the first three quarters, with services retail up 5.0% and online retail reaching 151.471 billion yuan, up 4.4%.

title_en: Getting Off to a Good Start in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period: China Accelerates Building a Broad Safety and Emergency Management Framework
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 21, officials from the Ministry of Emergency Management and other departments outlined plans to modernize China's national emergency management system and capacity during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including shifting toward pre-incident prevention, strengthening disaster response capabilities, and improving workplace safety hazard investigation and governance.

title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Foreign Guests Attending 2026 International Science Council Mid-Term Members' Meeting and Beijing Science Dialogue
summary_en: Politburo Standing Committee member and Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang met in Beijing on the 21st with foreign guests attending the 2026 International Science Council Mid-Term Members' Meeting and Beijing Science Dialogue. Ding said China is willing to work with all parties to uphold openness and cooperation in science and technology, while International Science Council President Gluckman praised China's scientific and technological achievements and voiced support for open cooperation.

title_en: Li Qiang and Russian Prime Minister Mishustin Co-Chair the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting
summary_en: On the morning of October 21 local time in St. Petersburg, Premier Li Qiang and Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin co-chaired the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting, where both sides agreed to deepen cooperation in key areas such as trade, energy, and connectivity. After the meeting, the two premiers signed a joint communique and reached cooperation documents in fields including trade, space, science and technology, and education.

title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in St. Petersburg for 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang arrived in St. Petersburg on the evening of October 20 at the invitation of Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin to hold the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting, and said that under the strategic guidance of President Xi Jinping and President Vladimir Putin, China-Russia relations have become more mature and resilient. Li arrived after concluding an official visit to Tajikistan and attending the 25th Meeting of the Council of Heads of Government (Prime Ministers) of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization in Dushanbe.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Do Not Forget the Original Aspiration, Take the New Long March Well
summary_en: CCTV aired this quick commentary on October 21 on the theme of not forgetting the original aspiration and carrying forward the new Long March.

title_en: Ren Zhongping Article in People's Daily: Striding Forward on the New Long March — Written on the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the People's Daily will publish a Ren Zhongping article on October 22 titled "Striding Forward on the New Long March — Written on the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March."

title_en: People's Daily Editorial: Marching Together on the New Long March — Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the People's Daily will publish an editorial on October 22 titled "Marching Together on the New Long March — Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March."

title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit, Forging Ahead on the Road to Rejuvenation: Continuing to Press Forward Bravely on the New Long March
summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, the segment recounts Xi Jinping's remarks on the Great Long March Spirit and reports on former revolutionary base areas' development, including modern agriculture in Tantou Village in Yudu, Jiangxi, poverty alleviation outcomes, infrastructure projects such as the Sichuan-Qinghai Railway and the Central Yunnan Water Diversion Project, and clean-energy and computing hubs in Gansu, Qinghai and Anhui.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova criticizing the Japan-U.S. "Keen Sword 27" joint exercise as part of Japan's "remilitarization" and a risk to regional security, Houthi attacks on Saudi targets near Aden airport and Riyadh International Airport in Hadramawt, a U.S. State Department order for the departure of non-emergency government employees and families from Saudi Arabia, a "Badr" multilateral defense cooperation memorandum signed by Qatar, Indonesia, Pakistan and Turkey in Doha, and a World Meteorological Organization warning that the current El Niño could reach unprecedented intensity.

title_en: Russia says willing to restart Russia-US-Ukraine trilateral talks; Ukraine says agrees to freeze battlefield status quo
summary_en: Russian presidential aide Yuri Ushakov said on the 21st that President Vladimir Putin told US special envoy Steve Witkoff that Russia is willing to restart trilateral talks among Russia, the United States and Ukraine in mid-November, possibly in Abu Dhabi, covering post-conflict security arrangements; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said in a US media interview that the status quo must be frozen as a realistic path to ending the war and that Ukraine supports holding the trilateral talks as soon as possible.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports the issuance of gold and silver commemorative coins marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March, a 3.9% year-on-year rise in nationwide electricity consumption for the first three quarters, plans to build about 30 specialized SME empowerment centers during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, and China's first women's team gymnastics world championship title in 20 years at the Rotterdam championships.

title_en: Major construction projects across China reach key milestones
summary_en: The segment reports that a batch of major construction projects across China have reached key milestones, including the Gansu-Zhejiang ±800 kV ultra-high-voltage direct current transmission project, where stringing work began on October 22 for its Yangtze River crossing in Wuhu, Anhui, with the Anhui section expected to be fully connected by month's end. It also covers progress on the Hangzhou Bay cross-sea railway bridge, the Dalian Changhai Bridge, the Heixiazi Island highway port project in Fuyuan, Heilongjiang, and the Huangmaoxia reservoir project in Guangdong.

title_en: Getting the 15th Five-Year Plan Off to a Good Start: New Progress in High-Quality Commercial Development
summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on October 22, a Ministry of Commerce official said China's commercial operations were generally stable with steady progress in the first three quarters of the year, laying a foundation for the 15th Five-Year Plan. During the plan period, China will work to unlock consumer potential, expand self-initiated opening, upgrade pilot free trade zones, broaden its global high-standard free trade network, and help shape international rules in emerging fields such as digital and green development.

title_en: Publishing Sector Releases Outstanding Thematic Books Commemorating 90th Anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March Victory
summary_en: To mark the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March victory, the publishing sector has released a batch of thematic books centered on carrying forward the great Long March spirit and embarking on the Long March of the new era, including titles such as "The Great Expedition: A Chronicle of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March" and "Selected Archival and Historical Materials on the Red Army's Long March." The works, featuring prominent themes, authoritative and precious historical materials, and profound content, are intended to help society, especially young people, draw on the power of faith and better carry forward the great Long March spirit.

title_en: TV Gala 'Ode to the Long March' Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March Airs Tonight
summary_en: A television gala titled 'Ode to the Long March,' co-hosted by the Central Propaganda Department, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, China Media Group, the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission, and the Beijing Municipal Party Committee, airs tonight at 8 p.m. on CCTV and new media platforms to mark the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory. The gala, themed on carrying forward the Long March spirit and taking the Long March road of the new era, is structured in five chapters and combines music, dance, drama, and traditional vocal arts.

title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 74th Council of Chairpersons Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee; Decides 25th Session of 14th NPC Standing Committee to Be Held in Beijing November 2-6
summary_en: Zhao Leji chaired the 74th meeting of the Council of Chairpersons of the 14th NPC Standing Committee at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of the 22nd, deciding that the 25th session of the Standing Committee will be held in Beijing from November 2 to 6. The proposed agenda includes deliberation of draft laws on procuratorial public interest litigation, Antarctic activities and environmental protection, water law amendments, anti-cross-border corruption, state-owned assets, and financial law, along with reports on financial work, state-owned asset management, people's assessors, intellectual property procuratorial work, and law enforcement inspections.

title_en: Li Qiang returns to Beijing after concluding overseas visit
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang returned to Beijing by chartered plane on the morning of October 22 after concluding the 31st regular meeting between the Chinese and Russian premiers. State Councilor and Secretary-General of the State Council Wu Zhenglong and other accompanying personnel arrived on the same flight; on departure from St. Petersburg, senior Russian government officials and Chinese Ambassador to Russia Zhang Hanhui saw him off at the airport.

title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Russian President
summary_en: On the afternoon of October 21 local time in St. Petersburg, Premier Li Qiang met with Russian President Vladimir Putin, conveying greetings from Xi Jinping and discussing strengthened bilateral cooperation in energy, trade, and transport, while Putin conveyed greetings to Xi and expressed support for China hosting this year's APEC leaders' meeting.

title_en: CCTV Quick Commentary: Striving to Create New Glory on the New Long March
summary_en: CCTV News (Xinwen Lianbo) reports that the program aired a CCTV Quick Commentary today (October 22) titled "Striving to Create New Glory on the New Long March."

title_en: Grand Meeting Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March Held in Beijing
summary_en: A grand meeting marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech, attended by Li Qiang, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Vice President Han Zheng, with Zhao Leji presiding. Xi reviewed the Long March's history and significance, set out "five musts" for carrying forward the Long March spirit on the new journey, and the meeting concluded with the Internationale.

title_en: 24 Solar Terms: Frost's Descent
summary_en: The segment marks Frost's Descent (Shuangjiang), the last solar term of autumn, describing the seasonal frost, the red maple leaves and persimmons of the north, and the folk customs of viewing red leaves and eating persimmons, while noting that the autumn grain harvest is ending and autumn-winter planting is underway.

title_en: International News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports on Russian President Vladimir Putin saying Russia and the US agreed to restart trilateral talks with Ukraine aimed at ensuring Russian and Ukrainian security after a final peace deal, with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy responding on security guarantees and ceasefire conditions; Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordering a full blockade of the West Bank after an attack near Hebron; and Yemen's Houthis claiming missile and drone strikes on Saudi targets including the Defense Ministry, while Saudi authorities reported casualties at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam.

title_en: International figures praise Xi Jinping's speech at the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory
summary_en: International figures praised Xi Jinping's speech at the commemoration of the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Red Army's Long March victory, saying the Long March spirit inspires China's progress and offers lessons for the world. Several who have visited Long March historical sites said Xi linked the Long March's historical experience to China's development cause.

title_en: Domestic News Roundup
summary_en: The segment reports that the NDRC released a revised Measures for the Administration of Outbound Investment, effective December 1; that State Grid fixed-asset investment exceeded 450 billion yuan in the first three quarters, up 5.2% year on year; that 6G railway applications and other tasks were included in the railway sector's 15th Five-Year Plan innovation goals; that China's innovation index for 2025 rose 6.4% to 185.5; that people's assessors nationwide total 340,000; that procuratorial organs handled over 8,000 administrative procuratorial cases involving enterprises since March 2025; and that the Supreme People's Court released typical cases of assessor participation in trials.

title_en: Second Phase of 140th Canton Fair Opens Today
summary_en: The second phase of the 140th Canton Fair opened in person on October 23 under the theme "Quality Home," featuring nearly 640,000 green, low-carbon products such as fully biodegradable tableware made from sugarcane bagasse and plant fibers and lithium-battery lawn mowers, with about 11,000 exhibitors across 515,000 square meters through October 27.

title_en: China's Fiscal Operations Generally Stable in First Three Quarters
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reported that national general public budget revenue reached 17.23 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 5.1% year-on-year, while expenditures rose 1% to 21.02 trillion yuan, with health spending up 7.7% largely due to childcare subsidies and social security and employment spending up 5.2%. Local government special bond issuance accelerated, with 3.5608 trillion yuan of new special bonds issued from January to September, representing 81% of the planned quota.

title_en: Central Organization Department Allocates 25 Million Yuan from Party Dues to Support Earthquake Relief Work in Tibet
summary_en: To implement the important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping, the Central Organization Department recently allocated 25 million yuan in special funds from the party dues managed on behalf of the Central Committee to Tibet to support earthquake relief work.

title_en: Rescue and relief work for the 7.0-magnitude earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet, proceeds apace
summary_en: A 7.0-magnitude earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet, has killed 16 people and injured 76, prompting the deployment of more than 5,000 rescue personnel, the evacuation of over 12,400 residents, and the establishment of 18 resettlement sites. The State Council earthquake relief headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management raised the national earthquake disaster emergency response from Level IV to Level III, while central authorities allocated 30 million yuan in budget investment and 50 million yuan in disaster relief funds.

title_en: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting
summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on October 23 to study work on coordinating population and economic-social development and to hear a report on implementing the deployments of the National Service Industry Conference. The meeting called for better coordinating population with economic, social, resource and environmental factors, boosting the service sector's role in supporting economic growth, and removing obstacles to service industry development.

title_en: Forging New Glory on the New Long March: Xi Jinping's Speech at the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March Inspires Strong Response
summary_en: Xinwen Lianbo reported that Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a rally marking the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March victory, calling the new journey a new Long March for the Party and the people and setting out "five musts" for carrying forward the Long March spirit. The segment said the speech drew an enthusiastic response, including from 108-year-old Red Army veteran Du Guobang, and that people across sectors pledged to unite more closely around the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core.

title_en: At Xi Jinping's Invitation, German President to Visit China
summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier will pay a state visit to China from October 27 to 31.

title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on 7.0-Magnitude Earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu City, Tibet, Stressing Full-Scale Search and Rescue, Proper Resettlement of Affected People, and Effective Safeguarding of Lives and Property; Li Qiang Issues Instructions
summary_en: A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu City, Tibet, on October 22, causing heavy casualties. Xi Jinping ordered full-scale search and rescue, treatment of the injured, monitoring of aftershocks and weather in the high-altitude area, and proper resettlement of those affected, while Premier Li Qiang issued instructions on verifying the damage and organizing relief efforts.

title_en: CPC Central Politburo Holds Meeting to Review Comprehensive Report on the Seventh Round of Inspections of the 20th Central Committee; Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Presides
summary_en: The CPC Central Politburo met on October 23, chaired by General Secretary Xi Jinping, to review a comprehensive report on the seventh round of inspections of the 20th Central Committee. The meeting affirmed progress in the work of central Party and state organs while noting problems requiring rectification, and called for stronger Party governance, continued reform, and risk prevention.
